Requisition ID: 67578 Title:Engineer II- Product Security

Seeking a Engineer II - Product Security (SecOps - Cloud) with an interest in cybersecurity wanting a career that positively impacts people lives!!

Arthrex is a global medical device manufacturer, and our mission is Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better™. As our Engineer II - Product Security (SecOps - Cloud) you will support the security of Arthrex's Engineering software delivery environment by assisting in cloud security monitoring and triage, detection rule maintenance, tooling health, and pipeline and infrastructure security across AWS and Azure. This role works within the Global Product Security Engineering team and is well-suited for a security engineer with a foundation in cloud security and detection engineering who is building depth across the engineering security discipline. The ideal candidate would work from our Naples, FL, Boston, MA, or Santa Barbara, CA locations; however, we are open to full-time remote anywhere in the United States.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Security Monitoring & Detection - Monitor and triage security findings across Arthrex's Engineering environments using CSPM/CNAPP tooling (Wiz), AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, and Azure Defender for Cloud; assess severity, distinguish true from false positives, and escalate confirmed findings per established procedures. Support the maintenance and tuning of detection rules, alert policies, and thresholds to reduce noise and improve signal fidelity, surfacing coverage gaps and recommending adjustments to senior team members.
  • Tooling & Log Pipeline Health - Monitor the health of Engineering security tooling and log ingestion pipelines, ensuring log sources are active, complete, and flowing correctly. Verify that cloud security services are properly enabled and configured across all in-scope Engineering accounts and subscriptions; assist in maintaining security dashboards and alerting configurations; escalate coverage gaps or tool degradation as needed.
  • Incident Response & Runbook Development - Contribute to the development and upkeep of incident response playbooks and triage runbooks for Engineering security events; participate in incident response activities including triage, containment support, evidence collection, and post-incident documentation.
  • Compliance & Reporting - Support Engineering compliance activities related to SOC 2 and HIPAA audit readiness including evidence collection, control documentation, and gap tracking. Contribute to security reporting including finding summaries, remediation tracking, and tool health status for Engineering leadership and compliance stakeholders.
  • Designs security architecture of components or functional systems and modifies existing designs to develop or improve products.
  • Recommends alterations to development and design to improve the security of products and/or procedures.
  • Contributes to a broader design perspective and considers how an application interacts with the underlying infrastructure or external resources.
  • Conducts structured threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities, rates associated risks, and designs mitigations. Ensures outputs are documented in DHF and linked to security requirements and ISO14971 risk assessments.
  • Maintains security relevant design history file documentation for assigned projects, adhering to Arthrex’s ISO13485 based design control procedures.
  • Determines the necessity of security testing and manages testing of assigned products.
  • Provides Regulatory Affairs technical support for assigned projects in support of global product approvals.
  • Supports Marketing and Product Management with technical support for training and marketing of assigned products.
  • Partners with Software Engineering to design and develop components, processes, and training using Security-by-Design and Privacy-by-Design principles.
  • Supports surgeon and distributor customers in the sales process by educating and demonstrating security-focused aspects of assigned products as needed.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance (Global Privacy and AI Governance), and IT to ensure products comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
  • Reports on progress and status of assigned projects on a timely basis.
  • May be required to travel; International travel may be required.

Knowledge:

  • Frequent use and general knowledge of industry practices, techniques, and standards. General application of concepts and principles.

Skills:

  • Cloud Threat Detection & Visibility(required): Hands-on experience monitoring and investigating security findings and incidents in a cloud environment, including working experience with AWS and/or Azure security services (Security Hub, GuardDuty, Azure Defender for Cloud), CSPM or CNAPP platforms, and security log management including log source validation, ingestion health monitoring, and coverage gap identification across AWS and Azure. Wiz experience is strongly preferred.
  • Identity & Access Security(required): Experience with identity federation, lifecycle management, and RBAC using Okta and/or Microsoft Entra ID (SAML/SSO).
  • Automation & Scripting(required): Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and tooling.
  • Experience with detection engineering fundamentals: alert tuning, false positive analysis, detection rule management, and runbook development preferred.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Argo, and Terraform security best practices preferred.
  • AWS Security Specialty or Microsoft Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) certification preferred.
  • Knowledgeable of System and Software Development Processes and Lifecycles required.
  • Knowledgeable of application security best practices required.

Education and Experience:

  • 2+ years of related experience required; preferably in cloud security, security operations, or a related security engineering role.
  • Bachelor degree required preferably in Engineering (Mechanical, Biomedical, Electrical or Software Engineering), Computer Science, Information Security, or Cybersecurity.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE COMPANYOur client is an Australian supplier of safety barrier and protection systems — guardrails, wire rope barriers, crash cushions, bollards, speed humps, pedestrian barriers and related infrastructure — to the construction, civil/road infrastructure and industrial sectors, with installations across Victoria.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is an Australian supplier of safety barrier and protection systems — guardrails, wire rope barriers, crash cushions, bollards, speed humps, pedestrian barriers and related infrastructure — to the construction, civil/road infrastructure and industrial sectors, with installations across Victoria. The business is based in Melbourne and led by its Director who this role reports to directly.

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • This is a senior, hands-on bookkeeping and accounts role sitting at the centre of the company's day-to-day finance function — real ownership of the numbers, not just data entry.

  • The company needs someone who can prepare BAS accurately, run the full accounts receivable cycle including picking up the phone to chase overdue invoices directly with clients, and build cash flow forecasts and budgets

  • This is not a role for someone who only wants to process transactions and send statements. The company specifically wants someone who doesn't feel above calling a client directly about an overdue payment, and who takes ownership of the finance function every day rather than needing to be chased themselves.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

To independently own the day-to-day bookkeeping and accounts function — accounts payable and receivable (including proactive, phone-based collections), BAS preparation, bank reconciliation, and cash flow forecasting and budgeting — with the accuracy and daily discipline to keep the business's finances current, accurate and reliable.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    ▸ Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Raise and issue customer invoices accurately and on time

  • Monitor debtors daily and proactively follow up overdue invoices — including by phone directly with clients, not just email reminders or statements

  • Confirm payment arrangements with clients where required, and escalate genuine disputes rather than letting them run

  • Allocate receipts and maintain accurate customer account records

    • ▸ Accounts Payable & Bookkeeping

  • Process supplier invoices, and schedule and process payments

  • Perform bank reconciliations across accounts within agreed timeframes

  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies before they compound

  • Maintain the general ledger and day-to-day bookkeeping records to a high standard of accuracy

    • ▸ BAS & Compliance

  • Prepare Business Activity Statements (BAS) accurately and on time each period, liaising with the company's external accountant/tax agent as required for review and lodgement

  • Apply correct GST treatment to transactions

  • Maintain audit-ready, well-documented financial records

    • ▸ Forecasting & Budgeting

  • Prepare and maintain cash flow forecasts that reflect the real timing of receivables and payables, not just historical averages

  • Build and maintain budgets, and report actual performance against budget

  • Flag emerging cash flow or budget risks early, before they become a problem for Brad and Matt

    • ▸ Ownership & Daily Discipline

  • Own the finance function's daily rhythm — reconciliations, collections calls and reporting cadence — without needing to be prompted or chased

  • Communicate clearly and proactively with Brad and Matt on the state of the numbers, including when the news isn't good

  • Query unclear instructions or figures rather than guessing

    • ▸ Working Hours

  • Part-time, 20 hours per week, aligned to Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST/AEDT) business hours, working the same calendar as the Australian-based leadership team

MUST-HAVE (ESSENTIAL)

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on, full-cycle bookkeeping/accounts experience — accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation and BAS preparation

  • Demonstrated experience preparing BAS accurately and on time, period after period

  • Genuine, proven experience proactively phoning clients to collect overdue payments — comfortable with real, sometimes difficult collection calls, not just email reminders or statements

  • Demonstrated experience preparing cash flow forecasts and/or budgets, and reporting actual performance against them

  • Proficient in Xero (or an equivalent cloud accounting platform such as MYOB), with strong Excel skills

  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail, able to meet recurring compliance deadlines (BAS, reconciliations, reporting)

  • Genuine daily self-discipline — works the numbers every day as a matter of routine, without needing to be prompted or chased

  • Confident, professional communicator, comfortable having direct conversations with clients about money

  • Able to work independently in a remote environment with limited day-to-day supervision

  • Available part-time (20 hours per week) on hours aligned to Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT)

NICE-TO-HAVE (DESIRABLE)

  • Background in construction, building products, or a trade-services supplier — familiarity with progress claims, retentions or trade payment terms

  • Certificate in Bookkeeping and Accounting, and/or BAS Agent registration (or eligibility)

  • Experience presenting cash flow forecasts or budget performance directly to business owners or directors

  • Experience with credit control or collections as a distinct specialism, not just as one part of a broader AR role

jobs.excerpt: Company BackgroundCensys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet.
jobs.description:
Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

Location: United States- Remote

Company Background

Censys is building the most credible, robust map of the Internet through IP scanning, DNS lookups, web crawling, and the ingestion of millions of certificates. Censys was founded by security researchers who are passionate about developing technology that provides anyone the power to fully understand their digital risk and exposure. Individuals and enterprises–and anyone in between–can harness this power to discover new information and insight as the Internet, IoT and Cloud evolve. We are a true security startup with midwestern roots and we believe that a map of the Internet, or a map of your organization’s assets can quickly help guide organizations to the answers they need to protect themselves from vulnerability and risk.

Role Summary

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Data Collection team, which builds and operates the systems that discover, scan, and collect the Internet data powering the Censys Internet Map and our customer-facing products.

The team includes various engineers working across high-performance network scanning, protocol implementation, scan orchestration, real-time data pipelines and platforms, observability, and production operations. Its work directly affects the coverage, freshness, accuracy, reliability, and cost efficiency of the data our customers rely on.

This independent manager will own the team’s people leadership, technical roadmap, delivery, and operational health. You will partner with Product, Research, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to identify high-value investments and deliver them effectively. You should be technically credible and able to engage in architecture, design reviews, incidents, and engineering tradeoffs while enabling engineers.

The Job Is a Good Fit If You

  • Enjoy developing a multidisciplinary engineering team while balancing people leadership, technical strategy, delivery, and operations.
  • Can set clear direction without needing to make every decision yourself.
  • Coach through frequent feedback, meaningful delegation, and clear expectations.
  • Use measurable outcomes such as coverage, freshness, accuracy, reliability, recovery time, and infrastructure efficiency to guide decisions.
  • Are comfortable balancing speed, quality, cost, technical debt, operational risk, and customer impact.
  • Believe engineering owns the full system lifecycle and works iteratively with Product and Research to solve ambiguous problems.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop Scanner Engineers and Distributed Systems Engineers.
  • Set clear expectations for ownership, quality, collaboration, delivery, and operational responsibility.
  • Provide timely feedback, create meaningful growth plans, and delegate ownership of systems, projects, and decisions.
  • Build a healthy, accountable team; identify staffing needs; and maintain a high bar for hiring, onboarding, and performance management.

Own the Roadmap and Delivery

  • Define the Data Collection roadmap with Product, Research, Infrastructure, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Connect priorities to measurable improvements in data coverage, freshness, fidelity, reliability, scalability, and cost.
  • Keep the team focused on the highest-value work while managing scope, dependencies, staffing, and risk.
  • Lead major initiatives from discovery through production delivery, clearly communicating timelines, tradeoffs, and risks.
  • Translate research and exploratory work into maintainable production capabilities when appropriate.

Provide Technical and Operational Leadership

  • Guide architecture across Internet scanning, orchestration, protocol implementations, distributed services, ingestion pipelines, APIs, and operational tooling.
  • Establish standards for design, testing, rollout safety, observability, service ownership, and operational readiness.
  • Be accountable for the quality, availability, maintainability, and cost efficiency of the team’s systems.
  • Define and use metrics for scan execution, pipeline health, data freshness, protocol coverage, failure rates, and resource consumption.
  • Support sustainable on-call and incident-management practices, ensuring follow-up addresses systemic causes.
  • Identify architectural bottlenecks and strategic technical debt, evaluate the cost and benefit of addressing them, and recommend priorities.

What You’ll Bring

  • Engineering management or team leadership experience (three years)
  • A track record of leading a substantial technical initiative from planning through production delivery.
  • Prior experience as a software or systems engineer building and operating production systems.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems and networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS.
  • Experience with data-intensive systems such as streaming services, ingestion pipelines, message queues, databases, schedulers, or high-throughput APIs.
  • Experience operating critical systems in production, including monitoring, incident response, capacity planning, and reliability improvement.
  • The technical fluency to contribute to architecture discussions, assess implementation risks, and support complex incident analysis.
  • Demonstrated success developing engineers through coaching, feedback, and delegation, including engineers with different specialties.
  • Strong project-management and communication skills, with the ability to turn broad objectives into clear priorities, milestones, and outcomes.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Things That Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience with Internet-scale scanning, network measurement, telemetry, security data, or distributed collection systems.
  • Experience with Cloud stacks, like GCP or similar.
  • Experience with streaming platforms or large-scale data stores such as Pub/Sub, Kafka, Bigtable, Spanner, or comparable technologies.
  • A background in cybersecurity, Internet measurement, threat intelligence, security research, or productionizing research systems.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Engineering Manager for Data Collection will:

  • Establish a clear charter and roadmap aligned with company, product, research, and customer priorities.
  • Build a cohesive team in which Scanner Engineers and Distributed Systems Engineers share ownership of end-to-end outcomes and grow into broader responsibilities.
  • Deliver major initiatives that measurably improve data coverage, freshness, fidelity, reliability, scalability, or cost efficiency.
  • Improve operational visibility, service ownership, incident practices, technical-debt management, and delivery predictability.

jobs.title: Senior Managing Director of Organizing
jobs.excerpt: THE CHISHOLM LEGACY PROJECT SUMMARY:The mission of the Chisholm Legacy Project is rooted in the Just Transition Framework.
jobs.description:
THE CHISHOLM LEGACY PROJECT SUMMARY:

The mission of the Chisholm Legacy Project is rooted in the Just Transition Framework. The project serves as a vehicle to connect Black communities on the frontlines of climate justice with resources to traverse the path from vision to strategy to action plan to implementation to transformation. In support of frontline leadership, the project seeks to link movements and mainstream entities with the tools necessary to advance systems change centered in equity and justice. With Black women on the frontlines of advancing systems change, this project ensures that these leaders have the support they need as they transform society from extractivism to a living economy that cares for sacred relationships between people and with Mother Earth, through regenerative, cooperative, democratic systems.

SUMMARY OF THEPOSITION:

The organization seeks a Senior Managing Director of Organizing with a commitment to supporting Black Liberation and a willingness to be on a learning journey, joining an institution that is grounded in Black Liberation, Climate Justice, and Just Transition. This position serves as a key member of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), providing strategic oversight and leadership to ensure alignment between programs, organizing, and strategy within The Chisholm Legacy Project (TCLP). The role is responsible for supervising senior programmatic leaders, fostering a culture centered on Black Liberation and Just Transition, and ensuring that TCLP’s work is mission-driven and community-centered.

Additionally, the Senior Managing Director of Organizing acts as a connector and facilitator, ensuring effective collaboration across departments, guiding organizing, and maintaining accountability for outcomes and impact. The SMDO also plays a critical role in assessing partnerships, representing TCLP in national spaces, and advancing key strategic initiatives to support just transition, including climate justice, gender justice, and Black liberation.

This position will be responsible for ensuring strategic alignment and consistent communication with the programs team in partnership with the Senior Managing Director of Programs.

Roles & Responsibilities

    Senior Leadership & Organizational Strategy

  • Serve on the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) contributing to mission, vision, strategy, and work plan development.
  • Collaborate with ELT to nurture an organizational culture centering Black Liberation and Just Transition.
  • Ensure organizational practices reflect connection, fulfillment, care, support, and purpose-driven accountability.
  • Provide co-leadership in fostering a culture that aligns with TCLP’s values.

    • Organizing Strategy, Infrastructure, and Movement Alignment

    • Provide executive leadership for the organization’s organizing function, ensuring that organizing strategy and structure advance TCLP’s broader mission, strategy, and movement-building goals.
    • Set the strategic direction for organizing approaches across regions, ensuring alignment with a community-centered theory of change and consistency in how outreach, engagement, and strategies are designed and deployed.
    • Ensure the development of a cohesive, organization-wide organizing framework that integrates tools and methodologies such as power mapping, narrative strategy, digital engagement, and community visioning.
    • Drive the evolution of innovative organizing strategies, and engagement models that strengthen grassroots leadership, deepen community relationships, and contribute to sustained environmental justice outcomes.
    • Cultivate and steward a robust ecosystem of partnerships across local, regional, and national stakeholders; including cross-movement, faith-based, and environmental justice organizations to expand collective impact and resource alignment for frontline communities.
    • Ensure alignment and integration between organizing and other core functions, including programs, communications, policy, research, and resource development, to support cohesive, constituency-driven strategies.
    • Provide strategic oversight of the structures, systems, and resource flows that enable effective organizing, ensuring alignment between priorities, investments, and long-term sustainability.

      • Team Leadership & Supervision

    • Provide supportive supervision to the Managing Director of Just Transition Municipalities Institute, Senior Director of Organizing and Senior Director of Narrative Strategy.
    • Ensure all direct reports and their teams have clear work plans and adhere to TCLP’s performance management system.
    • Maintain full accountability for departmental impact, balancing trust in team members with active verification.

      • Just Transition Municipal Strategy and Movement Integration

      • Provide executive oversight and strategic direction for TCLP’s Just Transition municipal strategy, ensuring alignment with TCLP’s broader organizing vision, and long-term goals.
      • Ensure the design and evolution of a scalable, multi-tiered engagement model that supports municipalities at varying levels of readiness, expanding access to Just Transition frameworks, tools, and pathways for implementation across diverse communities.
      • Steward the advancement of a national municipal ecosystem that enables local governments; particularly those serving historically disenfranchised communities; to adopt and implement community-driven Just Transition approaches.
      • Ensure the integration of leadership development and wellbeing-centered frameworks within municipal strategies, with a particular emphasis on advancing and sustaining Black femme leadership in local governance.
      • Drive the alignment of municipal organizing efforts with broader state, national, and global advocacy strategies, positioning Just Transition municipalities as a catalyst for systems-level policy change and widespread model adoption.
      • Ensure that municipal-based strategies are fully integrated into TCLP’s broader organizing infrastructure, including narrative strategy, policy development, research, and cross-movement coalition efforts, to maximize impact and coherence.

        • Focal Constituency Based Organizing Support

        • Global Afro Descendant Climate Justice Collaborative (GADCJC): Guide the development of cross-border and diaspora-based partnerships that connect U.S. communities with global communities, fostering shared learning, solidarity, and coordinated approaches to Just Transition and Black Liberation.
        • Black Base Building: Provide strategic leadership and oversight of TCLP’s engagement with Black-led base-building organizations across national, regional, and local movements, strengthening partnerships, collective capacity, and access to resources that advance Black Liberation and Just Transition. Ensure the team’s partnerships, and capacity-building efforts, including convenings, are aligned with organizational strategy and effectively connect movement organizations to TCLP’s programs, resources, and strategic opportunities.
        • Alignment Initiatives: Guide the strategic development of the Alignment Initiatives to advance inclusion, agency, and leadership for historically disenfranchised Black communities within the movements for climate justice and Black Liberation.

          • Narrative Strategy

        • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for narrative strategy work with frontline communities.
        • Provide strategic direction and management for leadership development and TCLP’s constituency communications efforts, including spokesperson development, media engagement, popular education and organizing partnerships, and amplification of frontline community voices.
        • Oversee the development and execution of key narrative initiatives and platforms, including the Black Climate Justice Toastmasters Initiative, Our Stories, Our Narratives Digital Media and Film Initiative, story library development, and narrative analysis to inform TCLP’s Just Transition communications strategy and messaging platform.

          • Partnerships & External Representation

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our mission is clear and staggeringly important: we're building the manufacturing operating system of the future from the ground up, one that’s engineered to create network effects as we grow.
jobs.description:
Our mission is clear and staggeringly important: we're building the manufacturing operating system of the future from the ground up, one that’s engineered to create network effects as we grow. A beautiful, sophisticated quantum leap forward for the most important core industry in the world.
Manufacturing is important. It’s the fundamental industry on which everything else is built. We take it for granted. In 1989, 35% of the entire software industry was manufacturing systems. What was the first massive burst in productivity from technology has stagnated into diminishing returns and increasing complexity. We can only continue to add complexity for so much longer until the whole system collapses.
"Any intelligent fool can make things bigger and more complex. It takes a touch of genius and a lot of courage to move in the opposite direction." - Albert Einstein

Who you are

    We’re less interested in whether you’ve followed a traditional Account Management career path than whether you’ve developed the capabilities this job requires. Great candidates may come from Account Management, Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Implementation, technical sales, or other customer-facing roles. What matters is evidence that you can own sophisticated customer relationships, diagnose difficult problems, learn quickly, and create commercial outcomes.
  • Deeply curious. You don’t take a customer’s description of a problem at face value—you ask questions, dig into how their business actually works, and figure out what’s really happening
  • You enjoy learning how things work, whether that’s a customer’s manufacturing process, a new Fulcrum product, an integration, or a technical problem you’ve never seen before
  • You actively use AI to make yourself more capable and productive, and you’re excited by how quickly tools like Claude Code are expanding what non-engineers can build and solve
  • You have the judgment and presence to navigate complex organizations, competing priorities, frustrated stakeholders, and senior executives
  • You build high-trust relationships without becoming passive. You’re comfortable challenging customers, asking uncomfortable questions, and selling when you believe it’s genuinely in their best interest
  • You create opportunities rather than waiting for customers to tell you what they want to buy
  • You take ownership when things go wrong. You communicate problems early, create a plan, and stay close until they’re resolved
  • You like operating with high velocity and limited structure. Ambiguity makes you curious rather than uncomfortable
  • You’re industrious. You enjoy getting into the details, learning new things, experimenting, and doing work that might fall outside a traditional Account Manager’s job description
  • You’re collaborative, but don’t confuse collaboration with dependency. You know when to bring in an expert and when to become capable enough to handle something yourself

What the job is

    You’ll own a portfolio os Fulcrum customers after implementation, with responsibility for retaining and growing the relationship over time. Doing that well requires much more than managing renewals and running business reviews. You’ll need to understand how your customers actually operate - their people, processes, constraints, politics, and economics - well enough to identify problems and opportunities that may not recognize themselves.

    Fulcrum is increasingly giving customer-facing teams the ability to solve problems that historically required Product, Engineering, or technical specialists. We expect our Account Managers to embrace that. You won’t need to be an engineer, but you should be excited to use AI, data, and new tools to investigate problems, prototype solutions, and make yourself increasingly capable.

    You’ll:
  • Develop a deep understanding of how each customer’s business actually operates, from executive priorities to the workflows of people on the shop floor
  • Ask probing questions, investigate problems, and distinguish symptoms from root causes
  • Build relationships and navigate politics across complex customer organizations rather than relying on a single champion
  • Identify risk early, communicate it internally, and take ownership of creating a path forward before revenue is threatened
  • Create and close expansion opportunities by identifying valuable problems Fulcrum can solve—not simply responding to inbound interest
  • Balance commercial aggressiveness with long-term trust; know when to push, when to challenge, and when selling more would be the wrong decision
  • Use AI and other tools to analyze customer problems, work with data, prototype ideas, automate work, and solve things that might previously have required another team
  • Learn new Fulcrum products deeply enough to confidently teach, demonstrate, troubleshoot, and sell
  • Get hands-on when customers need help rather than reflexively routing problems to Product, Engineering, or Support
  • Lead executive conversations and business reviews that turn operational details into clear business outcomes and decisions
  • Re-engage struggling accounts and stay close to problems until momentum has been restored
  • Manage renewals with no surprises—understand the health, politics, value, and likely commercial outcome of an account well before the renewal date
  • Bring patterns from customers back into Fulcrum so Product, Engineering, Marketing, and GTM can make better decisions
  • Operate effectively without a complete playbook and actively improve the way the AM team works

Who you’ll work with

  • Customers ranging from day-to-day users and operational leaders to owners and executives
  • Launch Managers who onboard customers and transition them into an ongoing partnership
  • Product Managers & Engineers to learn, collaborate on difficult problems, and turn recurring customer needs into better products without treating them as the default owners of your customer’s problems
  • Marketing to surface customer stories, advocacy, referrals, and opportunities to amplify customer success
  • Account Executives who bring new customers into Fulcrum and help establish the foundation for the relationship

Why this role is different

    Account management at Fulcrum isn’t about checking in once a quarter, running a QBR, and routing customer requests to other teams.

    Our customers are manufacturers. Their businesses are complicated, their problems don’t always fit neatly inside software, and the person describing a problem often doesn’t know its root cause. To be great here, you’ll need to become genuinely curious about how shops operate, how people make decisions, and why a process that looks simple from the outside behaves differently on a shop floor.

    You’ll also have capabilities that Account Managers historically haven’t had. AI is making it possible for non-engineers to analyze data, automate workflows, prototype software, and solve increasingly technical customer problems themselves. We want people who are excited by that—not people waiting for someone else to hand them a playbook.

    Sometimes you’ll uncover a problem and turn it into a meaningful expansion. Sometimes you’ll get deep into a workflow because a customer is struggling. Sometimes you’ll teach yourself a new tool, work with data, or prototype something because that’s the fastest way to figure out what’s happening. And sometimes you’ll need to tell a customer—or us—that we’re wrong.

    The job sits intentionally between two competing responsibilities: protect the trust we’ve earned with our customers and use that trust to grow the relationship. Great AMs here don’t maximize one at the expense of the other.

    If you like clearly defined swim lanes, mature processes, and handing technical problems to specialists, this probably won’t be a great fit. If you like understanding complicated businesses, figuring things out yourself, building relationships, solving unfamiliar problems, and turning that work into commercial outcomes, it probably will.

Salary range & benefits

  • $90,000 – $120,000 USD/year + OTE + equity
  • 401(k) matching after 90 days — immediate vesting
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Wellbeing benefits and perks
  • Unlimited vacation policy with required minimums
  • Cell phone & internet plan coverage

    • This role is open to candidates located in the U.S. and authorized to work here. We’re not able to offer visa
    sponsorship or consider international applicants at this time.
The market tells us we’re on the right track: +50% year over year growth but we know to not rest on our laurels and that there's a lot of stuff to build and a huge amount of work to be done. We're looking for people who can stand alongside us and work hard to make our dreams become reality in the fastest, smoothest, and best way possible.
If you're someone who is obsessed with making amazing things, being the best, and wanting your work to contribute to something excellent, please reach out.

About the Team

The Professional Services organization at Miro is focused on ensuring our Enterprise customers achieve exceptional outcomes through the Innovation Workspace. Our team of strategic advisors, implementation experts, and forward deployed consultants work side-by-side with customers to transform how they collaborate, build, and innovate—powered by agentic AI and Miro's world-class platform.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Consultant, Manufacturing, you will apply AI solutions to transform and automate the core operating processes of leading industrial enterprises. You will engage directly with C-level executives, help them identify high-impact opportunities, build and test enterprise-grade AI solutions on their own data and systems, and drive measurable business outcomes.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology. You will be paired with an Account Executive against named accounts—hunting for problems worth solving, then proving they can be solved. Generalist FDCs lead client discussions across industries; as the Manufacturing Specialist, you are the dedicated depth they bring in when a pursuit turns on industrial expertise.

What you’ll do

Executive Agenda:

  • Partner with senior executives—COO, Chief Supply Chain Officer, Chief Digital Officer, VP Manufacturing, VP Quality—to define an AI transformation agenda Miro can attach to
  • Lead the initial CxO conversation that creates awareness of what AI makes possible for the business
  • Qualify opportunities before committing to a Validation Sprint: sponsor authority, commitment, and the account's potential to become a multi-year, seven-figure relationship

Validation Sprints:

  • Co-author the Sprint charter with the AE: the business problem, its value, our approach, exit criteria, and the partnership proposal that follows success
  • Run the Sprint end to end—immerse, prioritise, build, read out—developing and testing the solution on the customer's real data and systems
  • Take manufacturing processes apart and rebuild them on AI-first principles across five workflows: new product development and gate review, quality and continuous improvement, portfolio and program management, operations and launch readiness, and process development and transformation
  • Build using Miro's AI Workflows, Prototypes, and Goals, Roadmaps & Delivery capabilities, extended through Miro's API, WebSDK, and MCP integrations into ERP, PLM, MES, and quality systems

Value and Conversion:

  • Turn Sprint outcomes into a business value story, ROI model, and KPI baseline—grounded in metrics the customer already runs on: gate cycle time, requirement coverage at gate, defect recurrence, cost of poor quality, capacity utilisation, on-time launch rate, ramp-to-full-rate time
  • Support executive leadership in delivering the Value Story read-out to the sponsor
  • Co-own with the AE the conversion of Sprint outcomes into the partnership proposal and commercial approach
  • Define the scope of Professional Services involvement post-sale and hand over cleanly

  • Deep understanding of manufacturing operating processes: NPI and stage-gate/APQP, engineering change management, quality systems (FMEA, 8D, PPAP), S&OP and production planning, lean and continuous improvement, maintenance and reliability
  • Fluency with the industrial enterprise stack—ERP (SAP or equivalent), PLM (Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE), MES, quality management systems—and where the data lives

  • Comfort in both the boardroom and the plant
  • Self-starter who operates independently and under ambiguity
  • Willing to travel to customer sites up to 40%

Welcome to OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe, smart, and environmentally responsible.

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto, Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX and see how far you can go.

We believe the future of our products sits at the intersection of AI and design. Our ambition is to become an AI-native organization, where intelligent systems and human-centered design come together to create faster, smarter, and more meaningful customer experiences. We’re rethinking how products are built, how experiences are shaped, and how teams deliver impact.

A key part of this transformation is creating the right foundations and infrastructure to enable high-quality experiences at scale - where design systems, patterns, and workflows are structured, scalable, and AI-readable, unlocking new levels of speed, consistency, and innovation.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team. Reporting to the Product Design Manager, you will shape design strategy across product squads, own craft and quality standards, and mentor junior and mid-level designers. You'll work at the intersection of design, code, and AI systems—using tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor to prototype and iterate. Beyond shipping product experiences, you'll establish patterns, build systems thinking, and elevate the entire team's capabilities in AI-native design. The output we expect is not just working artifacts: it's strategic direction that raises design quality and team maturity across the organization.

What responsibilities will you get when working with us?

  • Lead design strategy across one or more product squads, translating business goals and user needs into coherent design direction that shapes product roadmaps and team priorities.

  • Use AI-native workflows to collapse the gap between strategy and production, prototyping and iterating directly in code rather than through static handoffs. Lead by example in adopting tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor for end-to-end design execution.

  • Establish and maintain high craft standards by defining foundational and reusable Agentic Experience patterns, designing scalable components for the design system (Nexus), and reviewing work to ensure quality and consistency.

  • Mentor and develop designers through critique, guidance, and structured feedback—helping them grow their craft, decision-making, and ability to work autonomously with AI-native tools.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to align on experience strategy, success metrics, and technical feasibility—translating design insights into business outcomes and measurable impact.

  • Conduct user research and run experiments to validate design decisions. Define success metrics, gather feedback, and iterate fast—always balancing speed with quality and bias toward shipping.

  • Lead design reviews, brainstorming sessions, and strategic discussions with your design peers and cross-functional partners. Communicate design rationale clearly with data, influence decisions, and build alignment around priorities.

  • Identify gaps and opportunities for design improvement and innovation. Propose and champion new approaches to solving complex problems—whether through design systems improvements, new AI patterns, or cross-domain initiatives.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will need:

  • Proven experience in UX / Digital Product Design, with a strong portfolio that showcases shipped work, live prototypes, and measurable business impact—not just static screens. We won’t be interviewing if you don’t have a portfolio to share beforehand.

  • Demonstrated expertise in AI-native design: you actively use AI tools (Figma Make, Lovable, Cursor, Claude, etc.) as a core part of your design practice and can teach others how to leverage them effectively.

  • Experience building or contributing to design systems, including code components. You understand how design decisions impact engineering implementation and can collaborate deeply with engineering teams.

  • Proven track record mentoring and developing designers. You give and receive candid feedback, help others improve their craft, and create psychologically safe environments for growth and experimentation.

  • Strong product and business thinking: ability to frame problems strategically, connect design decisions to business outcomes, and define success metrics that demonstrate measurable impact.

  • Excellent English communication and influence skills: you articulate design rationale clearly with data, facilitate complex discussions, and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

  • Help the Risk & Compliance team gather technical evidence for audit frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP), and learn what auditable evidence looks like.

  • Curiosity and a habit of asking why — you want to understand the cause of a vulnerability, not just what the scanner reported.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort asking questions, asking for help, and escalating early.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamps, military, self-directed learning, or similar).

About Kalepa:

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

Our Values (This is important):

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

  • Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
  • Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
  • Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
  • Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
  • Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

About the role:

Cash Compensation: $190-250K

Location: USA (Remote)

Kalepa is bringing on our first dedicated Revenue Operations hire to build and scale the operating system behind our go-to-market team and drive Kalepa’s rapid growth. This is a high-impact, foundational role that will allow you to design systems from scratch: forecasting, pipeline management, territory design, analytics, and other critical revenue operations projects.

You’ll report to the Vice President of Operations, partner closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, and work daily with Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and the founding team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Forecasting and pipeline management: Develop Kalepa’s forecasting methodology, run the regular pipeline/forecast cadence with leadership, and surface risks early.
  • Own a GTM tech stack for the AI era: Oversee the entire tech stack, including but not limited to our CRM (HubSpot), data enrichment tools, and AI-powered automation. You’ll evaluate and implement new tools to accelerate growth and productivity of our GTM teams.
  • Compensation: Work closely with our CRO and finance to design compensation plans that align with Kalepa’s goals.
  • Book of Business and Capacity Planning: Build territories in partnership with the CRO, including account segmentation, quota setting, and annual GTM planning.
  • Analytics and Reporting: Be the source of truth for GTM metrics and reporting - including for Kalepa’s executive team and board meetings.

About you:

  • 7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Strategy & Operations at a high-growth, VC-backed AI/SaaS startup
  • Experience as the first or an early RevOps hire, building the function from scratch and owning it all (or significant pieces of it).
  • A track record of working with GTM and finance leadership to design GTM compensation plans and running them.
  • Experience building forecasts for enterprise sales motions with long, multi-stakeholder cycles.
  • Comfort presenting to executives with a clear recommendation, and the judgment to deliver data-driven insights.
  • Experience owning and implementing a modern, AI-powered GTM tech stack

What you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary (based on experience level).
  • Significant equity options package.
  • 401(k) plan with employer contribution (regardless of employee contribution)
  • Excellent benefits: 100% covered medical, 100% covered vision and dental for individuals and families, and others
  • Work with an ambitious, smart, global, and fun team to transform a $7T global industry.

  • Healthy living/gym stipend. Mobile phone bill stipend.
  • Continuing education credits.
  • Paid parental leave.

About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

An overview of this role

As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage.

You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook.

What you’ll do

  • Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy.
  • Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership.
  • Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff-plus engineers into leaders.
  • Drive cross-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps.
  • Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes.
  • Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions.
  • Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps.
  • Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers.
  • Experience working hands-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters.
  • Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes.
  • Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self-managed upgrade challenge.
  • Experience leading backend engineering teams that own production infrastructure, applying site reliability engineering practices including service level objectives, on-call operations, incident management, cost management, and automation.
  • Experience communicating clearly in writing in an asynchronous, handbook-first company.
  • Experience leading globally distributed remote teams.
  • Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus.

CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. The Lead Finance Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, optimization, integration, governance, and continuous improvement of CareDx's Finance systems portfolio, with NetSuite serving as the Company's core ERP platform and Coupa, Concur, FloQast, and related applications supporting critical financial operations. This role serves as the primary technical owner for Finance systems, partnering closely with Accounting, Finance, Procurement, Internal Audit, and IT stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and well-controlled solutions that support business objectives.

The Lead Finance Systems Administrator provides technical leadership for system configuration, integrations, vendor management, platform enhancements, and operational support. This individual translates business and accounting requirements into effective technology solutions while ensuring the reliability, compliance, and performance of systems supporting financial reporting, procure-to-pay, expense management, month-end close, audit readiness, and SOX-regulated processes.

Reporting and Key Partnerships

Reports to the Manager, IT SOX & Corporate Applications, serving as the primary technical owner for NetSuite and the supporting Finance systems landscape, including Coupa, Concur, FloQast, and other related systems/integrations.

  • Partner closely with the VP Controller, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Supply Chain, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders to support financial operations, reporting requirements, period-end close activities, compliance initiatives, and business process improvements.
  • Collaborate with IT infrastructure, security, integration, and application teams to ensure Finance systems are secure, reliable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards.

Responsibilities:

Finance Systems Administration and Governance

  • Own the administration, optimization, governance, and strategic roadmap for the CareDx Finance systems portfolio, including NetSuite, Coupa, Concur, FloQast, and related financial applications.
  • Serve as the primary technical owner and subject matter expert for Finance systems architecture, configuration, integrations, security, and support.
  • Develop and maintain system standards, documentation, operating procedures, and governance processes that promote scalability, reliability, and compliance.
  • Drive platform enhancements and process improvements that improve user experience, operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and control effectiveness.
  • Establish and maintain disciplined change management practices, including requirements gathering, testing, approvals, deployment controls, and documentation.

Finance and Accounting Enablement

  • Translate accounting and finance requirements into practical NetSuite solutions across close, revenue, billing, procure-to-pay, accounts payable, purchasing, cash, inventory, intercompany, consolidations, reporting, and audit support.
  • Support monthly and quarterly close requirements by improving workflows, reports, reconciliations, saved searches, dashboards, and exception reporting.
  • Create reporting capabilities to support consolidation of financials across multiple subsidiaries, entities, departments, and management reporting layers.
  • Improve accounting processes and workflows for various segments of the business, including processes introduced through acquisitions or new business units.
  • Partner with the VP Controller and Accounting leadership to prioritize system work based on financial reporting risk, operational urgency, compliance impact, and business value.

External Consultant and Project Management

  • Own relationships with external consultants, implementation partners, and managed service providers supporting Finance applications.
  • Oversee project scope, timelines, budgets, solution design, testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer activities.
  • Evaluate recommendations from vendors and consultants to ensure proposed solutions meet CareDx requirements for scalability, supportability, compliance, and long-term maintainability.

Integrations, Systems, and Data

  • Support integrations between NetSuite and adjacent finance or operational systems, including expense management, procurement, inventory or warehouse tools, banking, reporting, and other finance applications.
  • Partner with IT and business owners to troubleshoot integration errors, data mapping issues, master data governance concerns, and failed or incomplete transactions.
  • Support acquisition integration activities, including subsidiary setup, master data alignment, data migration, reporting layers, process stabilization, and post-close support.
  • Help define the long-term architecture and roadmap for the Finance systems ecosystem, ensuring solutions remain scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives.

Training, Adoption, and Stakeholder Support

  • Provide practical training, guidance, and job aids for new and existing users across Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, and other business teams.
  • Build credibility with accounting users by understanding their process pain points and communicating solutions in clear business language.
  • Create a consistent intake and prioritization process for enhancement requests, support tickets, close-related issues, reporting needs, and control remediation items.
  • Manage support tickets issued through ServiceNow or similar ticketing tools, where applicable.

Audit, SOX, and Compliance Support

  • Support the external audit process by helping Accounting and related teams gather system evidence, access support, configuration information, audit documentation, and reports required by external auditors.
  • Partner with Accounting, SOX owners, and external auditors to investigate and resolve audit findings, account discrepancies, access concerns, and issues of non-compliance.
  • Support user access reviews, role design reviews, segregation of duties analysis, change management evidence, and control remediation activities.
  • Ensure finance application administration practices support audit readiness, including evidence retention, approval documentation, and clear ownership of configuration decisions.
  • Participate in risk assessments, control improvement initiatives, and governance activities related to Finance technology.

Minimum Education, Experience, & Specialized Knowledge (Required): 

  • 5+ years of progressive NetSuite administration, finance systems, and ERP implementation experience, with hands-on configuration responsibility in a complex company environment.
  • Strong NetSuite technical skillset across roles and permissions, workflows, saved searches, reports, dashboards, custom records, forms, bundles, release management, sandbox testing, and production deployment practices.
  • At least one year of experience using or administering Coupa.
  • Working understanding of core accounting and finance processes, including close, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, inventory, revenue, consolidations, intercompany, reporting, and audit support.
  • Experience managing or coordinating external consultants, developers, or implementation partners.
  • Experience with integrations between NetSuite, Coupa, Concur, and other finance or operational systems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to Accounting and Finance stakeholders.
  • Ability to take ownership, prioritize competing requests, manage details carefully, and operate in a public-company control environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Public company, SOX, external audit, regulated life sciences, healthcare, or similar controlled-environment experience.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting acquisitions, subsidiary expansion, multi-entity reporting, post-close integration, or ERP stabilization after business combinations.
  • Experience with expense management, procurement, contract lifecycle, warehouse/inventory, banking, reporting, or other systems that integrate with NetSuite.
  • NetSuite certification, SuiteAnalytics, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript familiarity, or comparable technical credentials.
  • SAP Concur, ServiceNow, procurement systems, reporting tools, or similar finance application experience.

jobs.description:
About Schumacher

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company disrupting the $150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next an appreciation for what’s come before, and a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention to detail. Schumacher is a globally recognized company with many showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our competitive advantage in the industry is people. Our employees are our most valuable asset. F. Schumacher & Co is deeply anchored in our company core values ,which are as follows:

  • Preserve The Entrepreneurial Spirit
  • Take Ownership & Accountability
  • Be Solutions-Oriented
  • Demonstrate Courage
  • Practice Adaptability
  • Embrace Collaboration

We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is part of Schumacher North America, which is the largest division of the company.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Temporary Payroll Manager to run end-to-end payroll for 500+ employees in UKG from October 26, 2026 through January 31, 2027. This is a hands-on role: you will process every pay run, own payroll tax registration and reconciliation, and keep employee records accurate.

You will also play a key part in two transitions. First, you will help implement Rippling as our new payroll system. Second, you will help close out a former entity in each state where it operates, partnering with Finance on final payment remittances. The ideal candidate is detail-driven, works independently from day one and is comfortable in a period of change.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end payroll processing (UKG)

  • Run the full payroll cycle for 500+ employees, from data intake through final approval and funding.
  • Enter all payroll transactions in UKG, including new hires, terminations, pay changes, bonuses, commission, incentives, deductions, garnishments and off-cycle payments.
  • Maintain accurate employee profiles in UKG, including pay, tax, direct deposit and deduction setups.
  • Prepare and review pre- and post-payroll audits and variance reports; resolve discrepancies before payroll is finalized.
  • Process off-cycle, manual and final paychecks in line with state final-pay requirements.
  • Respond to employee and manager payroll questions promptly and accurately.

Payroll tax registration and reconciliation

  • Own state and local payroll tax registrations, including new account setups, rate updates and agency correspondence.
  • Reconcile payroll tax filings and payments against payroll registers and agency records each pay period and quarter.
  • Research and resolve tax notices, penalties and account discrepancies.
  • Support Q4 and year-end close, including W-2 preparation and review.

Rippling payroll implementation

  • Assist with pay runs during the transition, including any parallel runs between UKG and Rippling.
  • Help gather, validate and map data for migration, such as employee records, earnings and deduction codes, tax setups and year-to-date balances.
  • Test payroll results in Rippling and reconcile them against UKG output.
  • Help document new payroll processes and controls for the team.
  • Keep registrations up to date in both UKG and Rippling.
  • In January, work on the transition of POA and TPA to Rippling.

Former entity termination

  • Help close out the former entity in each operating state, including payroll tax account closures and final filings.
  • Work with Finance on payment remittances to tax agencies and other payees tied to the former entity.
  • Track closure status by state and escalate open items or risks.

Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of progressive payroll experience, including end-to-end processing for 500+ employees.
  • Hands-on experience running payroll in UKG (UKG Pro).
  • Multi-state payroll experience, including state and local tax registration, filings and reconciliation.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state and local payroll regulations, including final-pay rules.
  • Proven ability to reconcile payroll registers, tax filings and general ledger entries.
  • Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) for audits and reconciliations.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment with confidential data and the ability to meet fixed payroll deadlines.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Rippling or another payroll system implementation or conversion.
  • Experience closing out an entity, including payroll tax account closures across multiple states.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success.
