Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. This role centers on a comprehensive diagnosis of core business constraints impacting client growth, leveraging a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to identify and formulate strategic solutions. This includes pinpointing challenges across all points of sale - DTC/ecommerce acquisition, retail execution, Amazon market share erosion, or upstream strategic barriers like brand positioning - and developing a unified, data-backed strategy to overcome them.

CPG accounts tend to have opinions about their channels that predate the data. Part of this job is having the product, competitive, and retail fluency to challenge those assumptions with credibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with particular attention to how the client's retail and DTC performance interact
  • Own the senior client relationship
  • QBRs should drive decisions, not report history
  • Consult on channel mix across DTC, Amazon, and retail — understand how they cannibalize or reinforce each other and make a recommendation
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a single account strategy
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
  • Coach analysts and specialists; give specific, timely feedback

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in CPG marketing, ideally with both DTC and retail brand experience
  • Understands how Amazon fits into a CPG growth strategy — share of search, ASIN architecture, buy box, sponsored vs. organic balance
  • Familiar with the retailer relationship layer: how Target, Ulta, Sephora, Whole Foods, or similar partners shape media investment decisions
  • Has an opinion on CPG measurement — MMM, incrementality testing, in-store vs. digital attribution
  • Fluent in upper-funnel channel strategy — content, SEO, YouTube, programmatic
  • Comfortable with creative-heavy accounts where briefs, asset velocity, and influencer strategy are as important as media optimization
  • Track record of retaining and growing accounts
  • Has managed senior clients who have strong brand opinions and needs to be met with confidence

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Lead Marketing Technology Manager is responsible for the administration, optimization and evolution of Lumen's marketing automation ecosystem. This role supports campaign execution through project management, platform administration, integration management, data quality improvements and process standardization while partnering with stakeholders to support changing business requirements and new technology adoption. This position partners across Marketing, Sales, Technology, Product, Analytics, and external vendors to drive operational excellence and support evolving business requirements through automation and process innovation.

Work Location

Fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Administer and optimize Marketo and related marketing technologies to support reliable, scalable campaign execution
  • Own the maintenance, monitoring, and optimization of integrations between Marketo and connected systems including Salesforce, Demandbase, Conversica, Knak, NeverBounce, ZoomInfo, OneTrust and future marketing technologies along with the strategy for how to best utilize these systems
  • Lead onboarding of new technologies and integrations, including strategy, security reviews, configuration, testing, deployment, documentation and ongoing support
  • Increase efficiency through project management enhancements and change management processes
  • Drive improvements in data quality, compliance, segmentation and customer experience across the marketing technology stack
  • Perform QA of Marketo campaigns prior to deployment. Support standardization efforts that improve consistency, scalability and campaign performance
  • Own the documentation that support knowledge sharing, operational consistency and stakeholder communication

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Required Qualifications
    • Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) certification
    • 5–10 years of experience administering and optimizing Marketo in enterprise environments
    • Experience supporting large-scale marketing automation programs and campaign operations.
    • Strong experience with Salesforce integrations and complex marketing technology ecosystems
    • Experience managing integrations across multiple marketing technologies and supporting data-driven marketing operations.
    • Experience developing documentation, process maps, operational procedures, and training materials.
    • Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience with multiple marketing automation platforms, including HubSpot, Eloqua, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
    • Experience supporting enterprise MarTech ecosystems including Salesforce, Demandbase, Conversica, ZoomInfo, OneTrust, NeverBounce, webinar platforms, and event technologies.
    • Familiarity with Workfront or similar project management platforms.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Location Based Pay Ranges

Lumen offers a comprehensive package featuring a broad range of Health, Life, Voluntary Lifestyle benefits and other perks that enhance your physical, mental, emotional and financial wellbeing. We're able to answer any additional questions you may have about our bonus structure (short-term incentives, long-term incentives and/or sales compensation) as you move through the selection process.

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.

To learn more about Life at Lumen and how we live the Lumen 8, please visit:

For more information on these checks, please refer to the Post Offer section of our FAQ page. Job-related concerns identified during the background screening may disqualify you from the new position or your current role. Background results will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview: Everything we do is for educators.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Everything we do is for educators. We’re partnering with them to advance a bold vision for education that boosts district performance and student success. At Follett Software, we empower educators across roles with technology that streamlines processes and manages information and resources to improve their schools, increase student success, and drive the future of education. We believe that by empowering educators to amplify their impact on students’ lives, we can change the world. Our goal and mission is to drive the future of education. We are inspired by educators to deliver transformative technology. Our innovative, connected solutions simplify challenges and offer a seamless and intuitive experience.

Position Summary:

We’re looking for a Senior People Partner to support our Product & Technology, Marketing, and Finance teams. This role blends trusted relationship-building, strategic thought partnership, and hands-on execution. You’ll help leaders design healthy, high-performing teams, align people strategy to business goals, and make thoughtful people decisions that serve both employees and the business.

You are growth-oriented, seek feedback, and model the kind of curiosity, accountability, and resilience we expect from our leaders. You take care of people in a very real way—while also holding a high bar for performance, clarity, and business outcomes. You use technology and data as natural parts of your toolkit to support better decision-making and simpler, more transparent processes.

Position Scope:

  • Serve as a primary People Partner to leaders in Product & Technology, Marketing, and Finance, connecting org goals to clear people plans.
  • Advise on org design, headcount planning, team structure, and change management.
  • Anticipate and surface themes, risks, and opportunities early proposing options and helping leaders make thoughtful people-centered decisions.
  • Build trusted relationships with managers and employees across levels; be a go-to partner for candid, solutions-focused conversations.
  • Influence decisions through asking questions, identifying tradeoffs, and offering clear recommendations—not just citing policy.
  • Coach managers and employees through complex situations (role changes, behavior issues, team dynamics).
  • Navigate conflict and tension in a way that preserves trust and keeps work moving forward.
  • Bring the perspective of your client groups into People team decisions and company-wide initiatives.
  • Lead your client groups through core People cycles (performance, calibration, compensation, engagement, recognition) with clear timelines and expectations.
  • Translate company-wide programs into simple, practical guidance for your leaders and teams.
  • Spot process gaps or friction and partner with cross-functional teams to improve, simplify, or automate.
  • Support managers in setting clear expectations, giving effective feedback, and addressing performance issues in a timely, fair way.
  • Help identify and develop top talent and successors for critical roles.
  • Use people metrics to highlight trends and inform leader decisions.
  • Champion Follett Software’s values and drive a culture of clarity, inclusion, accountability, and recognition within your client groups.
  • Use technology and AI tools to increase your own efficiency and improve communication and access to information.
  • This role evolves as the business does; responsibilities may shift as team and company needs change.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in HR/People Partner or HR Business Partner roles.
  • Experience supporting technical teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, or IT) strongly preferred; exposure to Marketing and/or Finance teams is a plus.
  • Experience working in Tech or SaaS preferred; experience in EdTech is a plus.
  • Experience working on a fully remote or highly distributed team, with comfort operating independently and collaborating asynchronously required.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and levels without relying on formal authority.
  • Proven track record of moving cross-functional work forward where ownership is shared or ambiguous.
  • Strong relationship-building skills, high emotional intelligence, and sound judgment in sensitive situations.
  • Operational mindset with comfort managing details, timelines, and follow-through.
  • Growth-oriented and feedback-seeking; open to trying new approaches and iterating on how you work.
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort managing multiple systems and processes at once.
  • A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset — you notice gaps, ask questions, and take initiative without waiting for explicit direction.
  • Comfortable with HR systems (ideally including Rippling, Lattice, Awardco or similar platforms), AI tools and leveraging data to inform decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Work Environment:

  • This role is remote and only open to candidates currently located in the United States and able to work without sponsorship.
  • The role requires a suitable space that provides a private and quiet workplace.
  • Work hours and schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

Physical Environment:

  • Perform tasks in a home office environment with frequent virtual meetings, communications, and interruptions, requiring effective time management and prioritization.
  • Prolonged sitting with sustained visual focus on digital screens, requiring the ability to interact at a typical working distance.
  • Frequent use of keyboard and mouse, involving repetitive hand movements and fine motor skills for typing, navigating, and handling materials.
  • Occasionally adjust position or move within the workspace to reach, retrieve, or access items, involving bending, twisting, or reaching, and occasionally lifting or carrying items weighing up to 10 pounds.
  • Travel requirements: Less than 5%

At Follett Software, our people come first.
We’re deeply committed to supporting the well-being, growth, and success of every Team Member. That commitment shows up in a thoughtfully designed, comprehensive benefits package that helps you thrive—at work and in life. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Fully remote work, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from anywhere in the continental U.S. (unless otherwise noted)
  • Subsidized healthcare plans, including orthodontic coverage, with HSA option that includes employer matching
  • Company-paid disability and life insurance, with the option to enhance coverage through voluntary plans
  • Robust Paid Time Off, including Flex PTO for salaried roles, paid parental leave, company holidays, and paid volunteer service time
  • Retirement savings with employer match, vesting every pay period
  • Flexible Spending Accounts for healthcare and dependent care
  • Optional supplemental coverages, such as accident, hospital, and critical illness insurance, identity theft and credit monitoring, and legal protection services
  • Meaningful recognition and tangible rewards that celebrate achievements, fuel motivation, and recognize both individual and team success

EEO

Follett Software provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to, among others, individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you are interested in applying for employment and need assistance or an accommodationin the application process due to a disability, please contact us by email and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

jobs.excerpt: Our mission at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success.
jobs.description:
Our mission at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Strategic Consultant to join our team!

The Strategic Consultant owns Greenhouse’s largest and most complex paid strategic enablement engagements via professional services. You will be an integral member of the Customer Success and Professional Services teams, accelerating Greenhouse-led implementations and conducting system audits, strategic advisement, reconfigurations, and change management.

High proficiency with Greenhouse Recruiting is only part of the skillset we're looking for. A successful candidate will be skilled at distilling complex needs into digestible workflows, and feels comfortable inspiring decision makers to action.

Who will love this job

  • An organized multi-tasker - you can handle multiple complex engagements simultaneously and never lose sight of detail and organization in the process
  • A collaborative teammate - you work with both internal and external stakeholders to drive the success of project
  • A strategic thinker - you're an expert in all things Greenhouse and Talent Acquisition best practices and policies, and use your knowledge to advise and provide clear and actionable recommendations
  • A creative builder - you see the gaps in processes and actively work to optimize documentation, resources, people, tools, workflows, etc
  • An advocate - you turn customers from passive users to active champions of our product

What you’ll do

  • Work strategically with our largest and fastest-growing customers to help upgrade their workflows, system configurations, and recruiting strategies
  • Build documentation and playbooks to standardize consulting engagements and processes
  • Strategize and oversee the professional services lifecycle of multiple projects at a time
  • Partner with customers for specific lengths of time to advise, educate, and facilitate changes based on your recommendations
  • Engage in change management and evangelism
  • Conduct account and workflow audits, including detailed recommendations
  • Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require

You should have

  • Extensive Greenhouse knowledge
  • Project management experience
  • 3+ years experience advising on talent-related functions
  • Experience helping to build internal programs and process improvements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; assertive, strategic and thoughtful
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and work well on a team, and adapt to a constantly changing environment with competing priorities
  • Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day and curious about how they could help customers get more out of their recruiting process
  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply!

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linkedhere.

The national pay range for this role is $106,400 - $113,000 Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications. Certain roles may be eligible for additional compensation, including stock option awards, bonuses, and merit increases. Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role.

Greenhouse provides a variety of benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, basic life insurance, mental health resources, financial wellness benefits, and a fully paid parental leave program. For US-based employees, we offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan and company match. U.S. based employees also receive, per calendar year, up to 14 scheduled paid holidays and up to 80 hours of paid sick leave. Non-exempt employees accrue up to 20-25 days of paid vacation time annually, depending on tenure, and exempt employees have flexible paid time off (PTO).

The anticipated closing date for this role is October 9th, 2026.

Who we are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview (Who are we?  Why should you join us?
jobs.description:
Company Overview (Who are we? Why should you join us?)

At ecoATM the proof of our success is in our staggering growth, extraordinary impact on protecting the planet, and providing a work culture unlike any other. We are a technology company and a pioneer of device re-commerce. Through our 7,000 automated kiosks and online marketplace Gazelle.com, we enable people all over the world to join the mobile device re-use revolution, a revolution that will get billions of used smartphones out of the e-waste cycle and into the hands of people who don’t have affordable access to the empowerment of the latest mobile technology.

At ecoATM we know our employees are our greatest strength and the key to our continued growth and success. When you join our team, you will enjoy more than just a job, you will be empowered to develop and utilize your unique talents and skills to build a rewarding career while making a lasting, positive impact on the planet.

Our Values and Leadership Behaviors

About the Role

ecoATM is hiring a Director, Tax reporting to our Chief Accounting Officer (CAO). This roleowns ecoATM's global tax function end to end; tax planning, the quarterly and annual income tax provision under ASC 740, and all U.S. federal, state, local, and non-U.S. compliance. The role is the company's principal internal tax authority and the primary point of contact for external tax advisors, the external auditors, and taxing authorities.

This is a hands-on, build-and-run role. ecoATM co-sources significant compliance and advisory work, such as sales and use tax, property tax, direct tax, and business license registrations, so the Director is accountable for scoping, directing, reviewing, and controlling the cost of third-party providers rather than delegating judgment to them. Emphasis is heaviest on tax planning, the provision, and compliance execution; international and U.S. international tax (GILTI/FDII, Subpart F, Pillar Two monitoring, transfer pricing, and a small non-U.S. footprint) is a required competency but a modest share of the overall workload.

The role partners closely with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, and business leadership on transaction support, entity structure, cash tax planning, and audit readiness, and reports to the Chief Accounting Officer.

This is a visible role. The Director will interact regularly with the CFO, the CEO, and ecoATM's private equity sponsors, and must be able to explain a tax position in plain English to people who are not tax specialists.

Over time, ecoATM expects to bring elements of the tax provision and compliance in house and build a small internal tax team. The Director is expected to assess what should move in house, make the case, and lead that build; the ideal candidate wants to grow a function, not just run an outsourced one.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Planning & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the company's tax planning agenda — effective tax rate management, cash tax optimization, credits and incentives, entity rationalization, and NOL and attribute utilization and preservation (including Section 382 monitoring).
  • Model the tax consequences of business initiatives, capital structure changes, acquisitions, dispositions, restructurings, and financing transactions; present clear, decision-ready recommendations to the CAO and CFO.
  • Identify and drive federal, state, and local planning opportunities, including R&D credits, fixed asset and cost segregation positions, state apportionment and nexus planning, and sales and use tax exposure reduction.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enacted and proposed legislation and assess its impact on the company's rate, cash taxes, and structure.
  • Evaluate and document uncertain tax positions and establish the company's position on material judgments.

Tax Provision (ASC 740)

  • Own the quarterly and annual income tax provision end to end: current and deferred computations, rate reconciliation, return-to-provision true-ups, valuation allowance analysis, FIN 48 / ASC 740-10 reserves, and deferred tax roll-forwards.
  • Prepare or review all tax-related financial statement disclosures and supporting schedules, and coordinate deliverables with the external auditors to a clean, on-time close.
  • Maintain provision models and documentation to an auditable standard, with clear support, review evidence, and version control.
  • Own tax-related SOX controls, narratives, and walkthroughs; remediate deficiencies on schedule.
  • Forecast the effective tax rate and cash taxes in partnership with FP&A and Treasury, including quarterly estimated payment requirements.

Tax Compliance & Third-Party Provider Management

  • Own the complete compliance calendar and ensure timely, accurate filing of all U.S. federal, state, and local income and franchise tax returns, extensions, and estimated payments.
  • Direct third-party providers across sales and use tax, property tax, and direct taxes — scope engagements, set deliverable standards and deadlines, review output critically, and negotiate and control fees.
  • Own business license registrations and renewals with applicable states and localities, including nexus studies, registrations, and exemption certificate management.
  • Oversee non-U.S. filings and statutory tax reporting for the company's foreign entities in coordination with local advisors.
  • Manage federal, state, and local tax audits, notices, and information requests end to end, including strategy, responses, and settlement recommendations.
  • Support 1099, W-9, and other information reporting in partnership with Accounts Payable and Payroll.
  • Maintain the tax basis balance sheet, fixed asset tax depreciation, and supporting workpapers.
  • Retain ownership of all technical conclusions and filing positions; providers deliver scale and specialty depth, not judgment.

International & U.S. International Tax

  • Oversee U.S. international calculations and reporting — GILTI, FDII, BEAT, Subpart F, foreign tax credits, Forms 5471/8858/8975 and related disclosures — with support from external specialists.
  • Maintain intercompany and transfer pricing arrangements, including intercompany agreements, documentation, local files, and periodic benchmarking; coordinate intercompany charges with Accounting.
  • Monitor Pillar Two / global minimum tax developments, permanent establishment risk, withholding tax, and VAT/GST obligations relevant to the company's footprint, and escalate exposures with recommended actions.
  • Support cross-border cash repatriation, funding, and entity structure decisions in partnership with Treasury and Legal.

Process, Systems & Leadership

  • Build and continuously improve tax processes, workpapers, calendars, and documentation so the function is repeatable, controlled, and transferable.
  • Drive automation and data quality across tax data sourcing from Oracle and the data warehouse; reduce manual preparation and shorten provision cycle time.
  • Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, and Procurement, translating tax requirements into practical business guidance.
  • Provide clear, concise reporting to the CAO, CFO, CEO, the Board, and the company's private equity sponsors on tax risk, effective rate, cash taxes, and open matters — translating technical positions into plain English and a clear recommendation.
  • Represent the company's tax position directly in sponsor, board, lender, and diligence discussions, responding to questions on the spot with confidence and without jargon.
  • Assess which elements of the tax provision and compliance currently performed by third parties should be brought in house, build the business case, and lead the transition — including the people, process, systems and documentation required to run them internally.
  • Operate initially as a working individual contributor, then hire, coach and develop a small in-house tax team as scope moves in house; establish cross-training and documented desktop procedures so there are no single points of failure.
  • Support transaction, financing, diligence, and IPO- or exit-readiness workstreams as required.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA and/or Master's in Taxation (MST) highly desirable. JD/LLM in Taxation considered.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive corporate tax experience, including a mix of public accounting (Big 4 or large regional) and in-house corporate tax.
  • Deep, demonstrable ownership of the ASC 740 income tax provision, including deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Strong federal and multistate income tax compliance experience in a multi-entity, multi-state environment.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. international tax concepts (GILTI, Subpart F, FTCs, Forms 5471) and transfer pricing fundamentals, with the judgment to know when to engage a specialist.
  • Proven track record of managing third-party tax providers and advisors to scope, budget, and deadline.
  • Experience with tax planning, compliance, and audit support within a fast-paced, growth-oriented organization.
  • Experience transitioning outsourced tax work in house and building or scaling an internal tax team is a strong plus.
  • Experience operating in a SOX-compliant or audited environment, including tax control design and documentation.
  • Preferred: private-equity-backed or pre-IPO experience; partnership / LLC taxation; Oracle EBS or comparable ERP; tax provision or compliance software (e.g., OneSource, Corptax, Avalara/Vertex); Snowflake, Power BI or Alteryx.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Comprehensive understanding of federal, state, local, and international tax laws, with the ability to interpret complex statutes and apply them in practical, real-world scenarios.
  • Advanced proficiency in tax research and analysis, using authoritative resources to resolve intricate issues and provide strategic recommendations.
  • Expertise in tax software, accounting systems, and data management tools to streamline tax processes and enhance accuracy.
  • Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large ERP data sets; strong analytical and modeling ability.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with proven aptitude for identifying risks and opportunities in filings and planning strategies.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to articulate complex tax positions in plain English to non-tax audiences — the CFO, CEO, the Board, private equity sponsors, auditors, and regulatory authorities — and to state the conclusion and the recommendation up front.
  • Executive presence and credibility in front of senior stakeholders, including comfort being challenged on a position and defending it clearly.
  • Ability to mentor, guide, and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and compliance.
  • High ethical standards and sound judgment in handling confidential financial information and facilitating transparent reporting practices.
  • Ability to use Claude and other AI tools effectively for tax research, analysis, workpapers, and reporting.

Measures of Success (First 12 Months)

  • Quarterly and annual provisions delivered within the close calendar with no material audit adjustments and no significant deficiencies in tax controls.
  • A complete, documented, and current tax compliance calendar with 100% on-time filing and payment across all jurisdictions.
  • A documented, auditable provision and compliance workpaper set that a successor or reviewer can pick up without rework.
  • Third-party provider spend at or below budget, with scope, deliverables, and fees clearly defined and tracked.
  • At least two quantified planning opportunities identified and executed, with measurable rate or cash tax benefit.
  • All open notices, audits, and exposures inventoried, assessed, and either resolved or on a documented plan.
  • A recommendation delivered on which provision and compliance activities should move in house, with cost, resourcing, and a phased transition plan.

Business Travel (How much will you travel?)

  • <10%

Location (Where will you be working?)

  • Remote; must reside in the United States
Pay Range (How much might you earn in your base salary?)
  • $176,700 - $233,200 Annually
This position is eligible for short-term and long-term incentives based on individual and company performance.

Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This information is provided per CA SB 1162 (“CA Pay Transparency Law”). Base pay information is based on market location. Learn more about ecoATM benefits here.

This position may also be eligible for short-term and long-term incentives based on individual and company performance.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

All applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic, and are fairly and equitably compensated based on current market data. People join Tandem because they want to shape something meaningful. At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our patient mix includes a combination of self-referred patients as well as physician-referred, from primary care doctors as well as specialists.

We are looking to expand our team of Radiologists for our rapidly growing practice across North America. Ideally you are a Radiologist with a strong MRI foundation. For Canadian-based Radiologists, a BC License is required.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Job Highlights:

Today, we're looking for an Associate Director, Client Services to join our team. Our new Associate Director will serve as the strategic lead and trusted advisor for a portfolio of some of Silverback's most important client relationships. You'll own client health from end to end: understanding each client's business, connecting marketing performance to real business outcomes, spotting risk before it turns into churn, and finding the next opportunity to grow the partnership.

This isn't a hands-on-keys role. You won't be building campaigns in Google Ads or Meta, but you'll need to understand what those platforms are telling you, and what they're not. You'll work alongside our Paid Media, SEO, Measurement, and Creative teams to turn performance data into a clear story for clients, and you'll partner with delivery teams to make sure every account is both successful for the client and healthy for Silverback. This role is ideal for a seasoned client services leader who thrives on big-picture thinking, loves a good puzzle, and wants a real seat at the table.

Here's what we expect from our Associate Director, Client Services.

—What You'll Do—

    • Client Strategy: Understand each client's business and marketing performance through data analysis, and develop cross-functional marketing strategies that ladder up to their business goals.
    • Performance Analysis: Analyze paid media performance across your portfolio by triangulating data from Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, and client CRMs. When platform-reported conversions don't match pipeline in the CRM, you're the one who figures out why and explains it clearly.
    • Client Care: Build healthy, long-lasting client relationships through active listening and follow-through. Proactively monitor positive and negative client feedback to identify and mitigate churn risk before it affects the relationship.
    • Client Retention & Growth: Own retention and revenue growth for your portfolio. Identify strategic upsell and cross-sell opportunities, partner with our sales team on expansions, and lead the way through crisis moments with steady, solutions-first communication.
    • Delivery Margin Management: Partner with delivery teams to build 3-month rolling plans that balance client performance goals with margin targets. When an account is off track, dig into the root cause and resolve it through process changes, expectation resets, or rescopes.
    • Process Improvement: Regularly surface opportunities to improve how we work, whether that means increasing client value, eliminating waste, or making our people's jobs easier.
    • Client Innovation: Stay on top of changes in the marketing industry, understand how they impact your clients, and help clients navigate and capitalize on that change. Turn client wins into case studies that fuel our marketing.
    • Thought Leadership: Contribute a weekly news insight and point of view to keep our team and clients ahead of the curve.

—What We're Looking For—

    • Years of Experience: 7+ years of client services, account management, or client strategy experience, with at least 4 years at a digital or performance marketing agency. Previous agency experience is a must-have.
    • Paid Media Fluency: You don't need to be a platform expert, but you need to speak the language. You're comfortable with the metrics Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, and CRMs report out, and you know how to triangulate them to find the real story.
    • Deductive Reasoning: When something doesn't add up, you work the problem. You connect the dots across data sources, client conversations, and team input to get to the root cause and the right next step.
    • Communication: Your verbal and written communication is sharp, clear, and confident. You can explain a complex performance story to a CMO in plain English and write an email that gets a stalled decision moving.
    • Self-Awareness: You know your strengths, own your blind spots, and actively seek feedback. You read the room well, both with clients and with your team.
    • Big-Picture Thinking: You see how a single campaign ties to a client's revenue, how one account ties to the health of the portfolio, and how the portfolio ties to Silverback's growth.
    • Intellectual Curiosity: You ask "why" until you get to something useful. You're energized by learning your clients' businesses, industries, and what's changing in marketing.
    • Comfort with Ambiguity: You don't need a perfect playbook to take action. You make sound calls with incomplete information and adjust as things evolve.
    • Resilience: Tough client moments, shifting priorities, and bad news don't knock you off course. You stay steady, solutions-focused, and ready for the next challenge.

—Why Silverback?—

    • Silverback isn't for everybody. If you're an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you're a B player, you will be miserable.
    • Make an impact: We're a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.
    • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.
    • Do cool shit: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

—Benefits & Perks—

    • Unlimited PTO
    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
    • Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture
    • Company-paid ClassPass membership
    • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
    • Summer Fridays
    • 401(k) with Employer Match

—Work Environment—

    • We're a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication.
    • We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality.
    • Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss. Apply today & discover for yourself what makes Silverback Strategies such a special place to work. We can't wait to hear from you!

We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. The Information and Communications Technology Council (ICTC) is seeking a rigorous, analytically strong Economist to support economic research that underpins Canada's digital transformation. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Economic Research, this role will dedicate 50% of its time to executing ICTC's major labour market information (LMI) initiatives. The successful candidate will also contribute to ICTC's national policy, economic outlook, and workforce development work.

The ideal candidate brings solid knowledge of Canada's digital economy, LMI, economic forecasting, and workforce transformation, along with a track record of data-driven analysis and the ability to translate complex economic findings into actionable intelligence for Canadians, businesses, and policymakers.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution

  • In collaboration with internal teams, carry out the methodology for ICTC's labour market outlook reports, conducting longitudinal and cross-sectoral labour market analysis.
  • Support the preparation of quarterly economic briefs that distill current labour trends and digital economy shifts into accessible knowledge for industry leaders.
  • Support the development of LMI dashboards and tools that reflect occupational shifts, emerging technologies, and regional skills demand.
  • Work with partners and stakeholders across provinces and territories to align federal and provincial LMI data and inform evidence-based workforce planning.
  • Help develop and maintain the ICT LMI Hub for Canadian businesses and policymakers.
  • Participate in advisory council activities, co-design sessions, and external events as needed to validate findings and strengthen industry relevance.
  • Collaborate with qualitative and quantitative researchers and policy analysts on integrated, mixed-methods research initiatives.
  • Translate project objectives into research questions, analytical plans, and deliverables, identifying data requirements, dependencies, and methodological risks early.
  • Manage assigned research workstreams, monitor progress against timelines, and communicate emerging findings, limitations, and delivery risks to the project lead.
  • Conduct literature reviews and jurisdictional scans to inform the LMO, assessing Canadian and international evidence on digital economy trends, skills, and workforce policies.
  • Contribute to the design and delivery of the KII’s and longitudinal employer surveys, analyze hiring intentions, skills gaps, and technology adoption, and maintain consistency across survey waves.

Economic Analysis and Expertise

  • Build working knowledge of Canada's digital economy and contribute to publications, conferences, and stakeholder engagements
  • Produce research papers, sector briefs, and data-driven insights on the changing landscape of Canada's ICT labour market.
  • Analyze how automation, AI, cybersecurity, clean tech, digital infrastructure, and other emerging technologies and priority areas shape skills demand across sectors.
  • Examine employment, wages, productivity, and job quality alongside skills demand to provide a fuller picture of digital economy labour market conditions.
  • Contribute to ICTC's forecasting capabilities and economic modelling, including input-output models, integrating new data sources and methodologies.

jobs.description:
About the Role

When a staffing firm or high-volume employer signs with Onboarded, the contract is the starting line. Their compliance work has to run, and run right: I-9 and E-Verify, background checks, state and federal forms, tax credits, union agreements, credentials. Every customer's version is different. We're looking for engineers to embed with our direct customers and build those workflows end to end.

You'll be embedded in two or three strategic customer accounts at a time. You learn how their hiring actually works across states, worker types and systems, then build it on Onboarded: forms as code, policies, automations, and integrations to their ATS, HRIS and payroll. You own the build from first discovery through go-live, and you answer for how fast the customer goes live and whether the work is right. Sales opens the account. Customer Engineering supports it at steady state. You build in the middle.

Onboarded is the API for the workflows that have to be right. We never built I-9 as a feature. We built primitives, and every customer build turns implementation into code we reuse. What you build for one customer becomes a package for the next, and what you learn in the field shapes the roadmap.

We're casting a wide net. Maybe you've been a forward deployed engineer at an AI or data company, a solutions engineer who writes real code, an integration engineer, or a founder. What matters is that you ship production-quality code, you're energized by messy customer problems, and you use AI as a force multiplier.

What You'll Do

  • Embed with strategic customers. Work alongside their HR, operations, legal and IT teams. Map how a worker goes from hired to ready to work across their systems, states and worker types, and find where it breaks.
  • Build compliance workflows as code. Implement each customer's requirements on Onboarded's primitives: forms, policies, entities, automations and integrations. Versioned, reviewed, and deployed across every entity they run.
  • Connect the customer's stack. Integrate Onboarded with their ATS, HRIS, payroll and screening vendors through our REST API, webhooks and MCP surfaces. Own the data model, the auth, and how records stay in sync.
  • Ship to production and own the outcome. Take each workflow from discovery to go-live. Monitor it, fix what breaks, and stand behind it when an auditor asks how it works.
  • Turn every build into something reusable. Every workflow you deliver should make the next one faster. Generalize what you build into packages and tooling the whole team uses, including AI agents that write configuration.
  • Bring the field back to product. Write clear specs for the gaps the core platform should close, prioritize hard, and be the first person to test what ships.

What We're Looking For

  • A builder who ships. 3+ years writing production code in a modern stack (TypeScript, Python or similar), or a track record shipping real systems as a founder. You get productive in an unfamiliar codebase fast.

Experience in staffing, ATS or HRIS software, payroll, or employment compliance (I-9, E-Verify, background checks, tax forms) is a strong signal but not required. Learning velocity and an AI-first approach to closing the gap count just as much.

This role is not a fit for someone who wants a ticket queue, or who wants to write code far from the people who use it. It is for engineers who want to own the outcome and see their work run in the real world.

Why This Role

  • Your code puts people to work. Every workflow you ship decides whether a real person starts their job on time and compliantly. The stakes are real and so is the impact.
  • You'll build next to the people who built the engine. Our CTO and founders own customer accounts too. You'll have a direct line to them, Product and Engineering, and your field work shapes what the platform becomes.
  • There is a clear growth path. As we add strategic accounts, this role can grow into leading a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, moving into core platform engineering, or owning a product area.

  • Remote-first culture with optional in-person collaboration
  • A chance to build the workflows that have to be right, for some of the largest employers and staffing firms in the country

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Principal Structural Engineer - Technical Reviewer to work on very high-level and technically challenging projects to join our team! In this role you will get to lend your bridge technical knowledge on an as-needed basis.


POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Principal Structural Engineer – Technical Reviewer (Casual) will provide independent technical oversight for structural engineering work on highway, transit, freight rail, and passenger rail projects on an as needed basis. With more than 30 years of structural engineering experience, this senior engineer will focus on checking and improving work prepared by junior and mid-level engineers, helping ensure that calculations, plans, specifications, and technical recommendations are accurate, coordinated, constructible, and consistent with applicable standards.

Working with project managers, discipline leads, and design teams, the reviewer will examine structural analyses and design packages at key milestones, identify technical and coordination issues, and provide clear, actionable comments. The position calls for sound judgment across bridges, retaining walls, culverts, foundations, and related transportation structures, along with a practical ability to explain why changes are needed and help engineers strengthen their work. The reviewer will contribute to quality planning, resolve difficult design questions, and support delivery from preliminary engineering through construction.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Principal Structural Engineer will apply deep technical experience to review structural work and build quality into project delivery. Responsibilities include:

  • Independently check structural calculations, analysis models, design assumptions, and engineering judgments prepared by junior and mid-level structural engineers; verify that methods, inputs, results, and conclusions are technically sound.
  • Review bridge, wall, culvert, foundation, and related structure plans, details, specifications, quantities, and cost estimates for accuracy, completeness, internal consistency, and constructability.
  • Evaluate design packages for compliance with AASHTO LRFD, IDOT, Illinois Tollway, and applicable AISC, ACI, and rail requirements; identify departures, unresolved risks, and coordination gaps before submittal.
  • Provide clear review comments, redlines, and documented dispositions; discuss findings with the responsible engineers, confirm corrections, and coach staff on sound analysis, detailing, and quality-control practices.
  • Review structural evaluations, rehabilitation concepts, load ratings, inspection findings, and construction-phase responses, including shop drawings, RFIs, and field issues, with attention to safety and serviceability.

Coordinate reviews with roadway, rail, geotechnical, drainage, traffic, CADD, and construction teams. Attend client meetings and project-site visits as needed to resolve technical questions and support timely delivery.

Supervision Received

- Structural Practice Lead, Project Manager, or designated Technical Manager

Supervision Given

- Technical direction and mentoring for junior and mid-level structural engineers and design staff

Internal Contacts

- Project Managers, Structural Practice Leaders, bridge and rail engineers, roadway and geotechnical teams, CADD staff, quality managers, and construction support teams

External Contacts

  • Active Illinois Structural Engineer (S.E.) license.
  • Extensive experience with steel and concrete transportation structures, including bridge superstructures and substructures, foundations, retaining walls, and culverts.
  • Demonstrated ability to review structural calculations, analysis models, plans, specifications, technical reports, quantities, and cost estimates and to identify technical errors, omissions, and coordination conflicts.
  • Strong working knowledge of AASHTO LRFD, IDOT and Illinois Tollway procedures, and applicable AISC, ACI, and rail standards; proficiency with BlueBeam and bridge analysis/design software is expected.
  • Strong technical writing, communication, and mentoring skills, with the judgment to explain review findings constructively and support resolution of complex structural issues.

  • Quality assurance and quality control

  • Coaching and mentoring engineers

jobs.description:
Decile Group is transforming venture capital into a force for good in the world. We are working to launch 1,000 next-generation venture capital firms, changing the face of venture capital. We run VC Lab, the leading venture capital accelerator worldwide, and operate the Decile Hub platform — reducing the barriers of entry for next-generation investors to launch and grow meaningful early-stage investment firms.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own the full product experience of Decile Hub and build it into a world-class tool. Read more about the Decile Group tech team here:

The ideal candidate is obsessive about user experience — not in a theoretical way, but in the way that makes you fix a broken flow at 11pm because you can't stop thinking about it. You understand how software is actually built. You've worked closely enough with Rails codebases to speak the language of your engineers, and you know how to use AI tools not as a curiosity but as a real lever for speed and quality. You don't need a prestigious resume — but you do need to be a sharp thinker, a clear communicator, and someone who holds the bar high.

Basic requirements:

  • You must live and work within a few time zones of Pacific (California) time. We are on Zoom and Slack a lot.
  • You must be comfortable getting into a Rails app, reading the code, and understanding what's hard and what isn't.
  • You are already using AI tools daily — in your writing, your research, your specs, your thinking. This isn't aspirational for you; it's how you work.
  • You must be able to own a product surface end-to-end and work directly with the people who use it.

If you're the kind of person who gets genuinely bothered by a clunky UX, who has strong opinions about what "good" looks like, and who wants to build something that tens of thousands of venture capitalists will rely on to run their firms — then you're who we're looking for.

And we want to work with you too.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product experience, end to end. You are accountable for how Decile Hub looks, feels, and works — from the first login of a new fund manager to the most complex fund administration workflow. Every interaction is your responsibility.
  • Set and drive the roadmap. Translate user needs, operational realities, and Decile Group's business priorities into a clear, sequenced roadmap. Make the hard calls on what gets built and what doesn't. Maintain alignment across Decile Group's engineering, operations, and leadership teams.
  • Write specs that engineers love. Crisp, specific, with edge cases handled and acceptance criteria defined. You remove ambiguity before it becomes a bug. You respect engineering time.
  • Use AI to move faster and think sharper. Leverage AI in discovery, synthesis, spec writing, competitive research, and anywhere else it makes you better. Be a model for AI-first product thinking across Decile Group.
  • Stay close to customers. Run user interviews. Shadow onboarding calls. Read every support ticket. Synthesize what you learn into clear problem definitions and close the loop after features ship to make sure they actually worked.
  • Raise the bar on design and UX. Be the person at Decile Group who is never satisfied with "good enough." Push for clarity, simplicity, and delight in every flow — especially in the dense, complex workflows that define fund administration.
  • Lead cross-functional execution. Bring structure to product workflows across Decile Group. Rally engineering, ops, legal ops, and customer success around shared priorities. Keep launches on track and documentation tight.

What You Bring

  • 6–10+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping high-quality, complex SaaS products
  • Genuine technical fluency — you've worked closely with Rails or comparable web frameworks and can hold your own in an engineering conversation
  • An active, sophisticated AI workflow — you use AI tools to do your job better, every day
  • Exceptional written clarity — your specs, emails, and Slack messages are models of structured thinking
  • Deep UX sensibility — you've built beautiful, functional tools for operational, financial, or workflow-heavy domains and you know the difference between a flow that works and one that sings
  • Strong prioritization instincts and the discipline to say no to good ideas in service of great ones
  • Comfort in fast-moving, high-ambiguity environments — and the ability to create structure where there isn't any

Nice to Have

  • Experience with fund administration, venture capital tooling, or compliance workflows
  • Background in operations, legal ops, or workflow automation
  • Experience analyzing user behavior and creating practical user segments (e.g., new users, advanced users, high-touch accounts) to inform onboarding, feature design, or support processes

How to Apply:

If you don't tick every box above, we'd still encourage you to apply. We're building a diverse team whose skills balance and complement one another.
Please describe why you are uniquely qualified for this position in the competitive field of Venture Capital to apply, as well as submitting your resume.
Salary and benefits are commensurate with experience.

jobs.description:
Impinj delivers the Physical Intelligence that connects the physical world to the AI-powered digital world, fueling automated workflows and improving consumer experiences. From retail merchandise and groceries to packages and shipping pallets, Impinj products and solutions identify and track tens of billions of everyday items, providing real-time operational insights about every item enterprises make, move and sell. We are, quite literally, the eyes and ears of smart enterprise systems. Come help us build technology and solutions that enable businesses to visualize everything, waste nothing and act instantly.

Team Overview:

The Layout Design Engineering group is an integral part of the Silicon Engineering department, working closely with the analog RFID end-point IC development team and the Reader IC team, internationally. The team is responsible for delivering tape-outs for RFID products, test chips, reader ICs, and DOEs (design of experiments) work that sits at the center of how Impinj brings new silicon to market.

Layout decisions made by this team directly influence the power efficiency, cost, and time-to-market of every piece of silicon we ship, making the group's work foundational to Impinj's mission. The team operates with a continuous-improvement mindset, adapting quickly and challenging each other to remain best-in-class in both quality and speed, with meticulous attention to detail to ensure designs have long-term reliability and zero defects, at production volumes in the many billions and eventually trillions of tags per year.

What You Will Do:

  • Perform detailed transistor-level layout of RF, mixed-signal, and analog circuit blocks for both high-performance RF as well as ultra-low power and compact RFID
  • Work closely with the analog and digital design teams on floor planning, pin placement, power supply strategy and signal distribution between blocks
  • Conduct layout reviews for power/ground routing, electromigration, matching, and signal coupling
  • Participate in schedule meetings coordinating layout and floorplan activities

What You Will Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer or electrical engineering and 8+ years of experience
  • Experience in custom analog, RF, and mixed-signal layout
  • Ability to collaborate with other layout engineers on the top-level IC floorplan, partnering with circuit designers to resolve complex problems
  • Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and foundry technologies across advanced process nodes down to 16nm for ultra-low-power and high-fidelity applications
  • Knowledge of analog layout challenges and layout-dependent effects in advanced processes — noise coupling, matching, parasitics, LOD, WPE, PSE, and coloring — along with proficiency in mitigation techniques such as guard rings, DNW, PN junctions, parasitic management, signal integrity, reliability (EMIR), and ESD
  • Proficiency with the use of Cadence Virtuoso layout editor and Cadence/Siemens layout verification tools (including PVS and Siemens Calibre DRC/LVS). Ability to interpret and correct ERC, DRC and LVS error reports
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong technical project management skills

The benefits listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Impinj and the country where you work.

Both market wage data and the mid-point of the pay range is reviewed and used as the starting point for all new hire offers. Offers are made within the base pay range applicable at the time.

At Impinj certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, annual bonus and stock. These awards are allocated based on individual performance. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role. US based employees have access to healthcare benefits; a 401(k) plan and company match among others.

We may require additional documentation related to national identity to determine whether an export compliance license is required for any export-controlled items. This information is requested solely for the purpose of complying with U.S. export control laws and will not be used for other purposes. Learn more about export compliance here.

Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    HighLevel is looking for a Sr. SDET with 5+ years of experience to play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, performance, and scalability of our products. We are seeking engineers who thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoy problem-solving, and stay updated with the latest models and solutions. This is a great opportunity to work on cutting-edge performance testing strategies and contribute to the success of our products.

Responsibilities:

  • Performance baselines for critical services: SLIs, SLOs, and latency, throughput, and error-rate targets, plus workload models built from production traffic and real customer behaviour
  • A shared performance testing framework and production-like environments (Kubernetes and cloud, test data included) that product-team SDETs can use without starting from scratch, and the evaluation of new tools through PoCs
  • Automated performance regression checks in CI/CD, with trend reports that catch regressions before release
  • Load, stress, soak, and spike testing, and capacity planning ahead of peak events
  • Root cause analysis of bottlenecks across API, database, queue, and frontend layers, using traces, metrics, logs, and profiling, in partnership with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, concurrency, rate limiting and common performance bottlenecks
  • Ability to interpret performance metrics, translate findings into actionable engineering recommendations, and influence technical decisions across engineering teams
  • Supervise and mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building initiatives to raise the performance bar across the team

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in performance, scalability, or reliability engineering or testing, with examples of finding and fixing bottlenecks in production-scale systems
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern load-testing tool (k6, Gatling, or Locust), including realistic workload modeling and distributed load generation, and strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java
  • Experience using observability tooling (for example New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to isolate root cause across API, database, and queue layers, with a solid grasp of REST service performance, concurrency, and caching
  • Experience integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with pass/fail thresholds
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure) to deploy and debug test environments

Nice to Have:

  • Runtime profiling and thread or heap analysis on the JVM or Node.js (GC behavior, event-loop lag)
  • Frontend performance experience: Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, real user monitoring
  • Experience applying AI-assisted tooling to test design or result analysis
  • Experience with NoSQL or search datastores and message brokers at scale
  • Chaos or resilience testing, and safe testing in production (canaries, shadow traffic)
