  • Seniority: Senior
  • English Level: B2 / C1
  • Engagement: Full-time

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company building a next-generation Identity Security and Identity Observability platform.

The product helps enterprise security teams understand how human users, service accounts, workloads, applications, and AI-driven identities access systems across cloud, SaaS, network, endpoint, and on-premise environments.

At the core of the platform is a highly data-intensive architecture that collects and analyzes large volumes of events, logs, network telemetry, identity activity, and security signals. This information is processed to identify unusual access patterns, security risks, identity blind spots, infrastructure misconfigurations, and potential threats.

The platform integrates with complex enterprise ecosystems including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, SIEMs, endpoint security tools, network infrastructure, and security services.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer focused on Data Ingestion, Integrations, and Collectors to become a key technical bridge between enterprise customers and the engineering organization.

This is not a traditional backend or internal data engineering position.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their infrastructure, data sources, security architecture, network topology, APIs, and workflows, then design and implement scalable mechanisms to ingest that information into the platform.

You'll combine data engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and technical consulting.

A major part of your mission will be building and evolving connectors and ingestion pipelines capable of integrating data from complex enterprise environments while maintaining reliability, scalability, security, and fast time-to-production.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain production-grade data collectors, connectors, and ingestion services.
  • Integrate enterprise data sources including identity providers, cloud platforms, SASE solutions, network infrastructure, endpoints, applications, security platforms, and SIEM systems.
  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their environments, data flows, APIs, security requirements, and integration constraints.
  • Participate in technical onboarding processes, from initial discovery and architecture design through production deployment.
  • Design scalable ingestion architectures for processing security events, logs, identity activity, network telemetry, and other high-volume data sources.
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, cloud-native services, event-driven architectures, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Develop backend services primarily using Python and/or Go.
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, transform, query, and analyze high-volume data.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Deploy and integrate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex customer deployment and integration issues across application, infrastructure, networking, API, and data layers.
  • Optimize ingestion performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor around customer data architecture, collection strategies, security integrations, and implementation best practices.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements and transform them into reusable connectors, platform capabilities, or improvements to the core product.
  • Contribute technical insights from real-world implementations to the product roadmap.
  • Support production adoption and continuously improve time-to-value for enterprise customers.
  • Participate in occasional customer-facing technical sessions and, when necessary, onsite engagements.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of professional Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related experience.
  • Strong software development experience with:
    • Python
    • Go
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
  • Hands-on experience building data ingestion pipelines, connector frameworks, integration platforms, or similar systems.
  • Experience integrating complex enterprise systems and third-party platforms.
  • Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable, and production-ready distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, infrastructure, networking, application services, and data pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or technical partners.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in customer-facing technical conversations.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership when solving ambiguous technical problems.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following will be especially valuable:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Identity Providers (IdPs)
  • Identity Security
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Security telemetry
  • Network security
  • Endpoint security
  • SASE / Zero Trust environments
  • Cloud security
  • Large-scale event processing
  • Streaming architectures

Integration Experience

Previous experience integrating APIs or data from platforms such as the following is highly valuable:

  • AWS
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Okta
  • Google Workspace
  • Duo
  • CrowdStrike
  • Zscaler
  • Palo Alto
  • Microsoft Defender
  • SIEM and security analytics platforms

Direct experience with every platform is not required. What matters is a strong track record of learning complex APIs and transforming heterogeneous enterprise data sources into reliable integrations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale data processing or streaming platforms.
  • Experience designing reusable connector SDKs or integration frameworks.
  • Understanding of identity-related security concepts such as authentication, authorization, credentials, service accounts, privileged access, and non-human identities.
  • Experience with security events, audit logs, network telemetry, or cloud activity data.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and distributed system architectures.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML-enabled applications.
  • Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered security applications.
  • Solution Architecture or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
  • Previous experience in cybersecurity startups or high-growth SaaS environments.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Deliver successful enterprise integrations and deployments.
  • Reduce customer time-to-production.
  • Build reliable and scalable ingestion solutions.
  • Improve customer adoption and technical satisfaction.
  • Resolve complex integration challenges efficiently.
  • Turn customer-specific requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute improvements that strengthen the scalability and flexibility of the core product.

What Darwoft Offers

jobs.excerpt: OverviewWe are designing the grid of the future! jobs.description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

The Protection & Controls Engineering Manager will provide technical leadership for protection and control engineering across EPC and private-client projects, including substations, generation facilities, BESS, data centers, industrial facilities and other large-load interconnections.

The role will lead the development and review of P&C designs from conceptual engineering through detailed design, construction and commissioning. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, EPC contractors, equipment vendors, clients and interconnecting utilities to deliver practical, constructible and reliable protection and control solutions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in protection and control design, protective relaying, substation engineering and system studies, with the ability to lead technical execution and mentor a growing P&C team in a fast-paced consulting and EPC environment.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Lead P&C engineering and design for EPC and private-client projects, including substations, data centers, generation, BESS and other large-load facilities.
  • Develop and review P&C drawing packages, including one-lines, three-lines, AC/DC schematics, relay logic, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams and panel drawings.
  • Develop and review protection philosophies and schemes for transformers, buses, feeders, transmission lines, capacitor/reactor banks, generators and other electrical equipment.
  • Develop and review protective relay settings and coordination, including overcurrent, differential, distance, breaker-failure and communications-assisted protection.
  • Perform and review short-circuit, equipment-duty and protection coordination studies required to support the design.
  • Coordinate P&C design with substation physical, electrical studies, SCADA/communications, metering, civil/structural and other engineering disciplines.
  • Lead technical coordination with EPC contractors, equipment vendors, clients and interconnecting utilities to resolve interfaces and design requirements.
  • Ensure P&C designs meet applicable client requirements, utility requirements and industry standards, including relevant IEEE, ANSI and NERC requirements where applicable.
  • Review vendor drawings and equipment documentation for relays, control panels, switchgear, transformers and other protection-related equipment.
  • Support projects through construction, testing, commissioning and energization, including resolution of field issues and review of testing documentation.
  • Provide technical QA/QC and senior-level review of P&C engineering deliverables.
  • Develop and maintain P&C engineering standards, design practices, templates and calculation methodologies to support consistent project execution.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring and supervision to P&C engineers and designers and help build the department's P&C capability.
  • Support proposal development and project planning, including scopes of work, engineering estimates, schedules and identification of technical risks.
  • Work directly with clients to understand project requirements and develop practical, constructible and cost-effective engineering solutions.
  • Support business development by providing P&C expertise during client discussions, proposal development and project scoping.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering quality and efficiency through standardization, automation and responsible use of AI tools.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
  • Licensed Professional Engineer
  • 10+ years of experience in protection and control engineering, preferably including consulting, EPC or detailed design environments.
  • Strong technical background in substation P&C design and protective relaying for MV and HV systems.
  • Experience with industry-standard protection tools and relay software such as ASPEN, CAPE, ETAP, Powerbase, SEL Quickset, and GE Enervista.
  • Experience developing and reviewing complete P&C design packages from conceptual design through IFC.
  • Strong knowledge of protective relay applications, settings and coordination.
  • Experience coordinating P&C design across multidisciplinary EPC projects.
  • Experience with data centers, BESS, generation or other large-load/industrial facilities is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with inverter-based power plants is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting construction, testing and commissioning is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor and develop engineers and designers.
  • Strong client-facing communication, technical leadership and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Familiarity with applicable IEEE, ANSI, NERC and utility P&C requirements.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and innovation.

Lead the Change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

You respect the craft and the people who practice it, and you know how to bring an experienced team along through change without lowering the standard. You will lead a team that is entering a period of active change: new AI tools, a redesigned intake process and workflow, and a shift from a transactional, ticket-taking function to one that’s proactive, data-driven, and focused on impact. The work is already reliable and high-quality. You will help the team deliver the same quality faster and at greater scale, as content volume across the organization keeps growing. You will build a modern editorial function with flexible systems, structure, and culture, and bring the team into the process earlier, so less rework happens downstream. Beyond the team, you will own editorial standards and strategy for College Board as a whole, defining the risk tiers, technology, and quality measures the rest of the organization will use. You will set the bar not just for this team, but for what “good” means everywhere editorial work happens. You will partner with leaders in every division, join the Communications Leadership Team as the voice of editorial, and help ensure students and educators can trust what we publish.

In this role, you will:

Design and Scale Editorial Operations (40%)

  • Own the workflow end to end (intake, triage, tiering, assignment, approval gate) so that quality holds and throughput scales as volume grows
  • Lead the organization’s AI integration strategy for editorial work, choosing, configuring, and continually improving tools that support better editing and streamline the process and administrative work around it without compromising the editorial bar
  • Build and maintain intake and reporting processes across ticketing/queue tools (Jira, Smartsheet, or equivalent) that make bottlenecks visible before they become backlogs
  • Establish service tiers and coverage frameworks that match editorial rigor to what each piece actually needs, rather than treating every request the same
  • Own capacity planning, including the balance of human and AI-assisted effort: know when the team needs more people, more tooling, or a process fix to get more out of what it has

Lead and Manage the Editorial Strategy & Operations Team (25%)

  • Lead a team of 8 to 10 experienced editors, supported by contract and freelance colleagues, who safeguard the voice, accuracy, and credibility of everything College Board publishes
  • Guide the team through a significant shift in how it works by building trust, earning buy-in, and staying visibly committed to the new direction, while honoring the craft and experience the team brings
  • Cultivate an inclusive and high-achieving culture rooted in craftsmanship, curiosity, and a shared connection to our mission, one that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles
  • Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work
  • Hire, coach, and develop editorial staff, and run calibration sessions that keep standards aligned across full-time and freelance editors, so quality doesn’t vary by who happens to pick up the ticket
  • Manage the backup/coverage plan for approvals so no single person’s absence slows the queue
  • Build the team’s fluency with AI-assisted editing deliberately, so adoption drives real efficiency gains rather than becoming another manual step
  • Manage a blended model of full-time, contract, and freelance editors, deploying each where it adds the most value as work comes in waves

Set and Uphold Editorial Standards (10%)

  • Own enterprise editorial standards and style guidelines, setting the bar not just for the team but for how editorial quality is defined and measured across College Board
  • Establish KPIs for editorial quality and process management, and extend them as the enterprise standard for any team performing editorial work
  • Decide how AI tools get configured against the style guide and evaluate whether that configuration is actually holding up, partnering with the style guide owner rather than owning it directly
  • Ensure consistent voice, tone, accessibility, and clarity across programs and platforms

Turn Data into Editorial Strategy (10%)

  • Turn workflow and quality data into insight leadership can act on, surfacing where the team is excelling and where attention might be needed
  • Identify systemic risk, patterns, and improvement opportunities before they show up as escalations
  • Inform resourcing and scope decisions with data instead of instinct

Partner Upstream to Reduce Rework (15%)

  • Build relationships with high-volume stakeholder teams to raise the quality of what arrives in the queue, so less editorial effort gets spent fixing avoidable problems
  • Optimize the end-to-end copyediting cycle across divisions, identifying how editing projects should be handled based on risk and complexity
  • Use workflow and volume data to spot upstream opportunities for change, the kind of thing that turns a recurring fire drill (like a high-stakes RFP with a two-day turnaround) into a standard, repeatable process instead of a scramble every time
  • Run training and consultation engagements that help partner teams submit work that’s faster to turn around
  • Advocate for sustainable workload and realistic timelines that protect both quality and speed

What Success Looks Like

By the end of the first 12 months, a successful Senior Director, Editorial Strategy and Operations will have:

  • Executed against the workflow and metrics roadmap, turning the plan into a workflow the team uses day to day and reporting that gives real visibility into volume, turnaround, and quality
  • Continued pushing where AI and automation can improve the team’s own work, while also expanding the tool upstream so other teams get self-service, democratized access to editing support before content reaches the queue
  • Built a team culture rooted in experimentation and data, where trying something new and measuring the result is the norm, not the exception
  • Defined roles, tiers, and a coverage plan so the team knows what it owns and quality doesn’t hinge on any one person being in the room
  • Built at least one meaningful upstream relationship with a high-volume stakeholder team, turning a recurring scramble into a repeatable process
  • Aligned other teams with editorial responsibilities across College Board on a common set of KPIs, outcome metrics, and a shared risk-tiering framework
  • Made the editorial function visible and legible across the organization, clarifying what it offers, how to partner with it effectively, and where its judgment matters most

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 10+ years of experience in copy editing, editorial standards, or content governance, applying rigorous quality standards to high-volume, high-visibility content in complex organizations
  • Proven experience managing a team of editors or content quality professionals
  • Comfort leading a tenured team through a significant change in how it works: leading by example, bringing people along rather than mandating change, and holding the line on standards when it’s tempting not to
  • A track record of building systems, not just running them: intake design, SLAs, reporting frameworks, and workflow redesign
  • Experience integrating AI, automation, or another form of process innovation into editorial or content workflows, and genuine enthusiasm for using technology to improve how the work gets done
  • Strong data fluency and the ability to translate workflow and quality metrics into strategy
  • Experience managing a blended team of FTEs and contractors, with real judgment about when to flex capacity versus make a permanent hire
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence stakeholders without formal authority, including the confidence to push back on senior leaders about timelines, formats, and scope
  • A strategic and inclusive leadership style:you set clear priorities, build effective team structures, plan for future needs, and foster a culture of belonging
  • A proven ability to drive performance and growth:you set high expectations, deliver real-time, evidence-based feedback, and coach team members to take smart risks, stretch their skills, and achieve meaningful impact

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resumé and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $104,000 - $155,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.description:
At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people dedicated to our customers' success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide how we do business.

The Mission Enablement Center (MDEC) is seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to support its Cloud Engineering team. This hands-on position supports the design, deployment, automation, security, and sustainment of cloud and hybrid infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).


The selected candidate will support multiple federal and Department of Defense (DoD) programs, including MDEC's InSight Mission Cloud offering, by developing secure, scalable, and repeatable cloud solutions. The role requires a strong technical background in cloud engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, automation, containerization, and cloud operations.


The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can work independently, manage multiple technical priorities, troubleshoot complex issues, collaborate with customers and vendors, and mentor junior engineers while supporting mission-critical environments.



Primary Responsibilities

  • Cloud Engineering: Design, deploy, configure, and sustain secure cloud and hybrid infrastructure across AWS, Azure, OCI, and GCP, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and supporting platform services.
  • DevOps and Automation: Develop, implement, and maintain Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar tools to support automated infrastructure and application deployments.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Develop and maintain reusable Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, and other automation solutions to standardize cloud deployments, configuration management, and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Containerization: Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain containerized applications and orchestration platforms, including Docker, Kubernetes, and related cloud-native technologies.
  • Cloud Security and Compliance: Implement secure cloud configurations, access controls, encryption, vulnerability remediation, and automated security scanning aligned with NIST, FedRAMP, DoD STIGs, and applicable federal security requirements.
  • Cloud Operations and Sustainment: Support day-to-day cloud operations, infrastructure maintenance, patching, performance monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis to maintain reliable and secure environments.
  • Cloud Modernization: Support cloud migrations, landing zone deployments, application modernization, virtualization, and hybrid cloud integration across customer environments.
  • Monitoring and Logging: Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using cloud-native services and enterprise tools such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.
  • Technical Documentation: Develop architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, automation scripts, operational runbooks, and technical documentation to support repeatable engineering and operational sustainment.
  • Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, participate in engineering reviews, support troubleshooting efforts, and contribute to continuous improvement of cloud engineering standards and practices.

Required Experience, Skills, and Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with 12++ years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 10+ years of experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, administering, and supporting cloud infrastructure in AWS, Azure, OCI, or GCP, with strong proficiency in at least two major cloud platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Experience deploying and managing containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent container orchestration platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, including Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), virtual networks, subnets, routing, firewalls, load balancers, VPNs, and network security controls.
  • Experience supporting Linux and Windows Server environments, including system administration, patching, troubleshooting, and secure configuration.
  • Proficiency with scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages.
  • Knowledge of cloud security, identity and access management, vulnerability management, encryption, logging, monitoring, and secure infrastructure design.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex cloud infrastructure, networking, application, and platform issues in production environments.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work directly with customers, technical teams, vendors, and program leadership.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, support multiple programs, and provide technical guidance to junior engineers.

Clearance Required

  • Active DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance, or an active Top Secret clearance with the ability to obtain SCI eligibility prior to the start date.
  • Ability to complete any additional investigations or security requirements associated with assigned programs.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Certifications

  • Experience supporting DoD, or other federal government cloud environments.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, OCI Government, or other regulated cloud environments supporting DoD Impact Levels (IL4, IL5, or IL6).
  • Experience supporting enterprise cloud platforms, shared services, multi-cloud environments, or managed cloud offerings.
  • Experience with cloud landing zones, cloud migration, infrastructure modernization, and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Familiarity with the Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authority to Operate (ATO) processes, NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and DISA STIG requirements.
  • Experience with cloud security tools such as Tenable, Prisma Cloud, Wiz, AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, AWS Config, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience supporting technical solution development, cloud architecture reviews, Bills of Materials (BOMs), Rough Orders of Magnitude (ROMs), or proposal activities.
  • Experience conducting technical briefings, design reviews, and customer-facing engineering discussions.
  • CompTIA Security+ or higher applicable IAT Level II certification.
  • AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Terraform, or Kubernetes professional certifications preferred.

We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

jobs.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

We are hiring a Director, CX/VOC Strategy to build ABC’s first centralized Voice of Client program.


This is an individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Client Experience. You will design the program architecture, define the client signal strategy, evaluate tool and system options, build the operating rhythm, and ensure client insights become clear decisions, accountable owners, and measurable improvements.


This role is ideal for a senior CX strategy leader who has built VoC programs before, thrives in ambiguity, communicates credibly with executives, and can drive cross-functional change without relying on formal authority. Over time, this role may evolve into people leadership as the program and team scale.

What you'll do

• Build ABC’s centralized Voice of Client program from the ground up, including the strategy, operating model, governance, roadmap, and success measures.

• Define how client feedback is collected, structured, connected, analyzed, and activated across multiple signal sources, including surveys, support interactions, client success notes, product usage, reviews, sales feedback, interviews, retention signals, and operational data.

• Evaluate VoC, CX analytics, text analytics, client intelligence, workflow, and reporting tools; define system requirements; recommend scalable architecture; and lead tool/system selection with key stakeholders.

• Create the insights layer that turns fragmented client feedback into trusted, decision-ready recommendations for Product/Engineering, Client Experience, Support, Client Success, Marketing, Operations, and senior leadership.

• Establish governance forums, ownership models, dashboards, escalation paths, and closed-loop processes that make client feedback part of how ABC makes decisions.

• Own and drive high-impact Client Experience optimization workstreams from problem definition through recommendation, execution, measurement, and follow-through.

• Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to prioritize opportunities, resolve tradeoffs, and connect client insights to business outcomes.

• Coach and influence other team members through strong operating discipline, clear communication, and high standards for follow-through.


What you'll need

• 12+ years of experience in Client Experience, Voice of Client / Voice of Customer, client insights, strategy, operations, or a related discipline, including significant experience building or redesigning VoC programs.

• Demonstrated experience designing VoC program architecture, not only operating an existing program.

• Strong fluency with omnichannel client signal design, including how to connect qualitative and quantitative feedback into a trusted insight system.

• Ability to evaluate tools, systems, data flows, reporting needs, and operating processes to recommend scalable VoC architecture.

• Executive-ready communication skills, with the ability to translate complex client signals into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and action plans.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives with minimal oversight and without formal authority.

• Strong operational mindset, high accountability, and a high say/do ratio.

• Ability to use data to define priorities, make decisions, measure impact, and improve how teams operate.

• Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, including knowing when to escalate, challenge, simplify, or make a decision.

• Experience using AI-assisted analysis, text analytics, or summarization tools to identify client themes, validate patterns, and improve insight quality.

• Experience building closed-loop feedback systems that connect insights to product, service, operational, or retention improvements.

• Experience in SaaS, payments, fitness technology, member experience, or multi-product platform environments.

• Experience coaching or informally leading team members, with interest in future people leadership as the program scales.


What success looks like

• ABC has a clear, centralized Voice of Client strategy, roadmap, and operating model.

• Client feedback is connected across channels and transformed into trusted, actionable insights.

• Senior leaders and cross-functional teams use VoC insights to make better decisions.

• Client Experience optimization workstreams have clear owners, timelines, measures, and follow-through.

• ABC has a scalable foundation for future VoC tooling, reporting, governance, and team growth.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (candidates must be located in MST or PST Time Zone)

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As Frontline’s IT & Security Lead, you will own IT and cybersecurity for our fully remote workforce. You will run day-to-day IT operations, administer our systems and SaaS tools, manage the full hardware lifecycle, and lead the company’s security program, keeping our team productive and our data protected as we scale. You will report to the VP of Business Operations.

This is a founding IT role. You will be the first dedicated IT professional at Frontline, with significant latitude to build processes, select tools, and establish the security posture of a rapidly growing company. It is a high-ownership individual contributor role: you will set direction and do the work yourself, from resolving a laptop issue in the morning to presenting a security roadmap to leadership in the afternoon. The right person treats security as a core operating discipline, not a compliance checkbox, and sees building something from the ground up as an opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

IT Operations & Strategy

  • Own IT operations across the organization and serve as the central point of contact for all IT-related needs.
  • Build and scale IT processes, documentation, and SOPs that keep pace with company growth.
  • Own company-wide SaaS governance, keeping user counts, licenses, and access levels accurate across all platforms as headcount grows.
  • Drive cost optimization by identifying redundant tools, right-sizing licenses, and proactively negotiating with vendors.
  • Select and manage external IT vendors and service providers, including SLAs, renewals, and performance.
  • Give leadership hardware forecasts, budget insights, and operational reporting.
  • Recommend and implement tools and process improvements that make teams across the company more productive and secure.

Security & Compliance

  • Own and evolve the company’s security posture end to end, including risk assessments and remediation planning.
  • Lead the company’s SOC 2 readiness and certification efforts.
  • Establish and enforce a security policy framework, including acceptable use, BYOD, access control, and data classification.
  • Manage identity and access management (IAM) across all platforms, including SSO, MFA, password management, and timely deprovisioning of departing employees.
  • Develop and maintain an incident response plan, and lead response and root cause analysis when issues occur.
  • Lead security audits and vulnerability assessments, and maintain compliance documentation.
  • Evaluate and implement security tooling (e.g., EDR, SIEM, DLP) appropriate for the company’s size and risk profile, and partner with an external managed security provider if needed for monitoring and response.
  • Own endpoint protection and device compliance, and run phishing prevention and security awareness training.

SaaS, Identity & Collaboration Tools

  • Administer Google Workspace, Slack, and other collaboration platforms.
  • Secure employee access to company systems through identity-based controls, such as SSO, MFA, and device compliance policies
  • Manage SaaS user permissions and integrations between business tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Slack, and HR systems.)
  • Monitor endpoint and SaaS health and proactively identify and resolve potential issues.
  • Own and modernize the company intranet as a central hub for company information, partnering with departments to keep content current and useful.
  • Partner with the Product and Engineering team, which owns Frontline’s product cloud platform and controller connectivity, on shared access and security policies.

IT Support & Employee Experience

  • Provide responsive, friendly technical support to employees across a fully remote environment, on both Mac and PC.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, video conferencing, and access issues.
  • Own the ticketing system and make sure requests are resolved promptly.
  • Build a self-service knowledge base for common issues.
  • Own IT onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management, device setup, and secure decommissioning.

Hardware & Asset Lifecycle Management

  • Own the full hardware lifecycle: procure, configure, and deploy laptops, mobile phones, and other equipment.
  • Manage devices remotely through mobile device management (MDM) tools, including zero-touch provisioning where possible.
  • Maintain accurate device inventory and asset tracking.
  • Govern third-party asset recovery partners, including retrieval, storage, data wiping, and redeployment.
  • Plan hardware forecasting and refresh cycles.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in IT operations, systems administration, and/or IT security, including experience as the primary owner of IT at a small or mid-sized organization.
  • Experience supporting a fully remote workforce.
  • Hands-on administration of SaaS and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace, and Slack.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows and macOS environments.
  • Experience with MDM tools (e.g., Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or Google endpoint management) for remote device provisioning and compliance.
  • Hands-on experience with identity and access management, MFA, endpoint protection, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Experience with cybersecurity frameworks such as SOC 2, NIST CSF, or ISO 27001, and with conducting or supporting security audits and risk assessments.
  • Experience managing IT vendors and budgets.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and excellent documentation habits.
  • Excellent communication skills: approachable, patient, and able to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues and leadership.
  • A proactive, curious mindset, staying current on new tools and taking initiative to improve how teams work.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience building an IT function or security program from scratch at a startup or scaling company.
  • Experience leading SOC 2 readiness or a SOC 2 Type II audit.
  • Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing security tooling (EDR, SIEM, DLP) and working with managed security service providers.
  • Knowledge of network security and VPN configuration and experience with Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Experience building or managing an internal knowledge base.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop

You will contribute to the development of an internal cloud platform that simplifies and standardizes how applications are built, deployed, and operated across the enterprise. You will collaborate closely with platform engineers, application teams, and enterprise stakeholders to deliver foundational capabilities in a complex, data-intensive, and distributed cloud environment. In this role, you will contribute not only to execution but also to shaping platform standards, improving automation, and enabling long-term scalability, reliability, and operational excellence across AWS environments.

We are looking for individuals who enjoy solving complex infrastructure and platform challenges, are comfortable working hands-on with cloud-native technologies, and are passionate about building reusable, self-service capabilities. You should be eager to dive deep into technical details, improve system internals, and enable teams to deliver faster with greater consistency and quality.

As a Senior AWS Cloud Platform Engineer, Enterprise Development, you will

  • Own the platform engineering strategy, roadmap, and delivery outcomes, enabling scalable, self-service infrastructure and developer productivity across the organization
  • Drive adoption of platform capabilities including CI/CD templates, reusable modules, golden paths, and standardized environments across engineering teams
  • Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation) with reusable, versioned modules to ensure consistency, compliance, and scalability
  • Architect and manage multi-account AWS environments with strong governance, security guardrails, and automated onboarding for application teams
  • Enable self-service provisioning of infrastructure, pipelines, and services through developer portals and APIs (e.g., Backstage or similar platforms)
  • Implement centralized observability (logs, metrics, traces) with integrated tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Open Telemetry) to support operational excellence
  • Define and enforce platform standards for security, compliance, cost optimization, and reliability
  • Partner with application engineering teams to onboard them onto the platform, ensuring seamless adoption and high developer experience
  • Act as the primary SME for cloud-native patterns including microservices, event-driven architectures, serverless, and container platforms (EKS/ECS)
  • Lead platform reliability initiatives including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and resilience engineering practices
  • Proactively manage system-wide risks, platform dependencies, and trade-offs between flexibility and standardization
  • Collaborate with architects to define scalable data and integration patterns aligned with enterprise architecture
  • Mentor platform engineers and DevOps teams, building strong expertise in automation, cloud architecture, and platform design
  • Establish KPIs for platform adoption, developer productivity, deployment efficiency, and operational maturity
  • Serve as the strategic bridge between infrastructure, security, and application teams to drive platform-first engineering culture

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or Business/Technology Management, or relevant experience
  • Extensive experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure roles, with strong focus on building internal platforms at scale
  • Deep expertise in AWS services including compute (EC2, Lambda), containers (EKS/ECS), storage (S3), networking (VPC), Events(SQS, SNS, Event Bridge)
  • Ability to design a medium to large scale system in AWS
  • Familiarity with building APIs in AWS and authentication
  • Basic understanding of general programming languages such as Python, JavaScript and C#
  • Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation), including building reusable modules and frameworks
  • Experience with developer portals and self-service tooling (Backstage or equivalent)
  • Advanced knowledge of CI/CD design and standardization using tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or AWS-native services
  • You have a strong understanding of cloud security best practices (IAM, KMS, secrets management, network isolation, compliance enforcement)
  • Experience managing multi-account AWS environments with centralized governance, logging, and monitoring
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools (Datadog, ELK, CloudWatch) and defining SLO-driven monitoring practices
  • Expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS)
  • You have an understanding of developer experience principles, including reducing cognitive load and enabling faster delivery cycles
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, etc.) for platform tooling and integration
  • Proven ability to influence engineering teams to adopt platform standards and best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to design scalable abstractions for complex infrastructure challenges
  • Excellent communication skills, with ability to articulate platform vision and value to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt platform strategy to evolving enterprise needs

They are primarily responsible for the configuration of our interface engine and the interfaces module of our EHR system, as well as the setup of new interfaces that they are assigned.   • Monitor the health of live interfaces.

  • Understand data structures and document technical specifications detailing target data elements.

  • Communicate effectively with technical internal and external database analysts.

  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.

jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/02/2026

Meet the Team

The Cloud Capacity Planning team makes sure Cisco's cloud platforms have the compute, storage and network capacity customers need, in the right region at the right time. We turn demand from sales, product and engineering into confirmed supply with our cloud service providers (CSPs), which keeps customer launches, migrations and maintenance windows on track while managing cloud spend responsibly. We're a supportive team of 7 and analysts across the US and Canada who share what we know, learn from each other and celebrate wins together. What makes this team exciting is timing: we're bringing AI-powered forecasting into how Cisco plans for the future of cloud!


Your Impact

Build and maintain a rolling capacity forecast by CSP, region, workload and resource type to help leaders make confident investment and growth decisions worldwide. Compare demand from sales pipeline, bookings and product roadmaps against available supply, then work with CSPs on reservations so customers get capacity on time without wasted spend. Collaborate with sales on realistic lead times, with engineering on protecting capacity during maintenance windows and with FinOps on reconciling reservations to keep costs healthy. Mentor fellow capacity planners and introduce AI-enabled tools to make planning faster and more accurate across every region. Measure your success by sharper forecasts, on-time deliveries and a clear owner and plan for every capacity gap.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, engineering, supply chain, data analytics or a related field; and 8+ years of related experience, or a master's degree and 6+ years of related experience
  • Experience in cloud or infrastructure capacity planning with AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud, including quotas and reservations
  • Experience building demand forecasts and scenario models
  • Experience building reports and dashboards
  • Experience working with FinOps or finance teams on cloud cost management, reservation coverage or budgets

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience using AI or machine learning tools to automate forecasting and reporting
  • Knowledge of how geopolitical, regulatory and data sovereignty factors affect regional capacity and hardware supply chains
  • Clear communicator who enjoys explaining trade-offs to stakeholders at every level
  • Passion for mentoring teammates and building processes that make everyone's work easier

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. The Corporate FP&A team is the financial intelligence engine at the heart of Zoom's enterprise decision-making, translating complex financial data into strategic clarity for executive leadership. About the Team

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Recovering entrepreneur? Frustrated with bureaucracy? Want to write the roadmap, not inherit one?

We're hiring across multiple levels and verticals. The nice thing about growing 30%+ at ~$2B ARR is that we need great engineers everywhere, and we have the room to shape the role around the right person. You build like a founder. We give you the platform to do it at scale.

About the role:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
  • You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
  • You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
  • You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will:

  • Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.
  • Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.
  • Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.
  • Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.
  • Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.
  • Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.
  • Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.
  • Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.
  • Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.
  • Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.
  • A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
  • Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$154,700—$260,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Reports To: Delivery Manager, Head of OpenBao Development
Employment Status: Full Time
Salary: Up to £100k + bonus + benefits.

Who is ControlPlane?

ControlPlane is a London-headquartered consultancy specialising in cloud-native, Kubernetes, and open-source security solutions. Our expertise lies in helping organisations adopt and secure complex cloud infrastructures by implementing security measures that are "secure-by-design" and "secure-by-default." This engineering excellence drives ControlPlane deep into cybersecurity, providing services like zero-trust architectures, threat modeling, supply chain security, and platform engineering.

We are acclaimed for our work in highly regulated industries, such as finance, healthcare, and national infrastructure. We help clients consume next-generation and open-source projects safely and securely. In addition to consulting, we are active contributors to the open-source community supporting projects like Flux CD, OpenBao, and FINOS AI Readiness.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking an Intermediate or Senior Go Engineer to join our open-source development team, working directly alongside our Head of OpenBao Development.

In this role, you will focus on core backend development, designing, building, and maintaining new features for OpenBao, the open-source identity-aware secrets management platform.

You will spend your time writing clean, secure, high-performance Go code, contributing to core architectural design discussions, building custom secrets engines and auth methods, and helping lead open-source community contributions on ControlPlane’s behalf. Prior experience working within the OpenBao codebase is a strong bonus, but strong Go systems engineering skills and an aptitude to learn are what matter most.

What You'll Do

OpenBao Core Development

  • Feature Engineering: Design, write, and maintain core capabilities, plugins, storage backends, and secrets engines for OpenBao in Go.
  • Collaboration: Partner directly with the Head of OpenBao Development to refine system architecture, author technical RFCs, and break down complex feature roadmaps into clear engineering deliverables.
  • Secure Coding: Ensure all code adheres to strict cryptography best practices, memory management safety, and secure-by-design principles. Review and remediate any vulnerability reports.

Open Source & Upstream Maintenance

  • Community Engagement: Participate in upstream open-source development, reviewing pull requests, triaging issue reports, and maintaining high standards for community contributions.
  • Internal R&D: Work on internal lab projects, security tooling, and integration prototypes that advance open-source identity and secrets management.

Quality & Testing

  • Testing & Automation: Write comprehensive unit, integration, and security tests for Go codebase changes to maintain reliability across production releases.
  • Pipeline Hardening: Collaborate on CI/CD automation, release workflows, and supply chain security for OpenBao distribution artifacts.

What We're Looking For

Core Technical Capabilities

  • Strong Go (Golang) Engineering: Solid experience writing production-grade Go code, with a strong understanding of concurrency (goroutines/channels), interface design, testing suites, and performance profiling.
  • Systems & Security Engineering: Solid understanding of software security fundamentals, such as PKI/TLS, cryptography concepts, authentication/authorization models, and API design.
  • Experience Level: Intermediate to Senior software engineering background (typically 3–5+ years in backend systems development).

Desirable / Bonus Experience

  • OpenBao or Vault Experience: Direct experience with the OpenBao or HashiCorp Vault codebase (plugin architecture, storage drivers, dynamic secrets, or internal RPC mechanisms) is highly desirable, though not strictly required.
  • Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Familiarity with Linux primitives, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform/OpenTofu).
  • Open Source Work: Previous track record of contributing to open-source Go projects or security tooling.

Location & Eligibility

  • This is a global role, but candidates in our existing regions within Europe, North America, and APAC would be given priority
  • Ability to align work hours with a global team across USA, NZ, UK.

Benefits

ControlPlane is a dynamic, cutting-edge and passionate business to work for. Our employees are at the heart of our business, which means we care about our culture, our people and their progression.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

﻿Role overview

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.

You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.

If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

Responsibilities

Task & Pipeline Management

  • Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
  • Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
  • Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
  • Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up

  • Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
  • Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
  • Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
  • Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control

  • Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
  • Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
  • Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
  • Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
  • Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
  • Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI

  • Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
  • Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
  • Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration

  • Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
  • Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
  • Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
  • Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
  • Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
  • Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
  • Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

Technical Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
  • Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
  • Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
  • Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills

  • Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
  • Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines
  • Clear, professional communicator
  • Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team
  • Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas

What we offer

  • Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
  • Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office -We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.

The IT Portfolio Manager assesses, documents, and budgets potential projects; perform project resource planning; conducts continuous monitoring and reports on portfolio health, and participates in the department’s change management process and staff training.


Core Responsibilities:

  • Works to develop and implement best practices, processes, and toolsets for effective portfolio/project management, and helps educate staff on best practices and effective project execution.
