jobs.excerpt: The Technical Project Manager – SAP Deployment is responsible for coordinating and driving the technical and operational activities required to successfully deploy the Project Elevate SAP solution to BFS field locations.
jobs.description:
The Technical Project Manager – SAP Deployment is responsible for coordinating and driving the technical and operational activities required to successfully deploy the Project Elevate SAP solution to BFS field locations. This position serves as a key connection point between Deployment Field Services, the Deployment Hub, Core Project teams, Business Enablement, site leadership, SAP functional/technical teams, Security, Data, Training, and support organizations. The role drives deployment readiness, manages dependencies and risks, coordinates cutover and Hypercare activities, and ensures technical issues are identified, routed, tracked, and resolved through the appropriate teams. The position is not intended to be an SAP configuration/development role. Rather, the Technical Project Manager must understand SAP-enabled business processes and the BFS deployment model well enough to identify dependencies, facilitate technical problem solving, manage cross-functional execution, and communicate clearly between technical teams and field/site operations. Key Responsibilities

  • Deployment Planning & Execution

Lead team readiness and SAP functional training, ensuring team members develop the knowledge, skills, and hands-on proficiency required to confidently support their assigned functional area during deployment, go-live, and Hypercare. Prepare and coach team members for effective end-user support, reinforcing strong communication, patience, professionalism, problem-solving, and a positive, customer-focused attitude when working with end users. Drive go-live and Hypercare readiness, keeping the team focused, engaged, and accountable while monitoring training progress, addressing knowledge gaps, reinforcing key processes, and ensuring the team is prepared to provide effective on-site support under demanding deployment conditions. Develop and maintain detailed deployment plans for assigned SAP deployment waves and locations. Coordinate technical activities across pre-deployment, readiness, cutover, go-live, Hypercare, and transition-to-support phases. Coordinate activities across multiple BFS locations and deployment workstreams. Ensure owners, due dates, dependencies, and escalation paths are clearly established. Identify schedule conflicts and critical-path risks early and drive them toward resolution.

  • Technical & Site Readiness

Coordinate and track readiness of technical dependencies required for successful field deployment, including applicable:

SAP environment/access readiness User roles and security access Site and deployment data readiness Devices and handheld technology Infrastructure and connectivity dependencies Interfaces and application dependencies Training/practice environments Deployment and support tools Build effective working relationships with BFS site leaders and field teams

  • Cutover & Go-Live Coordination

Coordinate Field Deployment activities associated with production cutover and go-live. Maintain visibility to critical cutover tasks, dependencies, owners, status, and blockers. Facilitate deployment checkpoints and escalation discussions. Coordinate with Deployment Hub, Core Project, business, technical, and field resources when cutover activities affect site readiness. Ensure issues discovered during deployment are routed to the appropriate owner rather than allowing field teams to develop unsupported workarounds. Translate field operational issues into information technical and functional teams can act upon. Help technical teams understand the real-world business impact of deployment issues. Maintain focus on business continuity during deployment. Promote adoption of standard BFS Way processes rather than unsupported local workarounds.

  • Hypercare & Incident Coordination

Support operational stabilization after SAP go-live. Monitor deployment issues and incidents requiring cross-team coordination. Drive appropriate triage and escalation of technical, functional, data, access, integration, or process issues. Work with ServiceNow and support teams to maintain visibility to issues affecting field operations. Facilitate prioritization of issues based on operational impact. Track significant issues through resolution and communicate progress to deployment leadership and affected stakeholders. Support transition from Hypercare into steady state support. Produce concise deployment status reporting for Deployment leadership. Facilitate recurring technical deployment/readiness meetings. Translate technical information into clear business impact for field and leadership audiences. Escalate decisions requiring leadership intervention with clear options, impacts, and recommended next steps.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Project Management, Supply Chain, or comparable professional experience. 5+ years of technical project management, ERP deployment, IT implementation, or comparable large-scale transformation experience. Experience supporting SAP implementations, ERP deployments, or multi-site enterprise technology rollouts. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple sites, workstreams, dependencies, risks, and technical teams concurrently. Ability to translate between technical teams and nontechnical field/business users. Demonstrated experience operating in high-pressure go-live or production-support environments. Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills. Ability to travel to BFS field locations as required by deployment activities.

Preferred Qualifications

SAP S/4HANA deployment experience Experience with large-scale, multi-location ERP implementations SAP functional knowledge in one or more areas relevant to BFS Cutover and Hypercare experience Experience supporting manufacturing, warehouse, transportation, distribution, supply-chain, or building-material operations Experience coordinating internal teams, systems integrators, and third-party field-support partners

jobs.title: Staff Information Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences.
jobs.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.

Rithum is embedding AI into every corner of how it operates — and security is no exception.

As a Staff Information Security Engineer, you own the intersection of AI adoption and information security: designing guardrails for AI-powered products, building automated security tooling, designing security controls and monitoring for an AI-First workforce, helping every team at Rithum move fast without creating risk they cannot see. This is not a typical security role. You spend as much time building and automating as you do reviewing, turning a repeating control into infrastructure-as-code, a manual review into a workflow, and a vague AI risk into a concrete, enforced guardrails. You work autonomously, balancing research with fast-paced delivery, and collaborating closely with Platform Engineering, IT, Security Champions, and external auditors.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the bridge between architectural intent and operational reality; mediate conflicts between security requirements and feasible implementation, propose compensating controls where gaps exist and help register, track and remediate residual risks.
  • Implement preventive, default-on security controls across cloud and enterprise environments, codified as policy- and infrastructure-as-code so security is enforced by design, including controls that govern how AI tools and models may be used.
  • Implement and enforce identity and access controls to an agreed standard, including access boundaries for AI systems and non-human/agent identities by partnering with Platform Engineering and IT to align tooling and policy to the architecture.
  • Assist in maintaining the InfoSec risk register; track emerging threats and translate them into actionable guidance for engineering teams.
  • Support third-party and vendor risk assessments, with a focus on vendors who process data through AI pipelines.
  • Automate repetitive security workflows (evidence collection, access reviews, alert enrichment) and build or operate AI-assisted security agents — with human-in-the-loop approval gates, least-privilege credentials, and explicit attention to each agent's own blast radius.
  • Integrate security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, DAST/SAST, vulnerability scanners) with LLM layers to surface actionable insight and automated responses.
  • Define and enforce security requirements for AI-powered features: model access controls, prompt-injection mitigations, output validation, and data-handling boundaries.
  • Conduct threat modelling on agentic and LLM-based systems, accounting for novel attack surfaces such as tool misuse, indirect prompt injection, and supply chain risk.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of security engineering experience with demonstrated AI/ML security depth (prompt injection, model supply chain, adversarial inputs, RAG).
  • Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) and LLM frameworks and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, or similar) to accelerate and elevate your work.
  • Hands-on identity and access expertise across modern enterprise and cloud identity stacks, including access models for AI systems and non-human identities.
  • Infrastructure and policy-as-code (e.g. Terraform, OPA/Rego) and proficiency in a scripting language for automation (Python preferred).
  • Cloud security expertise: AWS Solutions Architect / Security Specialty or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including multi-account governance, preventive guardrails, and policy-as-code.
  • Application security (OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM/GenAI Top 10, secure SDLC) and threat-modelling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent). Practical experience building or operating AI agents, and integrating security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, SAST/DAST/SCA) so it surfaces action rather than raw alerts.
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 control frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating AI agents in a production environment.
  • Awareness of privacy regulation (GDPR/CCPA) as it touches AI including privacy-by-design and DPIAs.
  • Red teaming or adversarial ML research backgrounds.
  • Experience implementing privileged-access, key-management, posture-management, or data-protection programs.
  • Experience with EDR, CASB, DLP, Security automation and SAST, DAST, IAST and SCA tools.
  • Cloud Architecture or Security certifications (CCSK, TAISE, AWS).

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $170,000-$220,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 12% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits: Affordable health care plans and company HSA contributions, starting on Day 1
  • A 6% 401(k) match
  • Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 9 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days
  • 12 weeks primary caregiver leave & 4 weeks secondary caregiver leave
  • Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • Pet insurance
  • Legal assistance and identity theft insurance plans
  • Life insurance 2x salary
  • Access to the Calm app and the Employee Assistance Program
  • $65/month Remote work stipend for internet
  • Culture and team-building activities
  • Tuition assistance
  • Career development opportunities
  • Charitable contribution match up to $250 per year

We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Job Description

Purpose of the role

To assess and improve the security posture of the organisation by identifying, validating, and helping mitigate weaknesses across information technology (IT) systems, applications, networks, and infrastructure through authorised security testing, adversarial simulation, and threat-based assessment techniques.

Accountabilities

  • Plan and deliver offensive security engagements, audits and threat models to identify vulnerabilities and adversary pathways across the bank’s systems, applications, networks, and infrastructure using offensive security tools and techniques; and communicating actionable findings, risk impact, and remediation recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to identify emerging cyber-attack techniques, tools, and technologies, and to contribute to the continuous improvement of offensive security methodologies, frameworks, and testing approaches.

  • Develop and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation and reports for senior stakeholders, detailing offensive security findings, risk impact, and remediation guidance.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand security requirements and existing controls across business processes, applications, and services, in order to enhance the organisation’s overall security posture and assurance.

  • Identify emerging vulnerabilities, exploit techniques, and cyber-attack trends to inform the development of offensive security testing methodologies and assurance activities.

  • Design and maintain offensive security tooling, infrastructure, and tradecraft, ensuring safe, and controlled operations aligned with legal, ethical, and organisational requirements.

  • Support the management of complex cybersecurity incidents by collaborating with information technology (IT), security operations, and incident response teams, providing technical analysis, subject-matter expertise, and advisory input to assist effective investigation and remediation efforts. ​

Vice President Expectations

  • To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..

  • If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

  • OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

  • Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.

  • Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.

  • Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.

  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.

  • Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.

  • Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.

  • Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Red Team Operator - VP. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. In this role, you’ll leverage industry-leading tools, explore emerging techniques, and execute operations across a wide range of domains, including cyber, physical, human, process, and technology. As a member of the Red Team, you’ll participate in full-scope adversary emulation exercises spanning cyber operations, physical security assessments, social engineering engagements, and everything in between, testing the resilience of our defenses under realistic conditions. You’ll identify vulnerabilities and control gaps, then work closely with stakeholders to help strengthen our security posture. This is a highly hands-on role, ideal for someone who thrives on tackling complex challenges, developing offensive security capabilities, and operating against sophisticated targets. You’ll have dedicated time to research emerging tradecraft, evaluate new tools and techniques, and collaborate with a team of skilled, highly motivated operators. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, practical security testing experience, creativity in problem-solving, and the ability to work effectively across teams to achieve meaningful security outcomes.

To be successful as a Senior Red Team Operator - VP, you should have experience:

  • Develop and enhance custom tooling, offensive tradecraft, and defense-evasion techniques to emulate sophisticated threat actors and evaluate the effectiveness of security controls, detection, and response capabilities

  • Research, prototype, and execute innovative attack methodologies that advance adversary emulation capabilities and align with the evolving threat landscape

  • Demonstrate expertise in Red Team operations through hands-on security testing, offensive security research, and continuous development toward or attainment of industry-recognized certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, CRTP, CREST, CCSAS, CCRTS, or equivalent

  • Leverage programming and scripting skills to build, customize, and automate tools that improve operational efficiency and support complex Red Team engagements

  • Apply strong analytical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills to navigate technical challenges, adapt to dynamic environments, and deliver impactful security testing outcomes

Other highly valued skills include:

  • Developing and enhancing custom tooling, offensive tradecraft, and defense-evasion techniques to emulate sophisticated threat actors and evaluate the effectiveness of security controls, detection, and response capabilities

  • Research, prototype, and execute innovative attack methodologies that advance adversary emulation capabilities and align with the evolving threat landscape

  • Demonstrate expertise in Red Team operations through hands-on security testing, offensive security research, any of these industry-recognized certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, CRTP, CREST, CCSAS, CCRTS, are a plus

  • Leverage programming and scripting skills to build, customize, and automate tools that improve operational efficiency and support complex Red Team engagements

  • Apply strong analytical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills to navigate technical challenges, adapt to dynamic environments, and deliver impactful security testing outcomes

jobs.excerpt: Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?  Leidos is a Fortune 500® company with nearly $18B in sales and 50,000 employees that brings over 70 years of experience in support of both investor-owned and municipal utility growth goals.
jobs.description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

Leidos is a Fortune 500® company with nearly $18B in sales and 50,000 employees that brings over 70 years of experience in support of both investor-owned and municipal utility growth goals. Leidos Energy helps utilities address complex challenges through comprehensive, performance-based solutions delivered across the full project lifecycle. Our capabilities include engineering, planning, project management, construction management, and commissioning services for electric power substations, transmission and distribution systems, protection and controls design, and electrification programs. Utilities nationwide rely on Leidos for trusted power industry expertise, demonstrated by our work with more than 75 investor-owned utilities and over 100 municipal and cooperative utilities, as well as a growing portfolio of private developer clients.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos Energy is seeking a Power Consultant Senior Project Manager - Transaction Services to play an important part in transactions, giving you an opportunity to contribute to the transformation of the energy industry. Older, inefficient power generation and transmission systems are being upgraded and replaced with modern, environmentally friendly alternatives. You will be an integral part of an exceptional team of power industry experts, providing consulting services and work products that our clients view as critical inputs to their business decisions. We evaluate a wide variety of technologies, from wind turbines and solar panels to battery storage systems, fuel cells, and advanced fuel conversion technologies.

We provide expertise, guidance, and consultation to our clients, and our work is centered on supporting financial transactions - the development, financing, acquisition and sale of generation (and non-generation) hard assets. We identify technical and commercial risks and help our clients to find and/or evaluate solutions to their challenges. Because we are exposed to numerous unique projects over short periods of time, we (i) are diversified in technologies and commercial approaches to project execution; (ii) contribute to and learn how problems are solved by industry leaders and how those solutions drive financial viability; and (iii) benefit from this knowledge as a team and as individuals, resulting in a professional experience that evolves, is dynamic, and is well-rounded.

Location: Fully remote will be considered based on candidate experience and qualifications. Candidates within commuting distance of Denver, CO, or Framingham, MA is a plus.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Collaborate regularly with project developers, utilities, equipment manufacturers, engineering firms, investors, bankers, and legal and financial advisors.
  • Determine, monitor, and review all project economics including costs, operational budgets, staffing requirements, sub-contractors, resources, and risk.
  • Plan, schedule, monitor, and report on activities related to the project.
  • Lead the project teams based on client requirements and objectives.
  • Facilitate status review meetings among project team members and clients.
  • Work with senior management on project proposals, bids, contracts, estimates, and schedules.
  • Manage project requirements, scope, and change issues.
  • Coach and counsel members of cross-functional teams to accomplish project goals, to meet established schedules, and resolve technical or operational issues.

What does Leidos need from me?

  • Experience in energy consulting and the evaluation of distributed generation, combined heat and power plants, utility consulting, electric power generation facilities, including renewable (solar, wind), hydroelectric, energy storage, thermal (combustion turbine, solid-fuel), carbon capture and sequestration, and/or other power generation technologies.
  • Senior Level: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related discipline from an accredited university with twelve plus years of experience in a broad range of independent engineering assignments, and/or related business functions including: consulting for lenders, funds, utilities, and independent developers. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Subject Matter Expert Level: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related discipline from an accredited university with fifteen plus years of experience in a broad range of independent engineering assignments, and/or related business functions including: consulting for lenders, funds, utilities, and independent developers. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience with evaluation of commercial risks in construction, procurement, operating and services contracts.
  • Ability to travel up to 10-15% of the time.

In short, this role is for a seasoned cybersecurity professional who thrives at the intersection of governance, risk, compliance, and business partnership. As a Sr. GRC Analyst, you will play a key role in helping the organization identify, assess, manage, and communicate cybersecurity risk while supporting compliance obligations, audits, policy governance, third-party security reviews, and security awareness initiatives. You'll serve as a trusted advisor across the business, translating technical security findings into meaningful business risk and driving practical solutions that strengthen the organization's security posture.

  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities with the confidence to engage stakeholders at all levels.

  • Orchestration Security & Guardrails: Architect and implement the security control plane. You will engineer automated guardrails, controllers, and runtime security policies that validate and enforce the integrity of tenant boundaries.

  • Security-as-a-Service Approach: Designing and operating security services as a scalable platform. Building "self-service" security primitives (e.g., Identity-as-a-Service, automated secrets management, and real-time scanning APIs) that allow developer teams to move fast.

  • Security Tooling & Lifecycle: Develop internal security frameworks and automated response systems. Responsible for the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) of the security tools, including testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  • Threat Modeling & System Design: Conduct deep-dive threat models on complex distributed systems and the DGX Cloud stack, identifying architectural gaps in security and engineering the solutions to close them.

What We Need to See:

We are looking for high-caliber engineers with deep spikes of expertise in a few of these areas and the intellectual curiosity to dive into the rest. If your experience aligns with the core of this role—building resilient security systems—and you can show us how, we want to hear from you!

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Understanding of cloud-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and the security challenges inherent in high-throughput, low-latency environments.

  • Platformizing Security: Transform complex security requirements into consumable internal services. Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:

jobs.description:
Job Title: Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator
Reports To: CEO or designee
Work Shift: Flexible, with scheduled live overlap within 10:00 AM-6:00 PM Eastern Time; exact arrangement TBD
Working Hours: Approximately 10 hours/week, with additional hours during payroll weeks

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator to take over recurring financial administration for an addiction recovery program supporting people coming out of rehabilitation.

Delivered through an in-house accounting team, this assignment replaces the current bookkeeper and covers approximately 300-400 cash-basis transactions monthly, client billing, AP/AR, staff timesheets, payroll administration, HR documentation, and financial reporting & analysis.

The baseline workload is approximately 10 hours weekly. Payroll runs twice monthly, and those weeks may require additional time. The successful candidate must maintain accurate records, meet recurring deadlines, and communicate directly with the client through scheduled conversations as well as written updates.

Key Responsibilities

Bookkeeping And Reporting

  • Record and categorize transactions using the established cashbasis accounting approach, with future shift to accrual-basis

  • Reconcile bank, credit-card, and other financial accounts

  • Administer & track virtual corporate cards, expense management & receipt submission process

  • Investigate missing, duplicate, or incorrectly classified transactions, or errors caused by sync or technology

  • Maintain supporting invoices, receipts, statements, and reconciliation schedules

  • Prepare core monthly financial reports and flag material discrepancies, or outstanding items, ensuring accurate month’s end close

  • Build & analyze financial reports and dashboards for drivers of business improvement & assist with budgeting, forcasting and cash flow reporting

  • Demonstrated experience working with and maintaining Quickbooks Online file, including software updates & integrations

Client Billing, A/P And A/R

  • Prepare and issue bills or invoices using approved information

  • Record receipts, monitor outstanding balances, and coordinate follow-ups

  • Maintain vendor invoices and payment schedules

  • Prepare payment information for review under established approval procedures

  • Reconcile payments and escalate disputed charges or missing documentation

  • Communicate directly with clients and vendors as directed

  • Experience with online invoicing & payment platforms

Timesheets, Payroll And HR Administration

  • Collect and review timesheets and approved payroll changes

  • Prepare payroll inputs for twice-monthly processing, ensuring correct allocations

  • Check payroll information for inconsistencies and obtain clarification

  • Support routine employee onboarding, offboarding, and HR record administration, and historical cleanup

  • Maintain confidential payroll and employee documentation

  • Coordinate additional capacity when payroll deadlines increase the workload

  • Experience with online hr & payroll platforms

Handover And Coordination

  • Take over records, recurring tasks, and outstanding items from the outgoing bookkeeper

  • Maintain a calendar of billing, ap, payroll, and reporting deadlines

  • Document workflows and unresolved questions

  • Coordinate with the client and accounting lead on priorities and approvalsUpdate tracking sheets in real time

  • Perform historical cleanup & record organization

  • Participate in scheduled live discussions and team meetings during agreed Eastern Time overlap

  • Maintain strict confidentiality & security protocols for all data and data access and adhere to internal controls

  • Create SOPs and workflows for processes, including any necessary documents for staff training & compliance

  • Coordination with external CPA for Quarterly, Year End or ad hoc needs.

Qualifications

Required

  • Hands-on bookkeeping experience, including cash-basis & accrual basis accounting

  • Experience managing billing, AP/AR, cash flow, and account reconciliations

  • Experience reviewing timesheets and supporting payroll administration

  • Ability to prepare accurate recurring financial reports

  • Proficiency with accounting, invoicing & hr/payroll software and spreadsheets

  • Ability to analyze data for trends & insights and deliver high impact summaries & recommendations

  • Strong organization, accuracy, attention to detail, discretion, and deadline management

  • Clear written and spoken English

  • Ability to work independently,communicate questions proactively, and maintain confidentiality

  • Availability for approximately 10 hours/week, agreed payroll-week flexibility, and scheduled client calls

Preferred

  • Experience supporting US businesses and payroll workflows

  • Experience taking over books from another provider

  • Experience maintaining employee records and HR documentation

  • Relevant accounting qualification or bookkeeping certification

  • Ability to document and improve internal processes

  • Experience working within an outsourced accounting team

  • Experience directly supporting a founder, CEO or small business operator

  • Experience with Google Workspace Suite & AI

  • Experience configuring and optimizing features within financial & HR software stack

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Start Date: Immediate Role Type: Full-time Reports To: Jennifer Perniciaro Team: Central Operations Priority Application Deadline: November 9, 2026 Travel: ~30-35% time.
jobs.description:
Start Date: Immediate
Role Type: Full-time
Reports To: Jennifer Perniciaro
Team: Central Operations

Priority Application Deadline: November 9, 2026

Travel: ~30-35% time. Willingness to travel approximately 2-3x per month for 2-3 days depending on the location and duration of trips. There will be four to six trips per year of longer duration, lasting ~4-5 days. The number of trips will vary from month to month - some months will have more, while others will have fewer.

Location: Remote (U.S.-based); Midwest and East Coast preferred. This is a fully remote role, but given the location of our projects we’re prioritizing candidates located in the Central or Eastern Timezones.

Who We Are

Transcend is a national nonprofit that helps communities reimagine and redesign schools so every young person can thrive in a rapidly changing world. Across the country, communities are recognizing that classrooms built for the industrial age aren’t preparing learners for what’s next. Instead, schools must be designed for continuous evolution: relevant, resilient, and ready for the future. For more than a decade, Transcend has partnered with school and system leaders to build the capacity for bold, lasting change—change led by the people who live it every day. We’ve worked with nearly 500 schools and 200 districts serving over 225,000 students in 35 states. Together, we’ve seen what’s possible when communities lead redesign with proven methods, insight, and support. From that work, we develop and share tools, research, and models that help schools everywhere make the leap to extraordinary learning—for every child, in every community.

For more information, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

The Opportunity

At the heart of our work across projects and teams lies our operations and events work led by Operations Managers! Operations Managers are the backstage leaders of our work and go the extra mile to ensure everyone has what they need to be able to facilitate projects across Transcend.

Operations Managers are home-based within our centralized operations team and are allocated to specific projects across teams to ensure strong coordination and execution. Across all project allocations, they are responsible for driving clarity, maintaining momentum, and ensuring high-quality outcomes. By asking thoughtful questions, anticipating needs, and deeply listening, Operations Managers help shape experiences that ensure partners and teammates feel prepared, supported, and valued.

Operations Managers partner closely with Portfolio Directors, Project Leads, and Senior Leaders to co-create project plans, lead operational decision-making, and ensure seamless execution across projects. They build and steward systems, manage complex logistics, and design experiences that are thoughtful, human-centered, and aligned to Transcend’s high bar for quality.

A defining part of this specific Operations Manager role is support for and then ownership of Transcend's org-wide Team Retreat, our flagship all-team gathering that brings together 130+ teammates for three to four days each June. Alongside it, you will support smaller-scale experiences and events for our internal central coordination team, and may take on additional lead or support roles on other operational projects across portfolios.

More than our other Operations Manager roles, this one will have a large focus on Transcend's internal team experiences and support projects that create culture and community for our organization.

As an Operations Manager at Transcend, you will get to:

  • Foster strong relationships - with our partners, Portfolio Directors, Project Leads, and across our internal teams!
  • Serve as a project manager for all things operations – creating and managing timelines, supporting our coaches in anticipating and navigating through logistics and operational needs and constraints, and coordinating project plans and calendars across a scope of work and range of projects.
  • Grow from supporting to owning our org-wide Team Retreat Operations end to end. In your first cycle, you’ll primarily support an operational leader and learn from them as they guide the planning and execution of Transcend’s annual, all-team retreat, a three to four day convening held each June. Over time, you’ll take full ownership of this marquee, high-visibility project, which will be your primary body of work in this role.
  • Lead other conference coordination - holding, stewarding, and coordinating a group of teammates and external partnerships to attend events and/or conferences. This includes preparing travel plans, planning and leading spaces we want to craft during the conferences, and communicating with conference attendees.
  • Craft and manage operations-focused communications with internal staff, school partners, and our learning cohorts and communities. This includes crafting emails, slack messages, participant guides, logistics memos, etc. with clear instructions and information for the team and/or school partners to ensure alignment on the overall experience and the small details.
  • Lead and manage operations and logistics for various workshops, inspiration visits, and events, both virtually through Zoom and in-person. This ranges from leading operations for 2-hour, 15-person Zoom calls; to operations for 4-day in-person events with ~100 participants. Additionally, some in-person events may require you to rent and drive a vehicle to transport materials, support team members, or handle other logistical needs.
  • Create and analyze team survey data – writing and sending surveys (often in Google Forms), analyzing that data, and sharing back the summary and next steps with the team.
  • Spearhead smooth internal operations such as scheduling internal team meetings and project events, preparing agendas, taking notes, and capturing (and managing follow-through on) the next steps.
  • Manage conference/event budgets, and other team budgets as needed. With the support of the Finance team, support your project team and/or event to stay on budget. Operations Managers who support events and procurement also have and manage a Transcend credit card, including any actions needed to review and document expenses.
  • Support team special projects which vary in sensitivity to Portfolio/team needs. These activities may include: planning team stepbacks, designing school application processes, supporting grant writing and reports, more in-depth analytics data work, video and media editing, creating internal team websites to organize resources/knowledge management, and creating and updating cohort websites through a website builder platform. Each portfolio/team has unique needs, and we explore those more fully throughout the interview process.

To see this role in action and further details about what these buckets of work would look like, check out these sample projects.

Who You Are

You love all things project management and have incredible organizational superpowers. You approach managing operations and projects on a team, both internally and externally, with people at the core of experiences. You do so by taking the time to get to know the people you’re working closely with, forging strong relationships, and creating a sense of community and connection. Your passion for planning and event operations shines through as you meticulously craft and manage smooth logistics, and you know that the real craft is in the details that make people feel held, such as the personalized touch, the perfectly timed moment of delight, or the care that turns a well-run event into one people are still talking about weeks later. Taking initiative and managing your time effectively are second nature to you, and you take immense pride in your stellar organizational systems. You also thrive in, and enjoy, working behind the scenes in a fast-paced environment where things can change quickly and operate with resolute calmness!

And above all, you love that your everyday work is in service to a mission that matters. You believe deeply in the power of education to change lives and believe in reinventing schools so that young people can live a life of limitless opportunities. You are excited to contribute your operational expertise to making this work possible!

To all this, you bring:

  • A commitment to Transcend’s mission of building and spreading extraordinary learning for all.
  • Outstanding project management and organizational skills that include strong attention to detail and allow you to gather and organize multiple work streams and logistics efficiently.
  • Prior experiences planning and executing large-scale, multi-day conferences or retreats, alongside prior experience with planning and executing in-person and virtual events for a variety of groups - from small < 10-person events to convenings that bring large groups of people together.
  • Exceptional relationship-building instincts and initiative where you build trust quickly with peers and with leaders at every level of the organization and are equally comfortable partnering closely and pushing back with care when something needs it.
  • Familiarity with facilitating logistics for virtual events through Zoom.
  • A deep love for planning and executing a variety of events.
  • Curiosity and drive to develop clear, effective, and efficient operational processes.
  • A strong commitment to designing meaningful, thoughtful, and community-centered experiences—whether in the events you manage, the way you communicate, or how you approach your work—to ensure that participants, partners, and teammates feel genuinely valued and included.
  • A willingness to travel up to 2-3 times/month(most trips 2-3 days. Four to six trips/year of longer duration, likely 4-5 days), to support in-person operations.
  • Flexibility, optimism, and a desire to learn and grow.
  • Eagerness to embrace and live into Transcend’s core values.

Application & Hiring Process

We review applications on a rolling basis and are committed to a thoughtful and people-centered hiring experience that helps candidates feel what it’s like to work at Transcend. Here’s what you can expect if you are selected to move forward:

  • Initial interview with the team via Zoom to learn more about your interest and experiences. A note on compensation: during your initial interview with the team, we will confirm your location and accompanying salary range. *More on how we determine this is below
  • Try-on activity to engage in a role-aligned exercise. This helps us get a sense of how you approach the work and gives you a feel for what the role might be like
  • A panel interview with the hiring manager and members of our team, where we’d debrief the try-on task and engage in some scenarios you are likely to encounter in the role
  • Final interview with our Chief Portfolio Officer
  • Reference checks to learn more about your superpowers and working style

Salary

As a national team, we apply a cost-of-labor adjustment by adjusting salaries into 3 geographical bands (geo-band) in order to offer competitive compensation for all employees across the US. These geo-bands help us tailor compensation appropriately based on the specific location of each teammate. Below are the three salary geo-bands for this role, and we will confirm the individual range for your location during this initial interview, if you move forward in the process.

  • Geo Comp 1: Currently Includes: NYC metro area, CA Bay Area, Boston City, LA City, Washington, D.C, Seattle $75,000 - $105,000
  • Geo Comp 2: Currently includes locations such as: San Diego; New Haven, CT; Ventura, CA $71,250 - $99,750
  • Geo Comp 3: Currently Includes: Most other US locations $67,500 - $94,500

A Few Nuts & Bolts

We are an experienced team focused on extraordinary learning for all. We welcome candidates who are passionate about ensuring that all students thrive. We are also committed to providing our teammates with a competitive benefits package and offer medical, dental, and vision coverage options, org-wide holidays, paid time off, paid parental leave, professional development opportunities, and fully remote work. We take pride in our collaborative environment, exceptional team, and shared commitment to principled, impactful work.

We look forward to learning more about you!

jobs.description:
Implementation Consultant, Logis Billing

Team: Implementation, Logis · Level: Implementation Consultant · Reports to: Team Lead, Implementation (Logis Billing) · Location: Remote, United States

Outcome. Each billing customer you implement is billing cleanly within weeks of go-live, on the date in the plan, with a clean handoff to support.

About the role

When an agency or billing company buys Logis Billing, the first months decide whether it trusts us. If the setup is right, claims go out clean and cash arrives on time. If it is wrong, claims reject, payments do not post, and the customer feels it in their bank account.

You take a customer from kickoff to their first clean billing cycle. You learn how they bill today, configure Logis Billing to match, move their data, train their staff, and stay with them through go-live until the money is moving. Then you hand them off cleanly to support and Customer Success.

Where we are headed

Logis Billing is growing, and AI agents are already taking repetitive work off billing teams. Every new customer is a chance to set them up for that future from day one.

You will implement for agencies and billing companies of every size, and help shape the playbook as the product changes.

Who ESO is

ESO is the first responder for the first responders. We build software and data products for EMS agencies, fire departments, hospitals, and government stakeholders, and serve more than 18,000 customers. Our mission is to improve community health and safety outcomes through the power of data.

How you support the mission

You support the mission by making sure agencies can collect what they are owed, so they can keep crews on the road and equipment in service. A clean go-live protects their revenue and their trust in us.

You support your team by doing it the same way every time: following the playbook, writing down what you learn, and asking for help early when a project starts to slip.

What you will do

Run each implementation

  • Own a set of Logis Billing implementations from kickoff to handoff, each on a dated plan in the project management platform with health, risks, and next steps current every week.
  • Run discovery: how the customer bills today, their payers, fee schedules, codes, clearinghouse, and reports.
  • Raise risks early to your team lead, and to the customer, with a plan to recover.

Configure and convert

  • Configure Logis Billing to the configuration standards: payers, fee schedules, codes, claim rules, clearinghouse enrollment, and remittance and posting.
  • Plan and check data conversions, so open balances and history arrive correct.
  • Run the user acceptance test (UAT) checklist with the customer and get sign-off before go-live.

Train and hand off

  • Train the customer's billers and office staff on the workflows they will use every day.
  • Stay with the customer through their first billing cycles until claims and payments are flowing.
  • Hand off cleanly: Logis Billing support in Customer Care owns tickets, and Customer Success owns the relationship.

Time tracking

  • Log your time in real time, as you finish each issue or task, in the time tracking system, by customer and type of work.

How success is measured

  • Time to value: days from kickoff to the customer's first clean billing cycle, against the standard for the project size.
  • Go-lives on the date in the project plan, and right the first time, with no serious defect in the first 30 days.
  • Every project plan current each week: dates, health, and next steps.
  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT) at go-live and at handoff.
  • Clean handoffs: tickets in the first 60 days after go-live go to support, not back to you.
  • Time logged in real time and completely, to the team standard.

Benefits & Perks

ESO offers a comprehensive suite of benefits to promote health and financial security for our employees and their families. For full-time employment you this includes:
  • Competitive health plans (medical, dental, & vision insurance)
  • PTO (starting at 20 days) & 12 company holidays
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Telemedicine service provided by ESO
  • Savings accounts (FSA, HSA, DCA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Annual health and wellness reimbursement
  • Peace of mind benefits such as life insurance, disability insurance, and worksite benefits
  • Paid parental leave, new child program, & flexible parental return-to-work options
  • Casual office environments and unlimited office snacks and drinks

About ESO

ESO is a fast-paced, growing data, technology, and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today’s EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals. We’re small enough to be nimble and fun, but big enough to be a great place to work. We serve thousands of customers out of our offices across the US, Canada and Northern Ireland.
Are you ready to Make a Difference? At ESO, we believe in bringing your true self to work every single day. If you don’t match all the qualifications on the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway! We are looking for passionate, innovative, and authentic people to help drive our mission.
All offers are contingent upon a successful background check.
ESO is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at ESO regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religion; race; national origin; political affiliation; sexual orientation; disability; veteran status; or other non-merit factor.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients.
jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

﻿Role overview

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.

You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.

If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

Responsibilities

Task & Pipeline Management

  • Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
  • Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
  • Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
  • Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up

  • Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
  • Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
  • Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
  • Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control

  • Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
  • Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
  • Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
  • Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
  • Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
  • Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI

  • Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
  • Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
  • Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration

  • Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
  • Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
  • Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
  • Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
  • Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
  • Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
  • Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

Technical Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
  • Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
  • Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
  • Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills

  • Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
  • Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines
  • Clear, professional communicator
  • Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team
  • Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas

What we offer

  • Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
  • Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office -We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Data Analytics
jobs.excerpt: Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work.
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About The Team

Agility Robotics is building the future of work through humanoid robots that operate in human environments. The Data Platform team builds the data infrastructure that powers everything from fleet operations and hardware reliability to business analytics and machine learning. We enable engineers across robotics, perception, and product teams to derive insight from the vast quantities of telemetry and log data generated by our robots in the field.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team and help shape the foundation of data-driven operations at Agility. In this role, you’ll work closely with robotics & and operations teams to design, curate, and maintain high-quality datasets that enable analytics, debugging, and fleet-scale insights.

You’ll bridge the gap between raw robot data and actionable information — working both on-robot data generation and in the cloud ingestion and processing pipelines. You’ll design transformations, author pipelines, and collaborate across teams to deliver reliable and queryable data products for hardware reliability, system health, workflow metrics, and root cause analysis.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with robot software and hardware teams to define, collect, and curate data needed for analytics and debugging.
  • Develop and maintain ETL pipelines that transform raw robot logs and telemetry into structured datasets using Spark, Airflow (or equivalent orchestration tools), and AWS data services.
  • Own the gold-layer datasets that power fleet dashboards, reliability models, and business metrics, with defined freshness SLAs, documentation, and monitoring so analytics and data science teams can rely on them.
  • Implement data quality checks, schema evolution, and metadata management practices using our internal Data Registry and cataloging systems.
  • Collaborate with internal consumers — reliability, analytics, and ML teams — to design efficient data models for their workflows.
  • Occasionally contribute to shared libraries or APIs in Python, Java, or C++ to support data capture and consumption.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Spark or equivalent distributed data processing framework with complementary programming skills in Python, Java and/or Scala.
  • Experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or other data orchestration systems.
  • Proficiency with data formats such as Avro, Parquet, and structured/numeric datasets.
  • Familiarity with table formats like Icerbeg, Delta Lake etc and medallion architecture.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality best practices.
  • Good intuitions of how to model datasets logically and partition them physically for optimal query performance, both for analytical query engines and for playback or root-cause-analysis(e.g. ReRun, Foxglove etc)
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with software, hardware, and analytics teams in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with data versioning or immutable dataset design (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake)
  • Experience with vision data (RGB, depth, point clouds, or perception outputs) pipelines and how to process, store, and query multimodal efficiently.
  • Familiarity with C++ and willingness to contribute to lightweight logging or data serialization libraries.
  • Experience with data catalog systems and metadata management.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Join a small, high-impact team building the data foundation for humanoid robotics.
  • Work at the intersection of physical systems and large-scale data infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with talented roboticists, software engineers, and data scientists shaping the future of automation

Location

  • This is a fully remote role with the option to work hybrid if a commutable distance from our Salem, OR, Pittsburgh, PA, or Fremont, CA offices.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This range may change based on geographical location and may be modified in the future.

Anticipated Base Salary Range
$175,000—$274,000 USD

In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of the following for full-time employees:

  • 401(k) Plan:Includes a 6% company match.
  • Equity:Company stock options.
  • Insurance Coverage:100% company-paid medical, dental, vision, and short/long-term disability insurance for employees.
  • Benefit Start Date:Eligible for benefits on your first day of employment.
  • Well-Being Support:Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Time Off:
    • Exempt Employees:Flexible, unlimited PTO and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown.
    • Non-Exempt Employees:10 vacation days, paid sick leave, and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown, annually.
  • On-Site Perks:Catered lunches four times a week and a variety of healthy snacks and refreshments at our Salem and Pittsburgh locations.
  • Parental Leave:Generous paid parental leave programs.
  • Work Environment:A culture that supports flexible work arrangements.
  • Growth Opportunities:Professional development and tuition reimbursement programs.
  • Relocation Assistance:Provided for eligible roles.
  • Annual Discretionary Bonus: Provided for eligible roles.

All of our roles are U.S.-based. Applicants must have current authorization to work in the United States.

Each individual has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits unlawful discriminatory practices, including harassment. Agility Robotics prohibits any such discrimination or harassment.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer - REMOTE to join our team in Herndon (REMOTE), Virginia (US-VA), United States (US).

Job Summary:

The Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer is responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining advanced cybersecurity and identity and access management (IAM) solutions across all client environments, including cloud, IoT, edge, and data systems. This role is critical to ensuring that client meets and sustains compliance with cybersecurity, privacy, and risk management requirements, including RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP controls. The engineer leads the design and enforcement of secure authentication, authorization, and RBAC frameworks, supporting multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and integration with providers. The Cybersecurity / IAM Engineer works closely with DevSecOps, software, and infrastructure teams to embed security best practices into all phases of the system lifecycle, including secure configuration baselines, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response. The position requires hands-on experience with IAM platforms, PKI, secure directory services, and the implementation of audit logging and compliance reporting. The engineer maintains comprehensive documentation, supports audit and ATO processes, and ensures that all client solutions are resilient, auditable, and optimized for operational readiness and regulatory compliance.

Job Duties:

  • Architect, implement, and maintain advanced IAM solutions, including RBAC, MFA, SSO, and integration with providers
  • Develop and enforce secure authentication and authorization frameworks for client's cloud, edge, and data environments
  • Lead the implementation of secure directory services, PKI, and certificate management for all client components
  • Support continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response in compliance with DoD RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP requirements
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps, software, and infrastructure teams to embed security best practices throughout the system lifecycle
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for IAM architectures, security controls, and compliance artifacts
  • Support audit, ATO, and risk management processes, including evidence collection and remediation of findings
  • Implement and monitor audit logging, access reviews, and compliance reporting for all client environments
  • Provide technical support for user provisioning, deprovisioning, and lifecycle management
  • Participate in security assessments, code reviews, and compliance audits as required by contract and SOW

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering, or Mathematics with a concentration in computer science or equivalent.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience with cybersecurity engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency with RBAC, SSO, MFA, PKI, and secure directory services
  • Experience with DoD RMF, IL4/IL5, and FedRAMP cybersecurity and compliance requirements
  • Familiarity with AWS GovCloud, cloud security, and secure integration of edge/IoT devices
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, including the ability to produce compliance artifacts and technical guides
  • Experience supporting audit, ATO, and risk management processes for federal systems
  • Information Assurance Management (IAM) or Information Assurance Technical (IAT) or Information Assurance System Architect and Engineer (IASAE) Level I (position-based) per DoD 8570.1M

jobs.description:
This is a permanent, full-time remote opportunity open to candidates based in the UK. While the role is primarily remote, occasional travel to client sites across the UK may be required to attend meetings, workshops and other project-related activities.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.

Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role:

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

  • Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.
  • Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.
  • Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.
  • Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.
  • Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.
  • Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience in software engineering as either a Senior Engineer leading projects and mentoring or as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, you will ideally be using Golang, experience with additional other languages such as JavaScript or Python would be desirable.
  • Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.
  • Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.
  • Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.
  • Deep understanding of version control tools, e.g. Git.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)
  • Empathy and people skills
  • Financial services industry experience

Benefits and Perks we offer at Nearform

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances- We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
An initial conversation with a member of our Talent Team to explore your background, leadership experience, and career goals. We’ll provide an overview of Nearform, discuss potential alignment, and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

Technical Lead Assessment (90 mins, Zoom)
A structured assessment led by a senior Technical Lead or Head of Engineering, designed to evaluate key aspects of a Technical Lead role. This session includes a selection of tasks to cover:

Architecture Design – We want to see how you approach a high level problem, demonstrating your design thinking and decision-making process.
Technical Implementation – How do you turn a design into reality, taking into account business needs?
Code Standards and Feedback – We want to see not just your own skills, but also how you improve those around you

Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.


Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.
