General Description

The Director, Global Transfer Pricing is a strategic leadership role within the Global Tax organization responsible for developing, implementing, and governing the Company's global transfer pricing strategy. This position provides leadership over transfer pricing policy, value chain alignment, intercompany transactions, tax authority controversy management, and operational transfer pricing governance. The Director partners closely with Finance, Legal, Treasury, Supply Chain, Commercial, Manufacturing, R&D, and Business Development teams to ensure transfer pricing outcomes appropriately reflect the Company's global operating model, intellectual property ownership structure, and value creation activities.


Essential Functions of the Job

· Develop and maintain the Company's global transfer pricing framework, policies, and governance standards.

· Ensure alignment between transfer pricing outcomes and business operations, value creation, intellectual property ownership, and economic substance.

· Oversee implementation and execution of global transfer pricing policies across all jurisdictions.

· Lead preparation of Master Files, Local Files, Country-by-Country Reporting support, benchmarking studies, and audit-ready documentation.

· Provide transfer pricing leadership for acquisitions, licensing arrangements, collaborations, joint ventures, and other strategic transactions.

· Lead transfer pricing audit defense and controversy management activities globally.

· Drive automation, process enhancement, and digital transformation initiatives related to transfer pricing operations.

· Lead APA strategy, negotiations, implementation and compliance activities.

· Manage MAP and competent authority proceedings where appropriate.


Technology & Transformation

· Drive SAP-enabled transfer pricing process improvements.

· Lead tax technology and automation initiatives.

· Leverage AI and analytics to improve controls and operational efficiency.


Leadership & Stakeholder Management

· Ability to work on a matrix environment and supervise a broad external advisor network.

· Partner with Treasury, Legal, Supply Chain, R&D, Manufacturing and Commercial teams.


Qualifications

· 12+ years of transfer pricing experience in a multinational corporation and/or Big Four advisory environment.

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field required. Advanced degree (Master's in Taxation, Economics, Accounting, or MBA) preferred.

· Deep expertise in OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, BEPS initiatives, benchmarking studies and global documentation requirements.

· Significant experience with intellectual property, licensing, manufacturing, distribution, services, and financing transactions.

· Extensive experience using SAP (including S/4HANA environments) to support transfer pricing execution and reporting.

· Demonstrated experience automating transfer pricing calculations and intercompany entries.

· Proven experience negotiating and managing APAs and supporting MAP proceedings.

· Experience defending transfer pricing positions in audits across multiple jurisdictions.


Preferred Qualifications

· Pharmaceutical, biotechnology or life sciences industry experience.

· Experience leading global transfer pricing transformations.

· Experience supporting Pillar Two implementation.

· Experience managing global transfer pricing models.


Critical Leadership Competencies

· Strategic Transfer Pricing Leadership

· Executive Presence and Communication

· Transfer Pricing Audit and Controversy Management

· Technology and Automation Leadership

· Cross-Functional Collaboration

Description

﻿Accelerate Your Career in Cybersecurity

Pentera is the market leader in AI-native Security Validation, equipping enterprises with the platform to proactively test their defenses against the latest cyber attacks.

Pentera proves which exposures are truly exploitable across the entire attack surface and drives remediation workflows that reduce real risk. Anchored in real-attack validation, the Pentera platform powers the full Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) cycle, from exposure discovery through prioritization, validation, and mobilization. Thousands of security teams around the world trust Pentera to close their security gaps before threat actors can exploit them.

With over 350 team members and 1,300 customers in more than 60 countries, Pentera is a growing company supported by top investors such as Insight Partners, K1, and The Blackstone Group.

About the role

Pentera has moved to a 100% channel model in the Americas, and we are hiring a Director of Channel - US to build it.

This is not a role to maintain an existing partner program. It is a role to replace one. The channel at Pentera is moving under Marketing and will be run as a pipeline engine.

We are looking for someone who knows the channel playbook thoroughly and has decided that it’s time for someone to disrupt it. You will have the mandate and the executive backing to do things differently, and you will be expected to keep finding ways to win that other channel teams aren't using.

You will report to the VP of Marketing and manage a Channel ISR.

Roles and responsibilities

  • Launch Pentera's 100% channel model in the US: partner announcement, rules of engagement, and the internal process that routes every deal through a partner.
  • Build the partner base: select 10–15 priority partners, recruit the ones we're missing, exit the ones that don't produce, and run joint plans with real pipeline targets.
  • Enable partner engineers: certification on where Pentera fits versus the competition, with SPIFFs for certified engineers and registered deals.
  • Generate meetings: rep-to-rep and rep-to-account meetings, deal registrations, and partner-sourced pipeline, using proactive account mapping (Crossbeam) and reviewed weekly with Sales, Marketing, and BDR leadership.
  • Manage a Channel ISR who works the partner rep base daily.
  • Keep testing new routes to market - MSSPs, marketplaces, technology alliances and scale what produces business.

How success is measured

Compensation is structured based on qualified partner-sourced meetings, POVs, and closed-won revenue sourced or assisted by partners. Supporting metrics are deal registrations per month, certified partner engineers, and partner-sourced share of the US pipeline.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of channel or partner management at a cybersecurity vendor, including direct experience with US security-focused VARs, regional resellers, and national partners.
  • Proven track record of generating pipeline and revenue through partners, expressed in numbers, not partner counts.
  • Experience building a channel program, motion, or route to market from scratch, or turning one around.
  • Strong grasp of how partner programs actually work: deal registration, margin, MDF, tiering, distribution, and a clear point of view on what to keep and what to drop.
  • Willingness to say no to partners and to hold the line with sales on the channel model.
  • Experimental mindset: launches, measures, and kills initiatives quickly.
  • Player-coach - comfortable doing the work alongside your direct report.
  • Excellent communication and executive-engagement skills.
  • Must be based in the United States; travel required.

jobs.excerpt: Job brief - Opportunity only available for Latam ProfessionalsWe're looking for a hands-on Data Security Solutions Engineer to design and validate database-level security for licensed third-party data: identity-based authentication, fine-grained authorization, auditing, and access revocation/deletion.
locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
Job brief - Opportunity only available for Latam Professionals

We're looking for a hands-on Data Security Solutions Engineer to design and validate database-level security for licensed third-party data: identity-based authentication, fine-grained authorization, auditing, and access revocation/deletion. The role includes running POCs and turning validated patterns into reusable, production-ready designs.

Responsibilities

Technical and Database Assessment
    • Review Data In-Licensing requirements, workflow maps, data flows, data lineage, entitlement rules, and dependency records.
    • Assess relational database platforms, schemas, connectivity methods, interfaces, drivers, service identities, query patterns, and downstream consumption.
    • Identify where licensed data is stored, transformed, replicated, extracted, cached, archived, or backed up.
    • Assess current database security capabilities and identify gaps, constraints, risks, and prerequisites.

Data-Level Authentication and Identity Integration

    • Assess authentication for named users, service identities, workloads, and analytical tools accessing databases.
    • Evaluate OAuth/OIDC or other identity- and token-based authentication directly to the database where supported by the selected technology.
    • Design integration between enterprise identities, security groups, project groups, database principals, roles, and policy engines.
    • Reduce reliance on shared or long-lived credentials where feasible and define secure credential or token handling for unavoidable exceptions.
    • Align with tools currently available and identify gaps if any

    Fine-Grained Authorization and Data Firewalling

    • Design database-level controls that restrict access to explicitly authorized users, groups, services, projects, or licensing populations.
    • Design and implement row-level security, column-level security, dynamic masking, views, policy-based filtering, or equivalent controls as appropriate.
    • Define isolation patterns for different licensed datasets and agreements while preserving permitted platform use for other users.
    • Ensure controls are consistently enforced as close to the data layer as technically feasible and are not solely dependent on application logic.

Auditing, Monitoring, and Traceability

    • Design database auditing to capture who accessed data, what was accessed, when access occurred, and which identity or service was used.
    • Define logging for queries, exports, failed access attempts, permission changes, and privileged activity where supported and required.
    • Integrate audit telemetry with appropriate monitoring and reporting capabilities and define retention and evidence requirements.
    • Validate that audit records are searchable, attributable, protected from inappropriate modification, and useful for investigation.

Data Lifecycle, Revocation, and Deletion

    • Design controls for access revocation when users change roles, leave a project, or when licensing rights expire.
    • Design methods to identify and remove licensed data from primary stores and relevant downstream copies, extracts, caches, or derived stores.
    • Address deletion implications for referential integrity, backups, archives, replication, recovery processes, and downstream consumers.
    • Define validation, exception handling, and evidence mechanisms to demonstrate that required deletion activities were completed.

Solution Architecture and Engineering

    • Translate requirements into current-state and target-state architectures, technical specifications, security patterns, and implementation plans.
    • Compare solution options and document trade-offs across security, feasibility, performance, scalability, operability, cost, and technology constraints.
    • Define database connectivity, policy-enforcement, identity, audit, monitoring, lifecycle, and integration components.
    • Collaborate with database, IAM, security architecture, infrastructure, application, data platform, governance, and scientific teams.

POC Design and Execution

    • Select suitable relational database and workflow candidates that represent Data In-Licensing scenarios and material technical risks.
    • Define POC architecture, test data, test identities, success criteria, negative tests, performance considerations, and rollback approach.
    • Implement and validate identity-based authentication, fine-grained authorization, data firewalling, auditing, access revocation, and deletion scenarios.
    • Document outcomes, limitations, operational considerations, reusable patterns, and recommendations for broader adoption.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with relational databases, SQL, database architecture, schemas, roles, privileges, and access paths.
  • Practical experience implementing database-level authorization, including row-level and column-level controls or equivalent fine-grained mechanisms.
  • Strong knowledge of database authentication, IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, tokens, service identities, workload identities, and secrets management.
  • Experience designing secure database connectivity and integrations for applications, analytical tools, APIs, ETL/ELT, and data pipelines.
  • Experience with database auditing, query/activity monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, and investigation support.
  • Understanding of data lineage, lifecycle, retention, revocation, deletion, backup, archive, and recovery implications.
  • Ability to evaluate heterogeneous database technologies and design platform-appropriate controls.
  • Strong architecture, engineering, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder-collaboration skills.

Expected Deliverables

  • Technical assessment of databases, integrations, identities, and data flows
  • Current-state database security and capability assessment
  • Target-state data security architecture and detailed technical design
  • Database authentication and identity-integration design
  • Row-level, column-level, masking, and policy-enforcement design
  • Data firewalling and licensed-dataset isolation pattern
  • Audit, monitoring, traceability, and reporting design
  • Access revocation, retention, lifecycle, and deletion design
  • Solution options, feasibility, gap, dependency, and risk assessment
  • POC architecture, implementation, test results, and recommendations
  • Reusable implementation patterns and operational handover documentation

Nice to have:

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, cloud or hybrid databases, data catalogs, access governance, and policy-enforcement technologies.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical research, scientific data, intellectual property protection, data licensing, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience designing and executing security POCs and converting validated patterns into production-ready designs.
  • Knowledge of privacy, contractual-use restrictions, segregation, and evidence requirements affecting licensed data.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary in USD.
  • 100% Remote Work.
  • Contract type: Independent Contractor with Venon Solutions LLC.
  • Holidays: from the North American calendar.
  • Working hours: EST Time zone. Full-time, fully committed.

Descartes Unites the People and Technology that Move the World

The need for efficient, secure, and agile supply chains and logistics operations has become ever more critical and complex. By combining innovative technology, powerful trade intelligence and the reach of our network, Descartes helps get goods, information, transportation assets, and people where they’re needed, when they’re needed.

We’re one of the most broadly deployed logistics and supply chain technology companies in the world. More than 26,000 customers around the globe use our cloud-based solutions to transform the way they move inventory and information to enhance productivity, better serve customers, thrive competitively, keep pace with evolving regulations, and respond to rapidly changing market conditions. Descartes is publicly traded (Nasdaq:DSGX, TSX:DSG) with headquarters in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, and offices and partners around the world. With record financial performance for more than 16 years, we lead the industry in innovation investment. Every day, logistics service providers, manufacturers, retailers, distributors, and other logistics-intensive businesses of all sizes rely on our scale, stability, and comprehensive solution footprint to move what’s most important to them. Learn more at www.descartes.com.

We’re growing fast and invite you to join our amazing team.

Mission - Why This Role Exists

As a Technical Support Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring customers receive reliable, high-quality support for business-critical transport management software used across the world. This role exists to provide strong technical ownership of complex issues, strengthen the capability of the Support team, and help customers, colleagues, and third parties reach clear and effective solutions.

You will take a hands-on approach to investigation rather than simply passing issues on. You will form a view on root cause, guide resolution, mentor colleagues, and help shape the Support function of the future through smarter processes, AI tools, and automation.

Outcomes - What Success Looks Like

1. Own complex customer issues from start to finish, acting as a trusted escalation point and driving issues through to clear resolution.

2. Investigate and resolve data, integration, and system-related problems using structured troubleshooting, SQL, and log analysis where appropriate.

3. Provide clear technical guidance to customers, internal teams, and third parties by explaining the cause of issues, recommended fixes, and next steps.

4. Strengthen team capability by mentoring colleagues and sharing knowledge through documentation, training, and day-to-day coaching.

5. Contribute to building a strong Support team by participating in technical interviews for Support candidates.

6. Represent Support effectively in collaboration with customers, Professional Services, and Development teams.

7. Manage the handover of new customers from projects into Support, helping ensure a smooth and well-coordinated transition.

8. Identify practical opportunities to improve the Support function, including work that can transition into Support and opportunities to use AI and automation.

Skills & Competencies - How the Work Gets Done

Technical Expertise - Highly appreciated when you bring:

  • Several years of experience in technical or application support for complex business software, or strong experience in transport management and logistics; ideally both
  • A demonstrated ability to work independently and take full ownership of technical issues through to resolution
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured, methodical approach to troubleshooting
  • Clear and confident communication in English with customers, colleagues, and third parties
  • Experience coaching, mentoring, or training others

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting Transport Management Systems (TMS)
  • SQL skills for troubleshooting, data investigation, and analysis
  • Knowledge of EDI and integrations, including EDIFACT, XML, X12, and APIs
  • Interest in AI tools, automation, and new ways of improving technical support

Key Attributes

  • Mature, independent, and confident in making decisions and taking ownership
  • Reflective and willing to learn from setbacks, with the ability to identify what could be done differently next time
  • Patient and helpful when mentoring others, while remaining direct and clear in communication
  • Curious about new technology and new ways of working
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy and contributing ideas that improve team effectiveness

Culture Add: TEAM Values

We value team members who communicate openly, share information transparently, and build trust across functions. You bring excellence and expertise to your craft, maintaining a high standard of quality while continuously developing your skills. You demonstrate accountability by owning outcomes, following through on commitments, and taking responsibility for results. You are driven by evidence and practical insight, using data and thoughtful experimentation to improve customer and team outcomes.

Aptitudes

  • Smart: Able to quickly understand complex systems, analyse technical problems, connect information, and make sound judgments.
  • Curious: Actively seeks to understand customer problems, new technologies, AI tools, and better ways of working.
  • Coachable: Open to feedback, reflective about setbacks, willing to adapt, and committed to continuous improvement.

What's in It for You

  • A role with real autonomy, influence, and room to grow
  • A collaborative international team and a supportive culture
  • The opportunity to help shape how Support uses AI and automation
  • Exposure to transport, logistics, EDI, integrations, and business-critical customer processes
  • Opportunities to grow within an international software company
  • Fully remote working arrangement with opportunities for long-term career growth within a global software organisation.

Join Us

As we scale, we’re looking for new doers, collaborators and innovators to join Descartes in uniting the people and technology that move the world as the Global Leader in Logistics and Supply Chain Technology. We’re entrepreneurial, hardworking, geeky-in-a-good way problem solvers. Guided by our values, we nurture a TEAM focused culture that invests in people and creates opportunities for advancement across a broad spectrum of career paths. We prioritize work-life balance and foster an environment with the space to take ownership, to be heard, and to carve a path for your individual accomplishments to help drive our success. At Descartes, everyone has a voice and the best idea wins, regardless of who makes it. We offer competitive compensation, great benefits, remote and flexible work hours, and the opportunity to join a company on an awesome mission with a great existing team and trajectory.

Descartes also has a deep sense of environmental responsibility. Learn more about how we helped our customers save over 552,000 metric tons of CO2 in 2020 by reducing fuel and paper consumption: .  Join a team that’s committed to working with customers to conserve resources and enhance sustainability.

If you feel you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for, and Descartes sounds like the team and the mission you want to be part of, apply now. We can't promise it will be a fit, but we do promise to consider your experience.

Description

Curious about what it’s like to work at Cognyte?

At Cognyte, you’ll collaborate with expert colleagues around the globe to solve problems most people will never even know exist!

You’ll be part of building unique solutions shaped by real investigative methodologies, enabling our customers to identify, investigate, visualize and prevent criminal, terror and security threats worldwide.

These solutions are used by law enforcement, national security, and national and military intelligence agencies in almost 100 countries to turn massive, diverse data into clear, actionable intelligence for a safer world.

We are currently looking for an Experienced Threat Intelligence Analyst in North America - (Remote).

As an Experienced Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will support the identification, analysis, and reporting of cyber threats targeting customers, industries, and emerging technologies. You will conduct research across open, deep, and dark web sources to identify indicators of threat activity, assess potential impacts, and produce actionable intelligence for stakeholders.

The analyst will work collaboratively with intelligence, security, and customer-facing teams to support intelligence requirements, investigate emerging threats, and deliver timely intelligence products. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, curiosity, technical aptitude, and the ability to transform complex information into clear, actionable reporting.

As a Cognyter you will:

  • Collect, research, and analyze threat intelligence from open, deep, and dark web sources, social media, forums, and commercial intelligence platforms.
  • Monitor and assess threat actors, cybercrime activity, vulnerabilities, malware campaigns, and emerging threats relevant to customer environments.
  • Correlate information from multiple sources to identify indicators, trends, risks, and actionable intelligence insights.
  • Produce high-quality intelligence reports, assessments, alerts, and briefings for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support customer intelligence requirements through timely intelligence production and threat notification activities.
  • Apply analytical methodologies and intelligence tradecraft to develop accurate and defensible intelligence assessments.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, security, and operational teams to support investigations, threat hunting, and intelligence-driven decision making.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of intelligence processes, collection programs, knowledge repositories, and reporting standards.
  • Deliver dedicated demos, value propositions, and remotely facilitate client onboarding, monthly touchpoint calls, and Quarterly Business Reviews to support renewal and cross-sell functions.
  • Provide Q&A and product feedback

Requirements

For that mission you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or Practical Engineer diploma in a relevant technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2-5 years of experience in threat intelligence, cybersecurity, intelligence analysis, investigations, or related disciplines.
  • Working knowledge of cyber threat intelligence methodologies, intelligence lifecycle concepts, and structured analytical techniques.
  • Experience conducting intelligence collection and research using OSINT, social media, dark web, and other publicly available sources.
  • Understanding of threat actors, cybercrime, malware, ransomware, phishing, social engineering, and common attack methodologies.
  • Familiarity with networking concepts, operating systems, internet protocols, and vulnerability management frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to produce actionable intelligence assessments.
  • Proactive, highly motivated team player with excellent communication skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a customer-focused mindset
  • Exceptional SLA Management and Reporting Skills
  • Hands-on troubleshooting skills with OS such as Linux / Unix / Windows Server
  • Virtualization technologies in clusters configuration
  • Experience with container orchestration and management using Kubernetes
  • LAN network equipment configuration and integration

Advantage:

  • Enterprise server hardware (e.g. Dell, Cisco, HP, Dell, Intel, IBM)
  • Telecommunications protocols and technologies (GSM / GPRS / 5G / UMTS / 4G (LTE) / VoLTE)
  • Analysis technology (Packet sniffing and capture. Data traffic and packet stream analysis tools)
  • Scripting with languages such as, Python or PowerShell, for automation and system administration

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel (Capital Markets)
jobs.excerpt: The opportunityPrivate markets hold some of the most valuable and innovative companies in the world, yet trading their equity still runs on email chains, PDFs and wire instructions.
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Private markets hold some of the most valuable and innovative companies in the world, yet trading their equity still runs on email chains, PDFs and wire instructions. We believe that with the right infrastructure, private markets can become the biggest market in the world. Augment is building that infrastructure, end to end, to be the simplest experience for buying and selling shares in private companies.

As one of our core deal lawyers, you'll keep Augment's investment products moving, from diligence and offering reviews to SPV documents, side letters and closings. You'll help shape our investing playbook, build the templates behind it and help grow our legal team.

About Augment

Accredited and institutional investors use Augment to buy and sell shares in some of the world's most sought after private companies, including Perplexity, Kalshi, SpaceX (now public), and Glean. Augment was founded in 2022 with headquarters in Austin and an office in NYC.

We're growing fast:

  • Raised $16.5M to date from investors including Builders VC, Neo, Golden Section, E1 Ventures and OPCO Ventures
  • Profitable 50+ person team and growing, with an eight-figure annual revenue run rate, targeting 9 figures in 2027

· $1.5B+ in assets under management

  • 10,000+ users and transactions in 45+ private companies
  • Experienced leadership from Google, Rubrik, UBS, Morgan Stanley, Credit Suisse, and Nasdaq Private Markets with our Chief Compliance Officer sitting on FINRA's Small Firm Advisory Committee

Read more about Augment at Augment Jobs.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Legal Counsel to serve as a core deal lawyer behind Augment's revenue-generating investment products. You'll report directly to our Head of Legal and work across product, engineering, business development, operations and compliance teams.

Every week we execute private market transactions: single-asset SPVs, multi-asset funds, side letters, escrow and settlement arrangements, and securities placements. Most of your time will go to running SPV diligence and offering reviews, drafting and negotiating investment documents, and getting deals closed. You'll also support fund structuring, PTP and securities regulatory review, and product counsel work on investment features.

You'll cover the full range of this work, from high-volume execution to non-standard deals that call for judgment. If you'd rather build a practice than inherit one, this is the seat.

🧑‍💻 You Will:

Run SPV diligence and offering reviews

  • Run single-asset SPV diligence and offering reviews from Augment's playbooks, and flag deals that need escalation or a different approach
  • Work with outside diligence counsel on reviews, including managing quality, turnaround and cost
  • Negotiate buy-side investment terms, including side letters, to keep investments on Augment as consistent as possible

Draft and negotiate investment documents

  • Draft and negotiate operating agreements, subscription documents, purchase agreements, side letters and related transaction documents
  • Support the structuring and execution of Augment's multi-asset funds as the product ramps
  • Handle NDAs and NCNDAs with investors, platforms and other counterparties, sharing that work with Augment's commercial lawyers
  • Track side letter and investor obligations across the platform
  • Support entity formation, governance and dissolution across a growing portfolio of investment vehicles

Support PTP structuring and securities regulatory review

  • Run PTP structuring reviews for direct investments and for indirect investments that run through lower-tier vehicles, including the entity classification analysis at each layer
  • Identify and work through Securities Act, Investment Company Act, broker-dealer and RIA considerations that affect deal execution, including Section 4(a)(7) resales, transfer restrictions and resale eligibility
  • Help prepare conflict-of-interest disclosures, offering documents and investor disclosures

Serve as product counsel on investment features

  • Partner with product, engineering, business development and operations to launch new investment features and structures
  • Turn legal risk and structuring considerations into clear, launch-ready guidance that non-lawyers can act on
  • Coordinate escrow, settlement mechanics and closing deliverables so transaction flows are legally sound and operationally executable

Build legal infrastructure

  • Help build and maintain template libraries, playbooks and automated workflows so legal scales with deal volume. Augment is a software company, so you'll have engineers and product teams to help build what you design

🧠 You'd Fit in Well If:

  • You enjoy high-volume deal work and want each deal to close faster and cleaner than the last
  • You want to own outcomes, not just review someone else's work
  • You can move quickly between big-picture structuring and line-by-line document markup
  • You're comfortable doing hands-on work while building processes as you go, with lean resources
  • You have strong judgment and know when a deal needs a different approach
  • You build trust with counterparties, co-investors and internal stakeholders
  • You're excited by businesses that combine software, financial infrastructure and securities operations
  • You stay responsive, organized and calm when deals are closing

💡 Why Augment

  • Upside. Meaningful equity in a venture-backed company that's already operating at scale, in a market we believe is just getting started.
  • Ownership. You'll help shape Augment's investing playbook and structuring approach. Your templates will integrate into the product at scale.
  • Scope. Funds, securities, private markets and product counsel work in one seat. Few in-house roles touch this much of a regulated financial business.
  • Career path. You'll help build the legal team from the ground up, with room to grow into broader leadership as legal scales.
  • No billable hours. No timesheets, no origination targets and no partnership lottery.
  • Flexibility. We're remote-first, with Austin or New York preferred, and unlimited PTO.
  • Timing. Private market secondaries are becoming core financial infrastructure. You'll help build the company defining how that market works.

👨‍🔧 Qualifications

Required

  • JD from an accredited law school and active bar membership in at least one U.S. jurisdiction
  • 4–7 years of experience as a practicing attorney at a law firm, in-house or both, with meaningful experience in funds, securities or capital markets work
  • Experience drafting and negotiating fund, SPV or securities transaction documents, such as operating agreements, subscription agreements, purchase agreements and side letters
  • Working knowledge of the Securities Act and Investment Company Act, and familiarity with broker-dealer and RIA regulatory frameworks
  • Ability to manage high volume across multiple deals at once and to make practical calls quickly
  • Excellent drafting skills, with strong attention to detail and commercial judgment
    •

Bonus

  • Private markets experience, such as secondary transactions, SPVs, private funds or private company share transfers
  • Familiarity with PTP rules and entity classification analysis
  • In-house experience at a bank, asset manager, financial services or fintech company
  • Experience working with outside counsel or building playbooks for high-volume work
  • Willingness to obtain securities licenses (e.g., Series 7, Series 63, Series 65)
    •

🏄‍♂️ Benefits

  • Meaningful equity in a profitable, high-growth company
  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental and vision coverage for employees
    •

· Unlimited PTO

· Remote, with New York preferred

The U.S. base salary for this role is $160,000 to $215,000 a year, depending on level, experience and demonstrated responsibility, plus equity. Total compensation may also include other components or benefits, depending on the role.

Why This Role Matters

Augment's deal volume and complexity are growing fast. Every SPV, side letter, fund and new investment product we launch needs careful execution and skilled negotiation. You'll help build the legal foundation that lets Augment scale, protects our investors and helps define how private markets operate.

If this sounds exciting, apply here.

About the Team

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team enables secure, seamless access across DoorDash's global engineering and business operations. Our mission is to make access simple, automated, and user-centric, reducing friction through self-service solutions while maintaining strong governance and compliance. We focus on streamlining identity lifecycle processes, modernising access governance, and building scalable controls that enable employees and engineers to work efficiently and securely.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on IAM leader who can turn strategy into tangible outcomes, combining technical implementation, control ownership, and team leadership. Operating with a global remit, you will partner closely with the UK-based Global Head of IAM to execute our strategy, while leading delivery, resolving operational challenges, and supporting stakeholders across US time zones and the wider business. This requires flexibility to work earlier hours to maximise collaboration with the UK, while maintaining sufficient coverage across US teams. Within your first 60 days, we expect you to have independently delivered measurable improvements in access governance, audit remediation, lifecycle controls, or automation, before taking on responsibility for managing and growing our US IAM engineering team following an initial onboarding period.

You will report into the Global Head of Identity and Access Management on our Identity and Access Management team in our Security organisation.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build solutions, not just designs: Architect, configure, and implement IAM improvements using identity platforms, APIs, scripting, and automation, delivering minimum viable solutions quickly while progressing toward scalable strategic designs.
  • Enable the business: Simplify access processes through automation, self-service, and data-driven improvements that reduce friction for employees and engineers while maintaining appropriate security controls.
  • Lead IAM delivery in the US: Independently prioritise and resolve operational challenges, make risk-informed decisions, deliver against global IAM objectives, and build and develop a high-performing engineering team.
  • Create compliance by design: Build agile, automated IAM solutions that meet security and audit requirements by default, embedding effective controls into everyday workflows rather than relying on manual checks and retrospective remediation.
  • Shape the future of identity: Advance role-based and attribute-based access models, while exploring emerging opportunities in non-human identity and AI agent governance.

We're excited about you because…

  • You have 8+ years of IAM experience, including direct, hands-on ownership of user access reviews, identity lifecycle controls, SoX audit evidence, and remediation of control deficiencies.
  • You have proven technical implementation experience, including configuring IAM platforms such as Okta, ConductorOne, Saviynt, SailPoint, or similar tools, and using scripting, APIs, or automation to deliver working solutions.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to take ambiguous IAM problems from assessment through design to implementation, balancing immediate risk remediation with long-term scalability and delivering measurable outcomes.
  • You have experience leading technical teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders, with the ability to independently set priorities, make decisions, and remain actively involved in engineering and operational delivery.
  • You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using data to identify control gaps, improve processes, measure outcomes, and balance security, compliance, and user experience.

jobs.excerpt: Why Valtech?  We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands.
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

Please note, we are only accepting applicants from the provinces of Ontario and Québec for this role. For Québec-based candidates, fluency in English is necessary because the position entails collaboration with teams based in the rest of Americas and occasionally in Europe.

As Practice Director, Shopify Commerce, you will own the technical vision, delivery excellence, and business development strategy for our enterprise Shopify Plus practice. You will lead a global team of architects, engineers, and solution consultants—shaping how we design, build, and scale mission-critical commerce platforms for our largest clients. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise commerce architecture, active sales engagement, and talent leadership. You will be expected to command deep, hands-on knowledge of the Shopify Plus ecosystem and the broader technology stack that surrounds it—including ERP integrations, enterprise search, customer data platforms, and headless commerce patterns—and translate that expertise into winning proposals, trusted client partnerships, and a world-class team.

Why Join Us?

  • Lead a practice at the forefront of enterprise Shopify Plus—working with some of the world’s most ambitious commerce brands.
  • Collaborate with global experts across strategy, design, engineering, and commerce operations to deliver end-to-end transformation.
  • Shape how our firm thinks about and delivers Shopify—building playbooks, growing a team, and influencing the direction of a high-growth practice.

Role responsibilities

Shopify Plus Architecture & Technology Strategy

  • Define and own the architectural patterns and best practices for enterprise Shopify Plus deployments, including headless/composable commerce, Shopify Functions, Markets Pro, and B2B capabilities.
  • Lead the design of end-to-end commerce ecosystems spanning Shopify Plus and adjacent enterprise systems—ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), enterprise search (Elasticsearch, Algolia, Kenshoo), CDP/CRM (Salesforce, Segment, mParticle), PIM, OMS, and payment gateways.
  • Evaluate and stay ahead of emerging Shopify platform capabilities (e.g., Shopify Audiences, Checkout Extensibility, Editions releases) and translate them into client-ready solutions and internal playbooks.
  • Serve as the practice’s ultimate authority on technical feasibility, scalability, and integration strategy for Shopify Plus engagements.

Delivery Leadership

  • Oversee technical delivery across global, cross-functional teams delivering enterprise Shopify Plus solutions, ensuring quality, performance, and client satisfaction at scale.
  • Establish governance frameworks, risk mitigation strategies, and delivery KPIs tailored to the pace and complexity of commerce platform engagements. -
  • Act as a technical escalation point and actively unblock delivery teams, modeling the kind of senior leadership and decisiveness the practice requires.
  • Build, retain, and develop a high-performing team of Shopify architects, engineers, and solution leads—setting clear expectations, creating growth paths, and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

Sales Engagement & Client Partnership

  • Own the technical narrative in the sales process: participate actively in discovery, solutioning, estimation, architecture design, and proposal development for Shopify Plus pursuits.
  • Partner closely with business development and account teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing Shopify Plus engagements.
  • Serve as a credible, senior technical voice in client-facing conversations—building trust, managing expectations, and positioning our practice as a strategic partner, not just a vendor.
  • Maintain and deepen relationships with Shopify’s partner and alliance teams, ensuring we are positioned for early access to new programs, beta capabilities, and co-sell opportunities.

Practice Development & Talent Growth

  • Mentor and coach Shopify architects, technical leads, and engineers across regions—actively investing in their growth and career trajectories.
  • Drive Shopify-specific certification and enablement programs (e.g., Shopify Partner certifications, Shopify Developer certifications) and build learning paths that keep the team at the forefront of platform innovation.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, solution playbooks, case studies, and reusable architecture assets that accelerate delivery and sales across the practice.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Utilization Optimization: Maintain or improve team utilization rates across all Shopify Plus engagements, targeting 70%+ blended team utilization.
  • Certification Growth: Drive 100% of the practice team to hold at least one Shopify Partner or Developer certification within 12 months.
  • Solution Quality: Ensure architectural integrity, scalability, and maintainability across all delivered Shopify Plus solutions—measured by client satisfaction scores and post-launch performance benchmarks.
  • Sales Pipeline Contribution: Actively participate in pursuits contributing to at least $8M in unweighted Shopify Commerce pipeline annually, with a target of closing $3M+ in new logos or significant expansions.
  • Individual Billability: Maintain a minimum of 50% individual billable utilization, balanced against the practice-building and sales activities inherent to this role.
  • Team Retention & Growth: Achieve 85%+ retention within the practice and maintain a pipeline of at least two internal candidates ready for promotion annually.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology leadership within a consulting, systems integration, or agency environment—with at least 3–4 years specifically in Shopify Plus or a comparable enterprise commerce platform.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in the Shopify Plus platform: Shopify Functions, Checkout Extensibility, Markets Pro, B2B, headless/composable commerce architectures, and the Shopify app ecosystem.
  • Strong command of the enterprise commerce technology stack surrounding Shopify Plus—including ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), enterprise search (Elasticsearch, Algolia), CDPs (Segment, mParticle, Salesforce Data Cloud), PIM, OMS, and payment platforms.
  • Proven track record of participating in or leading sales pursuits, proposals, and client-facing solutioning conversations—comfortable owning a technical narrative in a competitive deal.
  • Experience building, leading, and growing distributed technical teams—hiring, mentoring, retaining senior talent, and creating cultures of technical excellence.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to operate fluently across executive, technical, and commercial audiences.

Preferred Certifications

  • Shopify Partner Certification, Shopify Developer Certification, or Shopify Plus Certification (required or expected within 6 months of hire).
  • AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, SAFe, PMP, or equivalent—demonstrating both platform-level and enterprise architecture credentials.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a full time position based in Quebec, Canada. The offered salary range is $150,000-225,000 CAD annually, depending on experience and location.

Valtech offers a comprehensive benefits package effective after three months of continuous service:

  • A comprehensive insurance plan, where you can choose the module that best suits your needs—Gold, Silver, or Bronze. The employer may contribute up to 80% of your coverage depending on the selected module. This plan includes short- and long-term disability coverage.
  • Dialogue via Sun Life provides virtual healthcare services, allowing you to consult with a healthcare professional for emergencies, prescription renewals, and more. You also have access to the Employee and Family Assistance Program, as well as a complete mental health support program.
  • A $500 Personal Spending Account, which can be used for healthcare reimbursements, gym memberships, public transit passes, office supplies, or contributions to your RRSP through Valtech.
  • A retirement plan where Valtech will match 100% of your RRSP contributions through a Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP), up to a maximum of 4%. You can start contributing to your RRSP immediately, and to the DPSP after 3 months. The vesting of the DPSP will be after a 24 months of service.
  • Access to a flexible vacation under Valtech's policy to support your work-life balance, with 5 days available during your probation period and a prorated amount calculated for the remainder of the year.
  • Personal Technology Reimbursement – $30/month for every employee-offered on day 1.
  • We close during the winter holidays and offer flexible scheduling throughout the year, so you can enjoy those sunny Friday afternoons—provided your weekly hours are completed.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Axia Women's Health has been recognized as the #1 Physician Practice for Women's Health by Castle Connolly and certified as a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years. Learn more at www.axiawh.com.

The SVP, Payor Strategy leads payor contracting on behalf of Axia Women's Health's affiliated physician practices across a growing multi-state MSO platform. Responsible for both fee-for-service (FFS) and value-based care (VBC) arrangements, this executive will develop and execute enterprise payor strategy across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid managed care plans.

Axia currently operates in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Kentucky and continues to expand. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, the SVP will lead market expansion contracting efforts, support M&A activity from diligence through integration, and serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership, Finance, Revenue Cycle, Operations, and physician leaders.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and influential healthcare executive with deep expertise in provider contracting, reimbursement strategy, and payor negotiations, coupled with the ability to build strong relationships across physician, executive, and health plan stakeholders.

Essential Functions:

Payor Strategy

  • Develop and carry out a multi-year payor strategy across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid managed care plans that supports Axia's growth and financial goals.
  • Lead contracting on behalf of the affiliated professional corporations (PCs) within the MSO model, in keeping with corporate practice of medicine requirements and Axia's governance structure.
  • Assess market dynamics, payor behavior, and competitive positioning in current and target markets to set contracting priorities.

Fee-for-Service Contract Optimization

  • Lead negotiations, renewals, and amendments of FFS agreements to improve rates, strengthen contract terms, and reduce administrative burden.
  • Build contract strategies for each service line, including professional, imaging, and laboratory fee schedules, and address prior authorization, site-of-service, and ancillary billing terms specific to each.

Value-Based Care & Alternative Payment Models

jobs.excerpt: About the role YAMU Media is a performance marketing agency that builds and scales paid social for ecommerce and lead-gen brands.
jobs.description:
About the role

YAMU Media is a performance marketing agency that builds and scales paid social for ecommerce and lead-gen brands. We are hiring full-time remote video editors based in the Philippines to turn creative briefs and scripts into Meta, TikTok and YouTube ads that hit their numbers.

This is not a brand-film or wedding-video role. Every edit you make is tested against hook rate, hold rate, CTR and cost per purchase or lead. You will work from strategy-first briefs (a Creative Angle, then a video or UGC execution brief) and ship multiple variants per concept so we can find winners fast and iterate on them.

You'll report to the Creative Lead and work alongside our media buyers, copywriters and strategists.

What you'll do

  • Edit short-form direct-response video ads (6–60 seconds) for Meta Reels, Stories and Feed, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1.
  • Turn UGC creator footage, founder clips, product b-roll and stock into ads that follow the script and brief exactly, then add your own ideas on top.
  • Build 3–5 hook variants per concept (different opening lines, visuals and text overlays) so the media team can test which first 3 seconds stop the scroll.
  • Iterate on proven winners: re-cut top performers with new hooks, new pacing, new offers or new creators when the media team flags fatigue.
  • Add captions, kinetic text, on-screen callouts, sound design, music and simple motion graphics that support the message rather than decorate it.
  • Follow brand guidelines and client compliance rules, including health and wellness claims rules for regulated clients.
  • Hit turnaround targets: first cut within 24–48 hours of a complete brief, revisions within 24 hours.
  • Keep project files, exports and naming conventions organized so any editor or buyer can find any asset.
  • Review ad performance with the team each week and use what the data shows to make the next round of edits better.

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years editing paid social ads for DTC, ecommerce or lead-gen brands, with a portfolio of live ads (not just reels or vlogs).
  • You can explain why a hook works: pattern interrupts, problem-first openers, social proof, "us vs. them" and before/after structures.
  • Strong pacing instincts for mobile: cuts every 1–3 seconds, no dead air, the product or payoff shown early.
  • Advanced skill in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus CapCut for fast UGC-style edits.
  • Working knowledge of After Effects or similar for text animation and simple motion graphics.
  • Clear written English. You'll read detailed briefs, ask questions in Slack and ClickUp, and leave notes on your own cuts.
  • Comfortable taking direct feedback and revising quickly without losing quality.
  • Reliable: you meet deadlines, flag blockers early and show up for scheduled overlap hours.

Nice to have

  • You've read Meta Ads Manager data yourself: hook rate (3-second views ÷ impressions), hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS.
  • Experience editing ads for health, wellness, supplements or telehealth brands, where claims must be compliant.
  • You can write or punch up hooks and on-screen text, not just cut them.
  • Experience with AI tools in your workflow (voice cloning, AI b-roll, auto-captioning, upscaling) and good judgment about when they help.
  • Static ad and thumbnail design in Photoshop, Figma or Canva.
  • Familiarity with US consumer culture and humor, so ads land with American audiences.

Role detailsItemDetailsTypeFull-time independent contractor, 40 hours/weekLocationRemote, PhilippinesScheduleFlexible, with 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern / Atlantic time (about 8 PM–12 AM PHT, Mon–Fri)Pay[USD X,XXX–X,XXX per month], based on portfolio and test project, paid via Wise or DeelBenefits[Paid time off, Philippine holidays, performance bonus for winning ads, annual raise review]EquipmentYour own editing computer (16GB+ RAM), 25+ Mbps internet, and backup power or internet for brownoutsTools we usePremiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, After Effects, Frame.io, Google Drive, ClickUp, Slack, Meta Ads Manager (view access)Open question: confirm the pay band and benefits before posting. Bracketed items are placeholders.

How to apply

Send the following:

  1. A portfolio link with 5–10 paid social ads you edited. Note your role on each and any results you can share.
  2. One ad you're proudest of, with 2–3 sentences on why the hook works.
  3. Your hourly or monthly rate expectation in USD and your earliest start date.

Shortlisted applicants complete a paid test project: we send a short brief, a script and raw UGC footage, and you deliver one 30-second ad plus 3 hook variants within 48 hours. We review it on hook strength, pacing, brief accuracy and polish.

Applications without a portfolio of ads won't be reviewed.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Success Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Hi 👋 I'm Mountain, Head of Technical Success at Pinpoint.
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Mountain, Head of Technical Success at Pinpoint.

Pinpoint builds the hiring software that in house recruiting teams use to attract, hire and onboard the right people. We have a mature product, strong product market fit and a lot of happy customers.

Technical Success clears the technical path for everyone who touches a customer. When Sales, Customer Success or Implementation hits something complex inside the platform (a careers site change, a bulk data job through our API, an integration, a migration, an escalation nobody else can crack), it lands with us. We've just welcomed our first Senior Technical Success Engineer, and we're expanding how the team works around automation and AI rather than more hands on the queue. We want the next person to help build that, which is why we're hiring a second Senior Technical Success Engineer.

That's where you come in. You look at a queue of tickets and see the workflow behind them. You'd rather fix the pattern than close the ticket, you reach for AI to do it, and you check what it gives you before a customer ever sees it. You won't know every technology on day one, but you're the kind of person who figures it out.
What you should know up front
  • This is a remote role, based in the UK, Spain, Portugal or Poland, with occasional in person team meetups.
  • You'd report to me, inside R&D, working alongside a small team and partnering every day with Customer Success, Implementation, Sales and our engineers.
  • This is not a support role. Support is reactive; this role exists to remove the reasons support gets called.
  • We're an AI first team. AI writes our scripts, builds our tooling and does real work in our workflows, and we expect you to raise that bar, not just meet it.
  • Pinpoint is still very much a startup. Priorities shift and not everything is defined, and we want people who do well in that.
  • Our values actually matter here. We hire people who reflect them in how they work, collaborate, and make decisions.

What you'll do

  • Take apart the repetitive work: build AI workflows, scripts and automations across careers site changes, bulk data jobs and onboarding, so the queue shrinks instead of grows.
  • Solve the technical problems that block customer facing teams, from API and integration work to data migrations and platform configuration.
  • Get under the hood of the platform to understand not just what a customer sees, but why it behaves that way and where the real fix lives.
  • Turn recurring customer friction into clear signal for the product squads, not just a closed ticket.
  • Be the technical partner in the room with customers, able to talk to their IT team and their talent team in the same conversation.
  • Build alongside our first Senior Technical Success Engineer to set the standard for how the growing team works.
In practice, that means work like:
  • Careers site changes, and fixing them when they break: custom application forms, tracking pixels, HTML and CSS tweaks, embeds that stop working after a customer changes their own site.
  • Bulk data jobs through our API: mass updates, retagging thousands of records, cleanups and exports.
  • Integrations set up and debugged: SSO, job board feeds, HRIS and onboarding handoffs, calendars, and customers' own API and webhook builds.
  • Data migrations for customers moving off another ATS: mapping fields, cleaning messy exports and getting it all in clean.
  • The escalations no one else can crack: the email that didn't send, the sync that failed silently, the config doing something nobody expected.

What you'll bring

  • Hands on technical work for customers: integrations, data, configuration and debugging, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Something you've built with AI and still rely on: a workflow, agent or automation that took real work off your plate, not a certificate or a tool you tried once.
  • Working code in Python, JavaScript or similar, enough to write and debug your own scripts that call an API, move or clean data, or automate a task, plus an understanding of what's going on underneath any no code tool you use.
  • An instinct to fix the system behind a problem, not just the problem in front of you.
  • Sound judgment about AI, including knowing when it's confidently wrong and when not to use it at all.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and a habit of figuring things out rather than waiting for a spec.
  • Ease in front of a customer as well as under the hood. Most people are one or the other; we need both.
  • Motivation to solve customers' technical problems after the sale, rather than to carry a number.
  • Bonus: a background in technical support or support engineering where you outgrew the ticket queue and started building your way out of it.
You may not enjoy this role if
  • Your AI experience is a course and a forked repo rather than something you built and use.
  • You want to stay heads down and never speak to a customer.
  • You need every problem to come with a documented answer before you'll touch it.
  • You want to architect deep software systems all day. This role is broader and lighter touch than that by design.

What we offer

We want Pinpoint to be the best place you've ever worked, somewhere you feel valued, supported and excited to grow. Here's what you get:
  • Comprehensive healthcare: excellent medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Unlimited holidays: take the time you need to rest and recharge

About Vana

Vana is the open network for user-owned data: people decide where their data goes and who trains AI on it, and share in what it creates. Builders reach it through UU API a tool developed by OpenDataLabs () on the Vana Network, the developer gateway to the protocol. Vana is build on the Personal Data Portability Protocol (PDPP) (), an open standard hosted with the Linux Foundation Decentralized Trust that underpins the way users permission their data across applications and services.

The role

You are Vana's face to the developers and product managers who build on UU API, PDPP and the protocol, and to builders at large. You own every builder relationship that touches the protocol, from a first question in Discord to a running node. About a fifth of the job is building and tinkering. The rest is developing programmes, demo-ing, working with our content team to develop builder-facing content, and managing the builders that touch our ecosystem. This is a Vana Foundation role, and you report directly to the Managing Director.

What you will do

  • Set the developer marketing strategy and guide the marketing team's campaigns and content. The content team creates; you decide what gets made and why.

  • Run the Builder Incentives Programme and the programmes that get data connectors built, tested and maintained. In time, run the node operator network.

  • Be the first user of every developer product and system. Test them, find what is missing, and tell engineering what is required.

  • Show people how to build data connectors, in writing, on video and live.

  • Represent Vana in Discord, at events and online, and grow the number of builders who adopt and stay.

What we are looking for

  • Zero to two years out of university, recent graduates welcome. A software engineering background: a computer science or engineering degree, or the equivalent in shipped work.

  • A strong GitHub, with contributions to open-source projects you did not start.

  • You love AI tools and build with them every day.

  • Mission aligned. You care about who controls personal data and what AI is trained on, and it already shows in what you do.

  • Outgoing, a clear communicator, comfortable on camera and on stage. Fluent, confident spoken and written English. Multi-lingual is a bonus.

  • Organised enough to run programmes with budgets, deadlines and many participants.

Nice to have

  • A public presence beyond GitHub: X, YouTube, a newsletter or a community you are visible in.

  • Shipped a data connector, browser extension or integration against a public API.

  • Run a hackathon, meetup, student society or online community.

  • Familiar with open standards and open-source governance.

What we offer

  • A salaried junior role, not commission.

  • Work from anywhere.

  • A direct line to the founders. You set how Vana shows up to builders.

How to apply

Send a link to something you built and something you published, and three sentences on why this mission is yours.

jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

WE'RE HIRING 1,000 WORK AT HOME STAFF TO SUPPORT FEDERAL, STATE, AND COMMERCIAL CLIENTS

MCI is looking for nationwide work at home customer service, help desk, technical support, and sales representatives to support call demand. In these roles, you will handle inbound customer inquiries, or troubleshoot basic technical issues, and assist customers in adding or removing products and services. There are full-time positions. The positions offer competitive base pay commensurate with experience, role, schedule, level, plus benefits for full-time, paid vacation, and variable bonus and contest incentives. All it takes to get started is for you to complete an easy online application and an informal interview with a talent acquisition specialist. If you do not have your equipment, MCI will provide it. You will need a home broadband connection.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

Our entry-level Contact Center Representatives are responsible for the following tasks:

  • Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues
  • Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks
  • Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade
  • Explain and position the products and processes with customers
  • Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team
  • Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT?

MCI provides all new employees with world-class training, so all positive, driven, and confident applicants are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated, energetic, and dedicated.

Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
  • The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Basic understanding of Windows operating system
  • Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality
  • The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues
  • An aptitude for conflict resolution, problem solving and negotiation
  • Must be customer service oriented (empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious)
  • Ability to multi-task, stay focused and self-manage
  • Strong team orientation and customer focus
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where change and ambiguity prevalent
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with your team and customers

COMPENSATION DETAILS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
  • Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
  • Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
  • Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.
  • Fun, Engaging Work Environment: Enjoy a team-oriented culture that fosters collaboration and engagement.
  • Casual Dress Code: Be comfortable while you work.

Compensation & Benefits that Fit Your Life

MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

All MCI Locations

  • Must be authorized to work in the country where the job is based.

Subject to the program and location of the position

  • Must be willing to submit up to a LEVEL II background and/or security investigation with a fingerprint. Job offers are contingent on background/security investigation results.
  • Must be willing to submit to drug screening. Job offers are contingent on drug screening results. (Does not apply in Canada)

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it is the policy of MCI and its affiliates to provide reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability unless such accommodations would cause undue hardship. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment. If reasonable accommodations are needed, please contact Human Resources.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity is a benefit to our employees, our company, our customers, and our community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, it is the policy of MCI to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

ABOUT US

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI’s subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines.

Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.
